title: Examination eligibility
case_a: A Massachusetts applicant has completed an approved PharmD program but will be 17 on the scheduled examination date. The application is otherwise complete.
case_b: A licensing coordinator compares an ACPE graduate with a graduate of a non-approved foreign pharmacy school before submitting their Massachusetts applications.

pairs.true: The examination pathway requires the applicant to be at least 18 by the scheduled examination date.
pairs.false: Graduation waives the minimum age for the examination pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 졸업 요건과 시험일까지 18세 이상 요건은 별개다.

pairs.true: The foreign-school pathway requires the specified FPGEC certification evidence.
pairs.false: A foreign-school diploma alone replaces FPGEC certification evidence.
pairs.reason_ko: 비승인 외국 약대 경로의 FPGEC 증빙을 단순 졸업장으로 대신할 수 없다.

pairs.true: Internship requirements remain a separate part of licensure eligibility.
pairs.false: FPGEC certification also establishes completion of every internship requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: FPGEC와 internship의 인정·증빙은 서로 다른 자격 단계다.

pairs.true: The Board determines whether the applicant meets its licensing requirements.
pairs.false: The employer's offer establishes the applicant's licensing eligibility.
pairs.reason_ko: 고용 제안은 Board의 최종 적격성 심사를 대신하지 않는다.

title: Passing examinations versus authorization to practice
case_a: A graduate receives passing examination results on Friday. The Massachusetts pharmacist license has not yet been issued, but the employer schedules independent verification duties for Saturday.
case_b: An applicant pays all required fees while the Board requests missing documentation. The applicant asks whether payment permits practice during processing.

pairs.true: Passing the examinations does not itself authorize independent pharmacist practice.
pairs.false: Passing both examinations authorizes practice while license issuance is pending.
pairs.reason_ko: 시험 합격과 실제 면허 발급은 별도의 단계다.

pairs.true: Payment does not replace completion and approval of the licensing process.
pairs.false: Payment activates temporary pharmacist authority until the application is decided.
pairs.reason_ko: 수수료 납부로 임시 약사 권한이 생긴다는 근거는 없다.

pairs.true: The Board may require a complete application before considering it.
pairs.false: The Board must treat an incomplete application as approved once fees are accepted.
pairs.reason_ko: 미비 서류를 납부 사실로 보완한 것으로 볼 수 없다.

pairs.true: An appropriately licensed intern must remain within the supervised intern role.
pairs.false: A graduate with an intern license may perform final pharmacist verification independently.
pairs.reason_ko: 졸업자라도 intern 자격으로 일하면 감독·업무범위 제한이 남는다.

title: Reciprocity responsibilities
case_a: A pharmacist licensed in another state obtains NABP approval of a Massachusetts reciprocity application and assumes that a Massachusetts license is now active.
case_b: A pharmacist has held licenses in several states and is assembling a Massachusetts reciprocity application. One license has a disciplinary history.

pairs.true: NABP's preliminary approval does not replace the Massachusetts Board's final decision.
pairs.false: NABP's preliminary approval automatically activates a Massachusetts pharmacist license.
pairs.reason_ko: NABP 사전 평가와 Massachusetts Board의 최종 면허 결정은 구분한다.

pairs.true: The application must address the required standing of all states in which licenses were held.
pairs.false: Only the standing of the pharmacist's most recently used license matters.
pairs.reason_ko: 여러 주에서 보유한 면허의 standing 관련 증빙을 최근 한 주로 축소하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Massachusetts MPJE requirements remain part of the applicable reciprocity pathway.
pairs.false: An active out-of-state license automatically waives the Massachusetts MPJE.
pairs.reason_ko: 다른 주 면허만으로 MA MPJE가 자동 면제되지 않는다.

pairs.true: The Board may require a personal appearance as part of reciprocity review.
pairs.false: A personal appearance is replaced by an employer reference in every reciprocity case.
pairs.reason_ko: 개인 면담 요구 여부는 Board의 적용 요건이며 고용주 추천이 자동 대체하지 않는다.

title: Reciprocity application clock
case_a: NABP approves a pharmacist's Massachusetts reciprocity application on April 6. The pharmacist waits several months before completing the remaining state requirements.
case_b: A pharmacist wants to restart the reciprocity application period by changing employers after NABP approval.

pairs.true: The stated one-year validity period is measured from NABP approval.
pairs.false: The stated one-year validity period begins with the first Massachusetts work shift.
pairs.reason_ko: reciprocity 신청의 1년은 첫 근무일이 아니라 NABP 승인일에서 시작한다.

pairs.true: Changing employers does not create a new application-validity starting date.
pairs.false: Changing employers restarts the one-year reciprocity application period.
pairs.reason_ko: 고용주 변경은 해당 법정 application clock의 시작 사건이 아니다.

pairs.true: The application-validity clock is distinct from an examination-failure clock.
pairs.false: Every one-year licensing deadline uses the date of the most recent examination.
pairs.reason_ko: 숫자가 같아도 신청 유효기간과 시험 불합격 관련 기한의 trigger가 다르다.

pairs.true: Final state licensing requirements must still be satisfied within the applicable process.
pairs.false: Timely NABP approval removes the remaining state licensing requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: 사전 승인을 받았어도 MA의 남은 요건은 별도로 충족해야 한다.

title: Personal and facility renewal calendars
case_a: A pharmacist manages both a personal Massachusetts pharmacist registration and a Drug Store Pharmacy license and tries to renew both on the same two-year schedule.
case_b: A pharmacy also holds sterile-compounding authorization. Its manager is preparing a calendar for the different renewals.

pairs.true: The personal pharmacist registration follows the even-numbered-year December 31 cycle.
pairs.false: The personal pharmacist registration follows the odd-numbered-year December 31 cycle.
pairs.reason_ko: 개인 약사 면허는 짝수 해 12월 31일 주기다.

pairs.true: Drug Store Pharmacy licenses use the odd-numbered-year December 31 cycle.
pairs.false: Drug Store Pharmacy licenses use the pharmacist's birthday renewal cycle.
pairs.reason_ko: Drug Store 허가는 홀수 해 말, technician 개인 면허는 생일 주기다.

pairs.true: The specified compounding pharmacy licenses have annual December 31 renewal cycles.
pairs.false: Adding a compounding license makes all facility licenses expire every three years.
pairs.reason_ko: compounding 추가 허가는 일반 Drug Store와 별도의 연간 갱신을 관리한다.

pairs.true: A pharmacy with multiple licenses must track each applicable renewal separately.
pairs.false: Renewing the personal pharmacist license also renews the facility licenses.
pairs.reason_ko: 사람과 시설의 면허는 서로 다른 문서이며 한 번의 갱신으로 모두 끝나지 않는다.

title: Ordinary license lapse
case_a: A Massachusetts pharmacist allowed a non-disciplinary license to expire 75 days ago. The pharmacist wants to resume practice after merely mailing the renewal fee.
case_b: Another pharmacist's non-disciplinary registration has been unrenewed for more than two years. The pharmacist asks whether the same short-lapse process necessarily applies.

pairs.true: A lapse exceeding 60 days can trigger Board-specified conditions, including additional CE.
pairs.false: A lapse exceeding 60 days automatically requires NAPLEX in every case.
pairs.reason_ko: 60일 초과 경로는 Board 조건이며 자동 NAPLEX 규칙이 아니다.

pairs.true: The more-than-two-year ordinary lapse pathway requires MPJE and other Board conditions.
pairs.false: An ordinary lapse longer than two years can be resolved by paying fees alone.
pairs.reason_ko: 2년 초과 일반 미갱신에는 MPJE 합격 등 선행요건이 있다.

pairs.true: Practicing after expiration is not authorized by a pending renewal payment.
pairs.false: Proof of a mailed renewal payment permits practice under an expired registration.
pairs.reason_ko: 납부·신청 사실을 현재 유효한 면허와 동일시하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Ordinary expiration and disciplinary suspension are different licensing states.
pairs.false: An expired registration must be treated as a disciplinary revocation in every case.
pairs.reason_ko: expiration·suspension·revocation은 구분되는 상태다.

title: Disciplinary reinstatement and military extension
case_a: A pharmacist seeks reinstatement after a disciplinary suspension lasting more than two years. The pharmacist assumes that the Board cannot require an examination beyond MPJE.
case_b: A pharmacist returning from active armed-forces service compares the special registration extension with the rules for an ordinary civilian lapse.

pairs.true: The Board may require NAPLEX in the specified extended disciplinary-reinstatement pathway.
pairs.false: NAPLEX is categorically excluded from the extended disciplinary-reinstatement pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 2년 초과 suspended/revoked 경로에는 Board가 NAPLEX를 요구할 수 있다.

pairs.true: The military extension is tied to qualifying active service and release from that service.
pairs.false: Every pharmacist receives a 90-day practice grace period after expiration.
pairs.reason_ko: 현역 복무 후 90일의 특수 규정을 모든 약사 일반 유예로 확대하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The military CE exception has its own service and timing conditions.
pairs.false: Military service at any time in a career permanently exempts a pharmacist from CE.
pairs.reason_ko: 군 복무 CE 예외도 적용 기간·시점 조건을 충족해야 한다.

pairs.true: A reinstatement applicant must satisfy the applicable Board conditions before resuming practice.
pairs.false: Submitting a reinstatement application restores the suspended practice authority.
pairs.reason_ko: 복구 신청과 실제 권한 회복은 별개의 단계다.

title: Retired status and duplicate certificate
case_a: A Massachusetts pharmacist receives retired status and plans to cover occasional paid dispensing shifts because the status is nondisciplinary.
case_b: A pharmacist obtained a duplicate registration certificate after a loss, then later found the original certificate.

pairs.true: Retired status does not authorize occasional active pharmacy practice.
pairs.false: Nondisciplinary retired status permits occasional practice without reinstatement.
pairs.reason_ko: nondisciplinary는 업무 허용과 같은 뜻이 아니다.

pairs.true: The recovered-original situation calls for prompt return of the duplicate certificate.
pairs.false: The recovered-original situation calls for destruction of the original certificate.
pairs.reason_ko: 원본을 되찾으면 반환할 대상은 duplicate이다.

pairs.true: Retired status does not remove the Board's disciplinary authority over relevant conduct.
pairs.false: Retirement prevents the Board from addressing prior professional misconduct.
pairs.reason_ko: 은퇴가 Board의 관련 징계 관할을 없애지 않는다.

pairs.true: The retirement pathway concerns permanent retirement from active practice in all jurisdictions.
pairs.false: Retired Massachusetts status is intended for continued active practice in another state.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 retired 경로의 의사는 MA뿐 아니라 다른 관할의 active practice 은퇴도 포함한다.

title: Annual CE allocation
case_a: A pharmacist without an exemption completes 40 accepted CE hours in one calendar year and none in the next, then attests to meeting the Massachusetts renewal requirements.
case_b: A pharmacist completes more than the minimum this year and wants to assign the excess hours to next year's annual requirement.

pairs.true: The annual minimum must be met in each calendar year, not merely in the biennial total.
pairs.false: Completing the biennial total in one year satisfies both annual requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: 연간 20시간과 2년 합계 40시간을 함께 충족해야 한다.

pairs.true: Excess hours cannot simply be carried forward to the next calendar year.
pairs.false: Excess annual hours automatically become next year's first CE credits.
pairs.reason_ko: 다음 calendar year로 carry over할 수 없다.

pairs.true: The ordinary annual completion deadline is December 31 unless an applicable exception applies.
pairs.false: The ordinary annual completion deadline is the date the employer reviews the file.
pairs.reason_ko: 일반 연간 기한과 고용주의 내부 점검일은 다르다.

pairs.true: A live law hour may meet category requirements without becoming two total hours.
pairs.false: One live law hour counts as two hours toward the overall annual total.
pairs.reason_ko: 동시 category 충족과 총 시간 이중 계산은 다르다.

title: Live and law CE
case_a: A pharmacist presents an annual CE record with 20 accepted hours, of which only three are live. Several home-study hours address federal pharmacy law.
case_b: A pharmacist rejects a live federal-law course from the law category solely because it is not Massachusetts-specific.

pairs.true: The current policy requires at least five live contact hours each calendar year.
pairs.false: Any 20 accepted hours satisfy the annual requirement regardless of live participation.
pairs.reason_ko: 현재 policy는 매년 최소 live 5시간을 요구한다.

pairs.true: Pharmacy-law CE need not be Massachusetts-specific to satisfy the stated law category.
pairs.false: Only a Massachusetts-statute course can satisfy the pharmacy-law category.
pairs.reason_ko: 법 CE가 반드시 MA-specific이어야 한다는 조건은 없다.

pairs.true: The law category requires at least two contact hours annually under the current policy.
pairs.false: The law category requires two hours only across the entire two-year renewal cycle.
pairs.reason_ko: law 2시간도 current policy의 매년 요건이다.

pairs.true: Law CE does not have to be live, although accepted live law can meet both categories.
pairs.false: The pharmacy-law requirement must be completed entirely through live programming.
pairs.reason_ko: law와 live는 서로 겹칠 수 있지만 동일 요건은 아니다.

title: CE daily credit and home-study limits
case_a: A pharmacist attends ten hours of otherwise acceptable CE on a single day and claims all ten toward the Massachusetts annual requirement.
case_b: Another pharmacist completed 18 hours of home study plus five live hours. The reviewer must distinguish attendance from the credits counted toward the annual minimum.

pairs.true: No more than eight contact hours may be claimed for a single calendar day.
pairs.false: All hours attended on one day may be claimed if the sponsor is ACPE-accredited.
pairs.reason_ko: 인정 provider라도 하루 인정 상한 8시간을 없애지 않는다.

pairs.true: Taking extra home study is different from counting it toward the required minimum.
pairs.false: Attending a sixteenth home-study hour is itself prohibited conduct.
pairs.reason_ko: home-study 15시간은 최소 20시간에 산입하는 한도이지 추가 수강 금지가 아니다.

pairs.true: The annual live requirement remains relevant even when total attendance exceeds 20 hours.
pairs.false: Extra home-study attendance replaces any missing live hours on a one-for-one basis.
pairs.reason_ko: 총 수강량이 많아도 live 최소치를 대체하지 못한다.

pairs.true: Category overlap does not multiply the actual duration credited for a course.
pairs.false: A course covering two required subjects earns twice its actual contact time.
pairs.reason_ko: 동일 강의가 여러 category에 해당해도 실제 시간을 두 배로 늘리지 않는다.

title: Graduation and transfer CE exceptions
case_a: A pharmacist graduated from an ACPE-accredited school several years ago and transfers a license to Massachusetts on October 12. The pharmacist assumes the entire new-license year is CE-exempt.
case_b: A recent graduate and a late-year transfer pharmacist compare the graduation-year exemption with the October 1 grace-period rule.

pairs.true: A past graduation-year exemption does not move forward to the later transfer year.
pairs.false: Every first Massachusetts licensing year receives the graduation-year CE exemption.
pairs.reason_ko: 졸업 연도 면제를 몇 년 뒤 면허 이전 연도로 옮기지 않는다.

pairs.true: A qualifying October 1-or-later licensee has until April 30 of the next year for the prior year's required hours.
pairs.false: The October 1 rule permanently removes the prior year's CE requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 경로는 면제가 아니라 다음 해 4월 30일까지의 완료기한 연장이다.

pairs.true: The graduation-year exemption concerns the calendar year of graduation from the specified accredited school.
pairs.false: The graduation-year exemption begins on the date of the first employer orientation.
pairs.reason_ko: 졸업 calendar year와 채용·orientation 날짜는 다르다.

pairs.true: Credits assigned to the grace-period obligation must be distinguished from the new year's own requirement.
pairs.false: The same grace-period hours automatically satisfy both calendar years in full.
pairs.reason_ko: 같은 수강 시간을 두 해 총 요건에 임의로 중복 산입하지 않는다.

title: Failure to complete CE
case_a: A pharmacist realizes before renewal that required CE hours are missing and looks for the notice method described in the currently posted CE policy.
case_b: After notifying the Massachusetts Board about missing hours, the pharmacist assumes the deficiency has been waived without a Board decision.

pairs.true: The current policy directs the pharmacist to email a detailed explanatory statement to the Board.
pairs.false: The current policy resolves missing CE by notifying the employer instead of the Board.
pairs.reason_ko: 현재 Policy 2021-04의 통지는 상세 사유 statement를 Board에 email하는 방식이다.

pairs.true: Sending an explanation does not itself waive the missing CE requirement.
pairs.false: Sending the explanatory email automatically waives the remaining hours.
pairs.reason_ko: email 발송과 waiver 승인·요건 충족은 별개다.

pairs.true: The CE notice method does not eliminate unrelated mandatory-disclosure duties.
pairs.false: The CE email instruction abolishes all mandatory-disclosure requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: 이 교정은 CE 통지 방식에 한정되며 다른 보고 의무를 폐지하지 않는다.

pairs.true: A renewal attestation must accurately reflect compliance rather than conceal a known deficiency.
pairs.false: A pharmacist may attest to compliance once a future CE course has been booked.
pairs.reason_ko: 미래 강의 예약은 현재의 미충족을 충족으로 바꾸지 않는다.

title: Immunization and CDTM CE
case_a: A pharmacist directly supervises vaccination but does not personally give injections. The pharmacist also practices under an active CDTM agreement.
case_b: The same pharmacist has two different CDTM clinical practice areas and asks how the additional annual-hours requirement is applied.

pairs.true: Direct supervision of immunizing activity triggers the policy's annual immunization CE requirement.
pairs.false: Only pharmacists who personally give injections need immunization CE.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 접종자뿐 아니라 immunizing activity의 직접 감독자도 annual 1시간 대상이다.

pairs.true: The stated CDTM minimum is five additional hours, for a total of 25 annually.
pairs.false: Each additional CDTM agreement automatically adds another mandatory five hours to the minimum.
pairs.reason_ko: 현재 policy의 기본 총 minimum은 25시간이며 여러 분야별 추가 교육은 권고와 구분한다.

pairs.true: The CDTM additional hours must address areas generally related to the agreement.
pairs.false: Unrelated CE can replace all of the agreement-related additional CDTM hours.
pairs.reason_ko: 추가 5시간은 협약의 practice area와 일반적으로 관련되어야 한다.

pairs.true: Immunization CE is distinct from initial immunizer training.
pairs.false: Completing initial immunizer training eliminates subsequent annual immunization CE.
pairs.reason_ko: 초기 교육과 매년 유지교육은 서로 다른 요건이다.

title: Compounding CE duties
case_a: A pharmacist only performs final verification of sterile preparations during a temporary assignment and does not physically compound them.
case_b: A pharmacist verifies complex nonsterile preparations and tries to count a general hazardous-drug course with no sterile or nonsterile compounding focus toward the specialized requirement.

pairs.true: Final verification of finished sterile preparations can trigger the five-hour annual sterile CE requirement.
pairs.false: Sterile CE applies only to pharmacists who physically mix the ingredients.
pairs.reason_ko: 최종 검수·감독·oversight도 해당 sterile CE trigger가 된다.

pairs.true: A generic USP 800 course is not automatically acceptable as the specified compounding CE.
pairs.false: Any course mentioning hazardous drugs automatically meets sterile and nonsterile CE criteria.
pairs.reason_ko: current policy의 해당 compounding content·keyword 조건을 확인해야 한다.

pairs.true: The complex-nonsterile category requires three annual hours for the specified duties.
pairs.false: Complex-nonsterile duties use the same five-hour requirement as sterile duties.
pairs.reason_ko: complex CNSP의 연간 3시간과 sterile 5시간을 구별한다.

pairs.true: The qualifying compounding hours may count toward the general annual 20 hours.
pairs.false: Compounding hours must always be added above the general annual 20 hours.
pairs.reason_ko: compounding CE는 general 20에 산입 가능하며 CDTM additional 구조와 다르다.

title: CE evidence and approved credit
case_a: A pharmacist has acceptable non-ACPE credits that do not appear in CPE Monitor and discards the course certificates after renewal.
case_b: An instructor teaches the same Board-approved CE program repeatedly in one year and requests a fresh instructor credit for every presentation.

pairs.true: Required documentation must be retained for acceptable credits not shown in CPE Monitor.
pairs.false: Credits absent from CPE Monitor require no evidence once renewal is accepted.
pairs.reason_ko: non-ACPE/IPCE 중 CPE Monitor에 없는 credit은 적절한 증빙을 보존한다.

pairs.true: The stated instructor-credit route allows credit once annually for that program.
pairs.false: Each repeat presentation of the same program earns new instructor CE credit that year.
pairs.reason_ko: 동일 프로그램의 instructor credit은 연간 한 번 경로와 반복 강의를 구분한다.

pairs.true: Evidence should identify the participant, activity, provider, completion, hours, and required credit details.
pairs.false: A payment receipt without activity or completion information is sufficient CE evidence.
pairs.reason_ko: 결제영수증만으로 과정·수료·시간·형태 등 필수 증빙을 대체하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Applicable record-retention rules continue after the renewal transaction.
pairs.false: Renewal approval authorizes immediate disposal of all supporting CE records.
pairs.reason_ko: 갱신 완료와 CE 증빙 보존 의무는 별개다.

title: License, certification, and role
case_a: A nationally certified technician moves to Massachusetts but has not yet obtained a Massachusetts technician license. The pharmacy schedules dispensing support work immediately.
case_b: A manager labels a licensed technician as a pharmacist intern because the technician plans to enter pharmacy school next year.

pairs.true: National certification does not replace the Massachusetts technician license.
pairs.false: Current national certification permits technician practice before state licensure.
pairs.reason_ko: national certification과 Board-issued license는 별개다.

pairs.true: Intern duties require the applicable intern licensure rather than an employer-assigned title.
pairs.false: An employer can create intern authority by changing the employee's job title.
pairs.reason_ko: 직함 변경·입학 계획은 MA intern license를 대신하지 않는다.

pairs.true: A trainee is a separately licensed training category with its own limitations.
pairs.false: A trainee may work without any Board license until the training is finished.
pairs.reason_ko: PTT도 시작 전 해당 Board license가 필요하다.

pairs.true: The pharmacist retains final dispensing validation responsibilities.
pairs.false: National technician certification transfers final dispensing validation to the technician.
pairs.reason_ko: CPhT 자격만으로 약사의 최종 검증 권한이 생기지 않는다.

title: Intern license and experiential hours
case_a: A pharmacy student begins a hospital rotation in Massachusetts without an intern license because the placement is arranged by an approved school.
case_b: An ACPE graduate has documented qualifying experiential hours and is told that all 1,500 hours must be repeated outside the degree program.

pairs.true: The Massachusetts intern license is required before the applicable internship begins, including hospital placements.
pairs.false: A school-arranged hospital rotation exempts a student from Massachusetts intern licensure.
pairs.reason_ko: school 또는 hospital placement라는 이유로 intern license 의무가 없어지지 않는다.

pairs.true: Qualifying ACPE experiential education can satisfy the specified internship pathway.
pairs.false: Every ACPE graduate must repeat 1,500 hours after graduation regardless of experiential credit.
pairs.reason_ko: 인정된 experiential education 경로가 있으며 무조건 졸업 후 재이수를 요구하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Internship credit is subject to the stated maximum of 12 hours per day.
pairs.false: A 14-hour internship shift necessarily earns 14 hours of Board credit.
pairs.reason_ko: 하루 internship credit 상한 12시간을 근무시간과 구분한다.

pairs.true: Out-of-state experience requires the specified evidence and Board recognition.
pairs.false: Any out-of-state employer's hour total is automatically accepted without evidence.
pairs.reason_ko: 타 관할 승인 증빙과 Board의 인정 절차를 확인한다.

title: Residency before Massachusetts pharmacist licensure
case_a: A PharmD graduate with an out-of-state pharmacist license begins a Massachusetts residency before the Massachusetts pharmacist license is issued.
case_b: A licensed intern withdraws from a PharmD program but does not notify the Board because the pharmacy employer already knows.

pairs.true: The graduate needs the appropriate Massachusetts intern status and pharmacist supervision while awaiting pharmacist licensure.
pairs.false: An out-of-state pharmacist license permits independent practice during the Massachusetts residency.
pairs.reason_ko: resident 직함·타 주 면허가 MA의 독립 약사 업무권한을 만들지 않는다.

pairs.true: Withdrawal from the program requires the stated written Board notice within 14 days.
pairs.false: Notice to the employer substitutes for the Board's program-withdrawal notice.
pairs.reason_ko: 학교 withdrawal의 14일 서면 Board 통지는 employer 통지와 다르다.

pairs.true: Graduation does not remove the limitations of the person's current intern role.
pairs.false: A graduate intern may perform independent final verification before pharmacist licensure.
pairs.reason_ko: 졸업과 면허 발급 사이에도 현재 intern 업무범위가 적용된다.

pairs.true: The intern's identification should accurately identify the pharmacy-intern role.
pairs.false: An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.
pairs.reason_ko: 명찰의 역할표시를 실제 면허와 다르게 사용하지 않는다.

title: Technician entry pathways
case_a: An 18-year-old applicant passes a listed national technician examination and assumes that no Massachusetts licensing application is needed.
case_b: A pharmacy uses the employer-training pathway after 500 trainee-employment hours and plans a 20-question competency examination.

pairs.true: A qualifying national examination supports a licensing pathway but does not itself issue the Board license.
pairs.false: Passing a qualifying national examination automatically issues the state technician license.
pairs.reason_ko: 시험 경로 적격성과 Board license 발급은 다른 단계다.

pairs.true: The specified employer competency examination requires at least 50 questions and a 75% passing standard.
pairs.false: A 20-question employer test satisfies the stated competency-examination minimum.
pairs.reason_ko: policy의 해당 competency exam은 최소 50문항·75% 기준이다.

pairs.true: The employer pathway requires the specified trainee employment before its examination route.
pairs.false: A promise to complete 500 trainee hours later satisfies the employer pathway now.
pairs.reason_ko: 최소 trainee employment를 미래 계획으로 대체하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The technician-examination percentage is not an MPJE raw-score passing formula.
pairs.false: The technician-examination 75% standard establishes the MPJE raw-score passing percentage.
pairs.reason_ko: technician 시험 기준과 MPJE 채점체계는 별개다.

title: Trainee licensing and duration
case_a: A 16-year-old is hired as a pharmacy technician trainee. The supervisor asks whether training may begin before the Massachusetts trainee license is issued.
case_b: An adult trainee reaches the ordinary one-year limit before reaching 1,500 employment hours and has no applicable exception or extension.

pairs.true: A trainee needs the Board-issued trainee license before starting the applicable work.
pairs.false: Training status permits an unlicensed start until the trainee reaches 500 hours.
pairs.reason_ko: PTT도 근무 시작 전에 별도 면허가 필요하다.

pairs.true: The ordinary duration ceiling is 1,500 hours or one year, whichever comes first, subject to specified exceptions.
pairs.false: The ordinary ceiling is whichever occurs later: one year or 1,500 hours.
pairs.reason_ko: 일반 ceiling은 먼저 도달하는 시점이며 예외·연장은 따로 확인한다.

pairs.true: The ordinary minimum age for the trainee category is 16.
pairs.false: The trainee category uses the same 18-year minimum as full technician licensure.
pairs.reason_ko: PTT 16세와 full technician 18세를 구분한다.

pairs.true: Trainee work remains subject to direct pharmacist supervision.
pairs.false: A trainee may work under remote telephone availability instead of the required direct supervision.
pairs.reason_ko: PTT의 direct supervision 조건을 단순 연락 가능으로 대체하지 않는다.

title: Trainee telephone limits
case_a: A prescriber calls with an unchanged refill authorization while the pharmacist is occupied. A technician trainee offers to receive the authorization.
case_b: A trainee is asked to telephone a prescriber and settle a dose discrepancy because the request seems routine.

pairs.true: The trainee is excluded from the permitted unchanged verbal-refill authorization role.
pairs.false: An unchanged refill may be received by a trainee because no new drug is ordered.
pairs.reason_ko: PTT는 unchanged verbal refill 수신 허용에서도 제외된다.

pairs.true: Clinical dose clarification remains outside technician-tier authority.
pairs.false: Calling the prescriber makes clinical dose clarification permissible trainee work.
pairs.reason_ko: 전화 업무라는 외형이 clinical judgment·clarification 권한을 부여하지 않는다.

pairs.true: A trained designee may make an offer of pharmacist counseling without providing the counseling itself.
pairs.false: A trainee who can offer counseling may independently provide the clinical counseling.
pairs.reason_ko: offer 전달과 실제 counseling은 구분한다.

pairs.true: Preparing permitted nondiscretionary information does not confer prescription-receiving authority.
pairs.false: Typing a proposed telephone order grants authority to accept it as a prescription.
pairs.reason_ko: 전산 입력 보조와 적법한 전화처방 수신 권한은 다르다.

title: Certification lapse
case_a: A technician's Massachusetts license remains active, but national certification expires. The technician continues using the CPhT title and is counted in a certified position for staffing.
case_b: The manager says no action is needed until the state technician license expires because national certification is a separate credential.

pairs.true: The technician must be treated within the ordinary technician duties and title while certification is lapsed.
pairs.false: An active state license preserves every certified-technician duty after certification lapses.
pairs.reason_ko: certification lapse 시 ordinary technician의 duties·title로 제한된다.

pairs.true: The lapse changes the qualified category used in the supervisory-ratio calculation.
pairs.false: The previous certified classification remains valid for ratio purposes until the next schedule is posted.
pairs.reason_ko: ratio는 실제 유효한 자격으로 계산한다.

pairs.true: The specified loss-of-certification reporting duty is separate from changing work assignments.
pairs.false: Changing work assignments eliminates any separate certification-loss report.
pairs.reason_ko: scope 조정과 Board 보고는 별도로 충족한다.

pairs.true: State-license expiration and national-certification lapse are distinct events.
pairs.false: A lapsed national certificate automatically makes the active state license a revoked license.
pairs.reason_ko: 서로 다른 자격의 만료를 자동 revocation으로 바꾸지 않는다.

title: Technician renewal calendar
case_a: A technician assumes that the Massachusetts license expires on the same December 31 cycle as the pharmacists in the pharmacy.
case_b: A technician sends a late renewal application after the birthday-based expiration and asks to continue working while it is processed.

pairs.true: The technician license uses the stated biennial birthday-based expiration.
pairs.false: The technician license expires on every even-numbered December 31.
pairs.reason_ko: technician는 2년마다 본인 birthdate 주기다.

pairs.true: A pending late renewal does not itself authorize practice under an expired license.
pairs.false: Submitting a late renewal automatically creates a temporary practice extension.
pairs.reason_ko: 만료 후 신청 중이라는 사실이 업무 허용은 아니다.

pairs.true: A lapse exceeding two years can involve additional Board conditions.
pairs.false: A lapse exceeding two years is resolved solely by an employer competency sign-off.
pairs.reason_ko: 장기 lapse의 Board 조건을 employer sign-off로 대체하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Renewal of national certification does not renew the state technician license.
pairs.false: Paying the national-certification renewal fee also renews the state technician license.
pairs.reason_ko: national certification과 state licensure 갱신을 각각 관리한다.

title: Ordinary technician refill authority
case_a: An ordinary licensed technician, not a trainee and not nationally certified, receives a prescriber's unchanged Schedule IV refill authorization with pharmacist approval.
case_b: During another refill call, the prescriber changes the dose. The ordinary technician treats the call as the same unchanged-refill task.

pairs.true: The permitted unchanged verbal-refill pathway includes an ordinary licensed technician with the required supervision and approval.
pairs.false: Only a nationally certified technician may receive any unchanged verbal-refill authorization.
pairs.reason_ko: PTT를 제외한 licensed technician의 unchanged III–VI refill 경로와 CPhT의 new Rx 경로를 구분한다.

pairs.true: A dose change is not an unchanged refill authorization.
pairs.false: A dose change remains an unchanged refill whenever the drug name is unchanged.
pairs.reason_ko: unchanged 판단은 drug name만 아니라 dose·directions 등 처방정보도 포함한다.

pairs.true: The permitted verbal-refill scope covers the specified Schedules III through VI.
pairs.false: The same refill authority extends to Schedule II because the prescriber called directly.
pairs.reason_ko: CII에는 refill이 없고 III–VI의 technician refill 권한을 확대하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Pharmacist supervision and the worker's actual licensed category remain relevant.
pairs.false: An employer's refill-call checklist independently grants the trainee the same authority.
pairs.reason_ko: 내부 checklist가 trainee의 금지 경계를 없애지 않는다.

title: Certified technician new verbal prescriptions
case_a: A nationally certified, Massachusetts-licensed technician is asked to receive a new Schedule III prescription under pharmacist supervision and approval.
case_b: A prescriber then telephones an emergency Schedule II authorization and asks the same technician to receive it because the pharmacist is busy.

pairs.true: The specified certified-technician scope includes new verbal Schedule III through VI prescriptions.
pairs.false: The certified-technician scope is limited to unchanged refills and excludes new verbal Schedule III prescriptions.
pairs.reason_ko: CPhT의 new III–VI verbal prescription 수신과 ordinary technician의 unchanged refill은 다르다.

pairs.true: Emergency oral Schedule II follows the practitioner-to-pharmacist authorization pathway.
pairs.false: Certification permits the technician to receive emergency oral Schedule II instead of the pharmacist.
pairs.reason_ko: emergency CII의 직접 수신 주체는 pharmacist이며 일반 전화권한을 복사하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The technician must hold both the required state license and qualifying certification.
pairs.false: National certification alone supplies the state authority to receive new prescriptions.
pairs.reason_ko: CPhT의 추가 scope에도 MA license가 필요하다.

pairs.true: Receiving a permitted order does not authorize clinical modification of it.
pairs.false: The right to receive a verbal order includes independent adjustment of its dose.
pairs.reason_ko: 수신 업무와 임상 판단·처방 변경 권한은 별개다.

title: Personnel and prescription transfers
case_a: A certified technician is asked, with pharmacist approval, to transfer remaining authorized refills of a Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription.
case_b: The same employee is asked to transfer a Schedule IV refill between two independent pharmacies and assumes the Schedule VI personnel rule also applies.

pairs.true: The specified certified-technician transfer authority is for Schedule VI prescriptions.
pairs.false: Certified-technician prescription-transfer authority applies to every schedule.
pairs.reason_ko: CPhT의 VI transfer 허용을 II–V로 확대하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The federal controlled-refill transfer requires the licensed-pharmacist communication pathway.
pairs.false: A certified technician may substitute for the pharmacists in every federal III–V refill transfer.
pairs.reason_ko: 연방 III–V refill transfer의 pharmacist-to-pharmacist 조건은 별개다.

pairs.true: Remaining authorization and prescription validity still constrain a permitted VI transfer.
pairs.false: A technician-performed VI transfer creates a fresh year of validity.
pairs.reason_ko: 담당자의 transfer 권한이 원 처방의 유효기간·잔량을 새로 만들지 않는다.

pairs.true: The patient's timely-transfer right does not expand the worker's professional scope.
pairs.false: An urgent patient request converts an ordinary technician into an authorized transfer pharmacist.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자 요청의 urgency가 면허 업무범위를 변경하지 않는다.

title: Final verification and clinical judgment
case_a: A pharmacy proposes that a highly experienced certified technician complete final patient-specific prescription validation after a barcode scan.
case_b: An intern under direct pharmacist supervision counsels a patient, while a technician offers to resolve a drug-interaction alert independently.

pairs.true: Final patient-specific dispensing validation remains the pharmacist's responsibility.
pairs.false: A successful barcode scan authorizes the technician to perform final dispensing validation.
pairs.reason_ko: 기술적 일치 확인은 pharmacist의 최종 법적·임상적 검수를 대신하지 않는다.

pairs.true: A properly supervised intern may counsel, but the technician may not independently resolve the clinical alert.
pairs.false: Interns and technicians have identical authority to resolve clinical alerts independently.
pairs.reason_ko: intern의 감독하 상담과 technician의 clinical judgment 금지를 구분한다.

pairs.true: An offer of counseling may be conveyed by a trained designee without delegating actual counseling.
pairs.false: Delegating the offer necessarily delegates the counseling itself.
pairs.reason_ko: offer와 actual counseling은 서로 다른 행위다.

pairs.true: Medication-history collection does not itself authorize assessment and therapy changes.
pairs.false: A certified technician's medication-history authority includes prescribing a replacement therapy.
pairs.reason_ko: 정보수집의 허용을 평가·치료변경으로 확대하지 않는다.

title: Schedule II handling versus completed-package transport
case_a: An ordinary licensed technician delivers an already filled and pharmacist-verified Schedule II prescription to the designated pickup area.
case_b: The manager treats this transport task as authority for the same ordinary technician to perform unrestricted Schedule II vault work.

pairs.true: Transport of a completed, verified prescription is different from handling unprepared Schedule II stock.
pairs.false: Delivering a verified Schedule II bag establishes unrestricted Schedule II stock-handling authority.
pairs.reason_ko: 완료·검수된 처방 운반과 미조제 CII stock handling은 다르다.

pairs.true: Broader Schedule II handling has the specified certified-technician and supervision limitations.
pairs.false: Every licensed technician has the same Schedule II handling authority regardless of certification.
pairs.reason_ko: ordinary technician와 CPhT의 CII handling 범위를 구분한다.

pairs.true: The supervising pharmacist retains direct accountability for security and controlled-drug work.
pairs.false: Delegating permitted handling transfers the pharmacist's security responsibility to the technician.
pairs.reason_ko: 업무 일부의 위임이 pharmacist의 법적 accountability를 없애지 않는다.

pairs.true: A medication's restricted formulation can matter even within Schedule II.
pairs.false: All Schedule II formulations necessarily have identical technician-handling permissions.
pairs.reason_ko: policy의 hydrocodone-only 비abuse-deterrent ER 등 formulation 예외를 유지한다.

title: Counting, entering, and adjusting inventory
case_a: Two licensed nationally certified technicians perform a Schedule II perpetual-inventory count under the specified pharmacist verification arrangement.
case_b: One technician finds a discrepancy and edits the balance without involving the MOR or the designated pharmacist.

pairs.true: The permitted paired-technician count still requires the supervising pharmacist's verification.
pairs.false: Using two certified technicians removes the required pharmacist verification of the count.
pairs.reason_ko: 허용된 두 CPhT count 경로에도 pharmacist verification이 남는다.

pairs.true: A discrepancy adjustment follows the MOR or authorized pharmacist-designee pathway.
pairs.false: Authority to enter routine transactions includes independent authority to erase unexplained discrepancies.
pairs.reason_ko: routine entry와 discrepancy adjustment 권한을 분리한다.

pairs.true: A certified technician may make permitted perpetual-inventory entries.
pairs.false: Only an unlicensed inventory vendor may make routine electronic inventory entries.
pairs.reason_ko: CPhT의 허용 entry와 unlicensed 인력의 금지를 구분한다.

pairs.true: An unexplained difference requires investigation rather than a silent numerical correction.
pairs.false: Matching the electronic total to the count completes the required discrepancy investigation.
pairs.reason_ko: 숫자를 맞추는 조작만으로 원인 조사·보고 판단이 완료되지 않는다.

title: Standard one-to-four staffing
case_a: One pharmacist is scheduled with four prescription-filling support personnel: one certified technician, one intern, and two ordinary technicians.
case_b: The scheduler substitutes an ordinary technician for the intern, leaving one certified technician and three ordinary technicians in the four-person group.

pairs.true: The first group satisfies a listed one-to-four qualifying-category combination.
pairs.false: Four support personnel are permitted without regard to the workers' qualifying categories.
pairs.reason_ko: 1:4의 headcount뿐 아니라 one CPhT+one intern 등 qualifying 조합을 충족해야 한다.

pairs.true: One certified technician with three ordinary technicians does not satisfy the stated one-to-four combinations.
pairs.false: Any single certified technician qualifies a four-person support group.
pairs.reason_ko: 1:4에 one CPhT만으로는 해당 qualifying 조합이 아니다.

pairs.true: Two certified technicians can satisfy the qualifying component of a four-person group.
pairs.false: The one-to-four rule requires an intern even when two certified technicians are present.
pairs.reason_ko: two CPhT 경로는 별도의 허용 조합이다.

pairs.true: Meeting the staffing ratio does not grant a worker additional clinical duties.
pairs.false: A compliant one-to-four ratio permits ordinary technicians to perform final verification.
pairs.reason_ko: ratio 적합성과 각 인력의 업무범위는 별개다.

title: Standard one-to-three staffing
case_a: One pharmacist supervises three ordinary technicians who assist with prescription preparation. No intern or certified technician is in the group.
case_b: One of the ordinary technicians is replaced by a licensed intern. The manager reviews both the staffing ratio and the intern's permitted tasks.

pairs.true: The stated one-to-three pathway requires at least one intern or certified technician.
pairs.false: Three ordinary technicians satisfy the one-to-three qualifying-category condition.
pairs.reason_ko: 1:3도 최소 one intern 또는 CPhT 조건이 있다.

pairs.true: A qualifying licensed intern can satisfy that category component without changing the other workers' scope.
pairs.false: Adding an intern allows the ordinary technicians to perform the intern's clinical duties.
pairs.reason_ko: qualifying 인력 추가가 다른 사람의 scope를 바꾸지 않는다.

pairs.true: Expired certification cannot be counted as a currently certified staffing position.
pairs.false: The original hiring credential remains sufficient after certification expires.
pairs.reason_ko: ratio는 현재 유효한 자격으로 계산한다.

pairs.true: Personnel who actually assist professional filling must be classified under the applicable ratio.
pairs.false: Calling a filling technician an inventory specialist automatically removes the person from the ratio.
pairs.reason_ko: 업무 명칭보다 실제 수행 역할이 ratio 판단의 기준이다.

title: Vaccination-service staffing
case_a: A pharmacy providing vaccination services schedules one pharmacist with six support personnel, including two certified technicians and one intern.
case_b: The manager proposes using three interns and no certified technicians as the three qualifying personnel for the vaccination-service exception.

pairs.true: The stated vaccination-service pathway permits up to six support personnel when its conditions are met.
pairs.false: The six-person pathway applies to every pharmacy regardless of vaccination services.
pairs.reason_ko: 1:6은 vaccination-service 조건부 경로다.

pairs.true: No more than two interns may count toward the required three-person qualifying group.
pairs.false: Three interns with no certified technicians satisfy the required three-person qualifying group.
pairs.reason_ko: qualifying group에는 interns 최대 두 명이라는 경계가 있다.

pairs.true: Separate intern-supervision restrictions still need to be checked.
pairs.false: The one-to-six pathway removes all separate intern-supervision limits.
pairs.reason_ko: staffing ratio와 intern supervision 제한은 각각 확인한다.

pairs.true: The required qualified personnel must have current licenses and applicable certifications.
pairs.false: A promised future certification may count toward today's qualifying group.
pairs.reason_ko: 미래 자격취득 계획은 현재 ratio 요건을 충족하지 않는다.

title: Ratio exclusions and actual duties
case_a: A licensed worker only places pharmacist-verified compliance packages into delivery totes and is identified by role on the posted schedule.
case_b: An unlicensed cashier is excluded from the staffing ratio and then starts selecting stock bottles to assist prescription filling.

pairs.true: The specified non-professional-support role may be excluded from the ratio with the required schedule identification.
pairs.false: Every licensed employee on the premises must count in the prescription-filling ratio regardless of role.
pairs.reason_ko: policy가 지정한 실제 non-support 역할과 게시 schedule 조건을 확인한다.

pairs.true: The cashier's exclusion from the ratio does not authorize professional filling assistance.
pairs.false: Being excluded from the ratio permits the cashier to select stock medications for prescriptions.
pairs.reason_ko: ratio 제외는 pharmacy 전문업무 허용이 아니다.

pairs.true: The exclusion depends on what the person actually does, not merely the assigned title.
pairs.false: Writing non-ratio beside a name permits unrestricted prescription preparation.
pairs.reason_ko: label이나 title이 실제 업무·자격 제한을 없애지 않는다.

pairs.true: Names and roles of the specified excluded licensees belong on the posted schedule.
pairs.false: The role-based exclusion eliminates any schedule-identification requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 licensed 인력 제외에도 이름·역할 게시 조건이 남는다.

title: Direct intern supervision
case_a: An intern's usual preceptor is absent. Another pharmacist is present, aware of the intern's work, and immediately available to direct it.
case_b: A manager wants to replace the on-premises direct-supervision arrangement with a pharmacist available only by an occasional telephone call.

pairs.true: Another pharmacist must directly supervise the intern when the preceptor is unavailable.
pairs.false: The intern may practice independently whenever the named preceptor is unavailable.
pairs.reason_ko: preceptor 부재 시 다른 pharmacist의 직접 감독이 필요하다.

pairs.true: The ordinary direct-supervision definition includes contemporaneous direction by an on-premises pharmacist.
pairs.false: Telephone reachability alone meets the ordinary on-premises direct-supervision definition.
pairs.reason_ko: 일반 direct supervision의 현장성·동시 관찰·지시 조건을 단순 연락 가능으로 줄이지 않는다.

pairs.true: The ordinary regulatory maximum is two interns directly supervised by one preceptor.
pairs.false: The ordinary retail-filling maximum is four interns because a special clinic exception exists.
pairs.reason_ko: 일반 two intern과 한정 four intern 예외를 구분한다.

pairs.true: An authorized remote-processing pathway must be evaluated separately.
pairs.false: Every intern duty becomes remote-authorized once remote processing is allowed.
pairs.reason_ko: 특정 remote-processing 허용이 모든 업무의 현장 감독을 없애지 않는다.

title: Limited four-intern pathways
case_a: A preceptor conducts an exclusively immunization clinic and considers the policy's limited authorization to supervise up to four interns.
case_b: The same preceptor moves four interns into an ordinary retail prescription-filling shift and assumes the clinic limit continues unchanged.

pairs.true: The policy describes a limited up-to-four-intern pathway for exclusively immunization clinics.
pairs.false: The clinic pathway automatically changes ordinary retail intern supervision to four.
pairs.reason_ko: exclusively immunization clinic의 한정 예외를 일반 retail에 옮기지 않는다.

pairs.true: Ordinary retail filling must be checked against its own intern-supervision limitations.
pairs.false: Calling a retail shift a clinic removes ordinary filling-supervision restrictions.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 activity·setting을 기준으로 해당 예외의 적격성을 확인한다.

pairs.true: Another limited four-intern route concerns specified non-pharmacy, non-filling activities without the stated patient-safety risk.
pairs.false: Any off-site activity qualifies for four interns even when it includes unsupervised patient treatment.
pairs.reason_ko: 다른 four-intern 경로의 업무·환자안전 조건을 삭제하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Patient or practitioner consultations require the preceptor's specified active presence.
pairs.false: Intern consultations are excluded from supervision merely because no drug is handed over.
pairs.reason_ko: 조제·교부가 없더라도 상담·추천의 active-presence 조건이 있다.

title: Dedicated trainer and trainee
case_a: A dedicated trainer directly oversees a licensed trainee and performs no independent professional support outside that training relationship.
case_b: The trainee is already nationally certified, so the manager counts the trainee as a certified qualifying position during the designated training period.

pairs.true: The trainer can be excluded from the ratio only while the dedicated-training conditions are met.
pairs.false: A trainer badge permits ratio exclusion while the trainer also independently fills prescriptions.
pairs.reason_ko: trainer의 별도 professional support가 없다는 조건을 유지한다.

pairs.true: The dedicated trainee is counted as an ordinary pharmacy technician for this staffing calculation.
pairs.false: An already certified trainee must count as a certified qualifying position during dedicated training.
pairs.reason_ko: dedicated training의 ratio category는 기존 intern·CPhT 자격과 별도로 ordinary technician이다.

pairs.true: The trainee may not act independently of the dedicated trainer.

pairs.reason_ko: Board의 regulation waiver로 연방법·상위법을 임의로 없앨 수 없다.

pairs.true: The petition must address compelling public interest, burden or impracticality, and adequate safeguards.
pairs.false: Cost savings alone automatically establish all waiver criteria.
pairs.reason_ko: 세요소와 충분한public-healthsafeguards를 근거로 제시한다.

pairs.true: The stated post-June-2013 waiver framework ordinarily expires on the fifth anniversary of the grant.
pairs.false: A granted waiver lasts for the lifetime of the pharmacy without an expiration review.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당5주년만료경로와 새waiver없이 원규정준수 의무를 구분한다.

title: Different sources of pharmacist authority
case_a: A pharmacist dispenses naloxone under a statewide standing order and assumes that this creates the same authority as an individualized CDTM agreement.
case_b: A pharmacy sells an approved OTC contraceptive and interprets that sale as evidence that every pharmacist may independently prescribe all contraceptive formulations.

pairs.true: A standing-order dispensing pathway is distinct from patient-specific CDTM authority.
pairs.false: Dispensing under a statewide standing order automatically creates a CDTM agreement.
pairs.reason_ko: Standing order, CDTM, 개별 statutory prescribing는 서로 다른 권한의 출처다.

pairs.true: An OTC product's purchase pathway does not define a pharmacist's independent prescribing scope.
pairs.false: OTC sale of one contraceptive authorizes independent prescribing of all contraceptive formulations.
pairs.reason_ko: OTC 분류와 pharmacist의 prescriptive scope를 구분한다.

pairs.true: Medication administration is a separate act from prescribing or dispensing.
pairs.false: Permission to prescribe a product automatically grants permission to administer it by any route.
pairs.reason_ko: Prescribe, dispense, administer의 권한을 각각 확인한다.

pairs.true: A CDTM arrangement needs the specified individual, setting, agreement, and patient authorization.
pairs.false: A pharmacy's facility license by itself supplies all CDTM authority.
pairs.reason_ko: 시설 면허 하나로 개인의 자격, CPA, 환자별 authorization을 대체하지 않는다.

title: CDTM pharmacist licensure and insurance
case_a: A pharmacist with an unrestricted out-of-state license, but no Massachusetts pharmacist license, is proposed as the pharmacist on a Massachusetts CDTM agreement.
case_b: A Massachusetts pharmacist's general employer insurance does not specifically cover drug-therapy management, but the pharmacist assumes it satisfies the CDTM requirement.

pairs.true: The CDTM pharmacist needs the specified current unrestricted Massachusetts license in good standing.
pairs.false: An unrestricted license from any state substitutes for Massachusetts CDTM licensure.
pairs.reason_ko: 현재 유효한 unrestricted Massachusetts license와 good standing 요건을 확인한다.

pairs.true: The required liability coverage must specifically cover drug-therapy management at the stated minimum.
pairs.false: Any general employer insurance satisfies CDTM liability coverage regardless of its scope.
pairs.reason_ko: Drug-therapy management를 보장하는 보험을 occurrence당 최소 100만 달러 유지하는 조건이다.

pairs.true: The pharmacist must be engaged in the required Massachusetts pharmacy practice.
pairs.false: A proposed future Massachusetts job alone satisfies the current-practice requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: 현재 Massachusetts에서 practice하는 조건과 미래의 고용 계획은 다르다.

pairs.true: Coverage must be maintained during the agreement rather than checked only at hiring.
pairs.false: Insurance is needed only on the day the first agreement is signed.
pairs.reason_ko: CPA가 유지되는 동안 필요한 보험 보장을 유지한다.

title: CDTM experience and grandfather provision
case_a: A recently graduated PharmD proposes joining a new CDTM agreement in 2026 by relying solely on the old PharmD grandfather language.
case_b: The employer says that any five years in a drug-related business automatically equals the specified licensed-pharmacist experience.

pairs.true: The dated grandfather provision cannot be newly invoked solely because the applicant now has a PharmD.
pairs.false: A current PharmD degree automatically qualifies every new 2026 CDTM applicant under the grandfather clause.
pairs.reason_ko: PharmD 학위와 2017년 6월 30일 또는 그 이전의 CPA 참여 조건을 분리하지 않는다.

pairs.true: General drug-related employment does not automatically establish the specified licensed-pharmacist experience.
pairs.false: Any drug-company employment automatically counts as licensed pharmacist practice for CDTM.
pairs.reason_ko: 일반 산업 경력과 자격 규정상 licensed pharmacist experience의 인정은 별개다.

pairs.true: Board-recognized equivalent education or residency pathways must meet their own conditions.
pairs.false: An employer may declare any training program legally equivalent without Board criteria.
pairs.reason_ko: Board가 인정하는 equivalency를 고용주가 임의로 만들 수 없다.

pairs.true: The pharmacist's practice must include the co-managed therapy area as required.
pairs.false: CDTM qualification is independent of any actual practice in the co-managed therapy area.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제로 공동 관리하는 치료 영역에 자신의 practice 일부를 투입해야 한다.

title: Educational equivalency pathways
case_a: A pharmacist finishes an ASHP-accredited PGY-1 and assumes that residency completion alone meets every CDTM experience-equivalency condition.
case_b: A site uses a supervised-CDTM equivalency route without a written monitoring method or records of the supervised work.

pairs.true: The PGY-1 pathway includes the specified additional experience or supervised CDTM period.
pairs.false: PGY-1 completion alone necessarily completes the entire stated equivalency pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: PGY-1 이후 2년의 practice 또는 지정된 12개월 supervised CDTM 경로를 구분한다.

pairs.true: The supervised route requires the specified monitoring policy and records.
pairs.false: A verbal statement that supervision occurred replaces the required monitoring records.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 시설의 written monitoring policy/procedure와 증빙이 필요하다.

pairs.true: Current BPS certification is a described alternative equivalency route.
pairs.false: An expired BPS certificate is identical to a current certification for this pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 현재 유효한 BPS certification과 이미 만료된 과거 자격은 다르다.

pairs.true: Site credentialing and the other CDTM qualifications remain applicable.
pairs.false: An equivalency pathway waives the separate license, insurance, and site-credentialing requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: 교육·경력 equivalency가 나머지 자격 요건을 면제하지는 않는다.

title: CDTM maintenance of competence
case_a: A pharmacist maintains a CDTM agreement but completes only the general 20 annual CE hours, with no additional agreement-related hours.
case_b: The pharmacist later obtains prescribing authority under the agreement and overlooks the separate periodic pain-management training requirement.

pairs.true: The CDTM framework adds at least five relevant hours to the general annual requirement.
pairs.false: The CDTM framework permits its five additional hours to replace five of the general 20.
pairs.reason_ko: CDTM의 CE는 일반 20시간에 5시간을 추가하는 연간 총 25시간 구조다.

pairs.true: Prescribing CDTM pharmacists have a separate stated pain-management training obligation.
pairs.false: CDTM prescribing authority eliminates all periodic pain-management training requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: Prescriptive authority가 있으면 해당 2년마다 최소 1시간의 pain-management training 조건도 확인한다.

pairs.true: Accepted pain-management CE may contribute to the additional five hours when its conditions are met.
pairs.false: Pain-management training can never contribute to the additional CDTM hours.
pairs.reason_ko: 인정되는 CE credit이면 추가 5시간에 산입할 수 있는 경로를 구분한다.

pairs.true: Relevant CE evidence must be retained under the applicable agreement and CE-record rules.
pairs.false: Ending the year's CE courses permits immediate disposal of all agreement-related evidence.
pairs.reason_ko: CPA 관련 CE 증빙 보존과 일반 CE 보존 의무를 각각 충족한다.

title: CDTM prescribing registration and participation
case_a: A qualified pharmacist adds prescribing to a CDTM agreement and assumes the agreement replaces any applicable controlled-substance registration requirements.
case_b: The pharmacist compares CDTM's MassHealth participation-or-application attestation with a different prescribing circular that merely encourages enrollment.

pairs.true: Applicable MCSR and federal registration requirements must be considered separately from the CPA.
pairs.false: A signed CPA replaces the applicable MCSR and DEA registration requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: CPA와 필요한 등록은 서로 다른 권한의 층이다.

pairs.true: A mandatory CDTM attestation is not converted to a recommendation by language in another prescribing pathway.
pairs.false: An encouraged-enrollment statement in another pathway removes CDTM's attestation requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: CDTM의 participation/application attestation과 다른 circular의 encouraged 표현을 구분한다.

pairs.true: Retail Schedule II–V prescribing restrictions remain despite a CPA.
pairs.false: Any CPA grants retail authority to prescribe Schedule II–V drugs.
pairs.reason_ko: Retail CPA의 문구로 Schedule II–V prescribing 금지를 없앨 수 없다.

pairs.true: Practice restriction or discipline requires the specified communication to supervising physicians.
pairs.false: Reporting a restriction to the Board necessarily replaces notice to every supervising physician.
pairs.reason_ko: Board에 대한 보고와 CPA 상대방에게 하는 서면 통지는 별도 의무다.

title: CDTM practice-setting approval
case_a: A pharmacist qualified individually for CDTM begins services at a new practice site without obtaining the site's required approval.
case_b: A community pharmacy assumes that every authority available in a hospital CDTM setting transfers unchanged to retail practice.

pairs.true: Individual qualification does not replace the required practice-setting approval.
pairs.false: Once a pharmacist qualifies, no practice-setting approval is needed.
pairs.reason_ko: 개인 자격과 해당 practice setting의 승인을 각각 충족한다.

pairs.true: Retail-specific restrictions cannot be removed by borrowing an institutional pathway.
pairs.false: Hospital CDTM authority automatically defines the full scope of a retail CPA.
pairs.reason_ko: Institutional setting의 허용 범위를 retail에 그대로 옮기지 않는다.

pairs.true: Hospitals and LTCFs have specified but different approval structures.
pairs.false: The pharmacy employer's human-resources approval substitutes for every setting's medical approval.
pairs.reason_ko: Hospital medical staff와 LTC medical director 등 해당 setting의 승인 구조를 확인한다.

pairs.true: A signed current CPA and applicable patient authorization are still needed.
pairs.false: Facility approval alone permits management of any patient without a CPA or referral conditions.
pairs.reason_ko: 시설 승인 하나로 서명된 agreement와 환자별 조건을 대체하지 않는다.

title: Retail CDTM referral and adult patient
case_a: A retail pharmacist proposes independently diagnosing a 17-year-old's condition and enrolling the patient in the ordinary retail CDTM pathway.
case_b: For an adult patient, the physician sends a referral without identifying the primary and secondary diagnoses to be co-managed.

pairs.true: The described retail pathway requires an adult patient and the specified physician referral.
pairs.false: The retail CDTM pathway authorizes pharmacist diagnosis of any patient, including minors.
pairs.reason_ko: Retail 경로에는 18세 이상 환자, physician의 written referral, 진단 지정이 필요하다.

pairs.true: The referral must identify the relevant primary and secondary diagnoses as required.
pairs.false: The pharmacist may replace missing referral diagnoses with independent new diagnoses.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자별 primary·secondary diagnosis의 지정은 physician referral의 요소다.

pairs.true: The patient receives a copy of the written referral under the stated process.
pairs.false: The referral must remain solely between professionals and cannot be given to the patient.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 환자에게 referral 사본을 제공한다.

pairs.true: A separate minor-prescribing statute does not rewrite the ordinary retail CDTM age criterion.
pairs.false: Any minor-consent exception automatically removes the retail CDTM adult-patient requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: 다른 처방권한 경로의 연령·동의 규칙을 retail CDTM에 혼합하지 않는다.

title: Consent copy and communication clocks
case_a: A physician obtains written informed consent for retail CDTM but retains the only copy and does not send the pharmacist a copy.
case_b: Later, the pharmacist issues a therapy modification and assumes the earlier consent-copy delivery already satisfied the new communication requirement.

pairs.true: The stated process requires a consent copy to reach the pharmacist within 24 hours.
pairs.false: The pharmacist's consent copy can wait until the next biennial CPA renewal.
pairs.reason_ko: Consent 사본 전달의 24시간을 CPA 갱신 주기와 구분한다.

pairs.true: A new prescription or therapy change has its own physician-communication clock.
pairs.false: Delivering consent once satisfies all future prescription-change communications.
pairs.reason_ko: Consent 수령과 새로운 처방·변경의 issuance는 서로 다른 시간의 시작점이다.

pairs.true: The physician retains the original consent and both parties maintain the required records.
pairs.false: Neither party needs consent records after the first prescription is dispensed.
pairs.reason_ko: 원본과 사본의 보관 위치 및 양측의 기록 의무를 유지한다.

pairs.true: The patient is provided the applicable written informed-consent copy.
pairs.false: Patient consent is complete only if the patient is denied a copy.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자에게 사본을 제공하는 의무를 반대로 해석하지 않는다.

title: Retail extension of current therapy
case_a: A retail CDTM pharmacist considers extending a patient's established Schedule VI therapy under the physician's authorization and individually developed CPA guidelines.
case_b: The pharmacist wants to use this pathway as a general emergency-refill authority for unrelated patients who have no CDTM referral.

pairs.true: The described extension depends on the physician authorization and applicable CPA guidelines.
pairs.false: Any pharmacist may use the CDTM extension without a physician agreement.
pairs.reason_ko: CDTM therapy extension은 적격 pharmacist, CPA, physician authorization에 기반한다.

pairs.true: The retail CDTM extension is distinct from general continuity-of-care dispensing.
pairs.false: The CDTM extension automatically applies to every patient with an expired prescription.
pairs.reason_ko: CDTM extension과 일반 Schedule VI continuity-of-care 경로를 혼합하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The default is two 30-day extension periods, subject to the specifically authorized referral-and-CPA exception.
pairs.false: The default grants an unlimited series of 30-day extensions.
pairs.reason_ko: 두 번의 30일이라는 기본 경계와 구체적으로 허용한 예외 문구를 함께 읽는다.

pairs.true: A physician's specific authorized variation must be grounded in the referral and agreement.
pairs.false: A cashier's note authorizes exceeding the agreement's therapy-extension scope.
pairs.reason_ko: 개별 허용 범위는 적법한 physician referral과 CPA에 근거해야 한다.

title: Retail diagnosis-linked management
case_a: A retail CDTM agreement and physician referral address an adult patient's hypertension and specified comorbidities. The pharmacist considers therapy changes within that arrangement.
case_b: The pharmacist assumes that the listed HIV/AIDS condition means any pharmacist may independently initiate all HIV treatment outside CDTM.

pairs.true: Therapy management must remain within the referred diagnoses and authorized CPA scope.
pairs.false: Listing hypertension permits the pharmacist to diagnose and treat unrelated diseases independently.
pairs.reason_ko: Therapy management는 referral에 지정된 diagnoses와 CPA 범위 안에서 수행한다.

pairs.true: A listed retail CDTM condition does not create universal independent prescribing authority.
pairs.false: The HIV/AIDS entry independently authorizes HIV prescribing by every retail pharmacist.
pairs.reason_ko: CDTM의 질환 목록과 별도의 statutory HIV-prevention prescribing 권한을 구분한다.

pairs.true: Initiation, modification, or discontinuation must meet the agreement's specified authority.
pairs.false: A pharmacist may disregard the agreement whenever a listed disease is present.
pairs.reason_ko: 질환이 목록에 있어도 실제 agreement가 해당 권한을 부여해야 한다.

pairs.true: The patient's physician diagnosis is distinct from pharmacist drug-therapy management.
pairs.false: Drug-therapy management authorizes the pharmacist to replace the physician's diagnosis.
pairs.reason_ko: 진단 권한과 약물치료 관리 권한을 합치지 않는다.

title: Retail schedule limits
case_a: A retail CPA includes a physician's statement authorizing the pharmacist to prescribe testosterone. The pharmacist knows testosterone is Schedule III.
case_b: Another patient is managed on an appropriate Schedule VI therapy, and the pharmacist assumes that Schedule VI status removes any additional reporting duties.

pairs.true: The retail prohibition on prescribing Schedules II–V is not removed by agreement language.
pairs.false: A physician can waive the retail Schedule II–V prescribing restriction in a CPA.
pairs.reason_ko: 계약 문구로 retail의 Schedule II–V prescribing 금지를 없앨 수 없다.

pairs.true: Schedule VI status does not by itself remove special PMP or other product requirements.
pairs.false: Every Schedule VI product is exempt from every PMP-related obligation.
pairs.reason_ko: Gabapentin처럼 Schedule VI이면서 추가 PMP 조건이 있는 제품을 구분한다.

pairs.true: Testosterone's non-opioid character does not change its controlled-substance schedule.
pairs.false: A non-opioid drug must be Schedule VI for retail CDTM purposes.
pairs.reason_ko: 약리학적 분류와 legal schedule은 다르다.

pairs.true: An eligible Schedule VI therapy still needs the appropriate diagnosis and CPA authority.
pairs.false: Schedule VI status alone allows treatment of any disease without referral.
pairs.reason_ko: Schedule 하나로 환자·질환·협약 조건을 대체하지 않는다.

title: CDTM documentation and urgent communication
case_a: A CDTM pharmacist modifies a patient's prescription on Monday and plans to send the copy to the supervising physician with the next monthly report.
case_b: An urgent safety issue occurs after the change, and the pharmacist decides to wait until the ordinary copy-transmission period ends before notifying the physician.

pairs.true: The stated prescription or modification copy is provided within 24 hours after issuance.
pairs.false: Monthly batch reporting ordinarily satisfies the 24-hour prescription-change communication.
pairs.reason_ko: Issuance 후 24시간 이내 사본 전달과 월간 보고는 다르다.

pairs.true: Urgent circumstances call for communication sooner than the ordinary limit.
pairs.false: The 24-hour limit requires waiting a full day before urgent communication.
pairs.reason_ko: 최대 기한이 있다는 것은 그때까지 기다리라는 뜻이 아니다.

pairs.true: The action belongs in the patient medical record with the required cross-professional documentation.
pairs.false: A dispensing label alone replaces the CDTM medical-record documentation.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자 label, patient medical record, physician에게 전달하는 사본은 다른 문서다.

pairs.true: The CPA should specify how and when laboratory and patient information are exchanged.
pairs.false: A generic instruction to contact as needed replaces all required communication terms.
pairs.reason_ko: CPA의 구체적인 정보전달 방식과 urgent communication 조건을 유지한다.

title: CPA terms and delegation
case_a: A proposed CPA contains signatures but omits the disease scope, medication-change protocols, risk management, and information-transmission procedures.
case_b: The physician and pharmacist add a sentence allowing a technician to make independent therapeutic decisions and assume the agreement expands the technician's statutory scope.

pairs.true: Signatures alone do not replace the required substantive CPA terms.
pairs.false: A signed blank agreement supplies every required CDTM protocol.
pairs.reason_ko: 서명된 agreement에도 질환, protocol, risk management 등 필수 내용이 필요하다.

pairs.true: Delegation provisions cannot create technician prescribing or clinical-judgment authority.
pairs.false: A CPA may grant a technician any clinical duty that its signatories choose.
pairs.reason_ko: CPA의 위임 문구가 technician에게 새로운 법정 scope를 부여하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The agreement addresses specific prescribing authority and outcome measures.
pairs.false: The agreement need not identify any prescribing authority or outcome measures.
pairs.reason_ko: Specific authority와 outcome measures 등 필수 요소를 확인한다.

pairs.true: Pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the agreement at least biennially.
pairs.false: A CPA never requires renewal once both parties sign.
pairs.reason_ko: 적어도 2년마다 review·renew하며 그 사이 필요한 변경도 별도로 반영한다.

title: Ending a CDTM agreement
case_a: A pharmacist and physician decide not to renew a CPA and stop accepting the patient's therapy requests without arranging continuation.
case_b: During inspection, the pharmacist says the physician holds the agreement and therefore no readily retrievable copy is needed at the pharmacist's primary practice setting.

pairs.true: Therapy continuation must be arranged before termination or nonrenewal as required.
pairs.false: Nonrenewal permits immediate abandonment of ongoing therapy without a transition plan.
pairs.reason_ko: 종료 전에 약물치료가 중단되지 않도록 continuation 절차를 마련한다.

pairs.true: The pharmacist keeps the current agreement and required referral or consent copies readily retrievable at the primary setting.
pairs.false: The physician's records eliminate the pharmacist's local CPA and copy-access responsibilities.
pairs.reason_ko: 양측의 원본·사본 보관 책임을 구분한다.

pairs.true: The patient receives written notice and information about continuing therapy.
pairs.false: Telling only pharmacy employees satisfies patient termination notice.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자에게 서면 통지하고 이후 치료를 지속할 절차를 안내해야 한다.

pairs.true: Electronic storage must preserve access and the applicable current version.
pairs.false: Any old electronic draft substitutes for the current signed agreement.
pairs.reason_ko: 전자화가 version consistency와 현재 유효한 agreement의 필요성을 없애지 않는다.

title: Employment and CDTM quality assurance
case_a: A community pharmacy considers hiring a physician specifically to establish and maintain the pharmacy's CDTM agreements.
case_b: The pharmacy instead evaluates a physician contract genuinely limited to quality-assurance review of the CDTM pharmacist's work.

pairs.true: The stated restriction distinguishes hiring to establish a CPA from a permitted quality-assurance relationship.
pairs.false: A community pharmacy may hire a physician for the purpose of establishing its CPAs without the stated restriction.
pairs.reason_ko: CPA를 설립·체결·유지하기 위한 고용과 QA review를 위한 고용을 구분한다.

pairs.true: A qualifying quality-assurance review relationship is not the same as purchasing prescribing authority.
pairs.false: Every physician quality-assurance contract automatically creates a CPA for all patients.
pairs.reason_ko: QA 계약이 환자별 CPA 처방권한을 자동으로 만들지는 않는다.

pairs.true: A physician or physician group may employ a qualified pharmacist for CDTM within the applicable framework.
pairs.false: CDTM pharmacists may never be employed by a physician group.
pairs.reason_ko: 허용된 physician group의 qualified pharmacist 고용 경로를 구분한다.

pairs.true: The purpose and terms of the employment arrangement matter to the legal assessment.
pairs.false: Changing the contract's title alone removes the restriction on its actual purpose.
pairs.reason_ko: 계약 제목보다 실제 목적과 적용 조건을 검토한다.

title: Vaccinator status and pharmacist supervision
case_a: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee finishes an injection course and is assigned to vaccinate while the pharmacist manages prescriptions nearby.
case_b: A fully licensed technician meets the separate vaccination qualifications but proposes vaccinating without approval from the pharmacist on duty.

pairs.true: Completing an injection course does not make a technician trainee eligible under the state vaccination policy.
pairs.false: An injection course makes a licensed technician trainee eligible to vaccinate under the state policy.
pairs.reason_ko: 주 예방접종 policy의 pharmacy personnel에는 PTT가 포함되지 않는다. 교육만으로 직종 제한이 바뀌지 않는다.

pairs.true: An eligible technician still needs the on-duty pharmacist's approval and direct supervision by a qualified immunizing pharmacist.
pairs.false: A qualified technician's training certificate replaces on-duty approval and direct pharmacist supervision.
pairs.reason_ko: 자격·근무 약사의 승인·적격 immunizer의 직접 감독은 별개 요건이다.

pairs.true: The pharmacist retains vaccine selection and counseling duties before technician administration.
pairs.false: A technician's permission to inject includes independent vaccine selection and patient counseling.
pairs.reason_ko: Technician에게 허용한 물리적 준비·투여를 임상 판단·상담으로 확대하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The intern pathway also requires the specified supervision rather than independent practice.
pairs.false: An intern's vaccination training creates an independent pharmacist practice privilege.
pairs.reason_ko: Intern의 교육과 면허도 직접 감독 조건을 없애지 않는다.

title: State vaccine age and product eligibility
case_a: A four-year-old requests a routine vaccine through the Massachusetts state policy alone; no separate federal or other authorization is being invoked.
case_b: A five-year-old requests a product whose applicable approved or authorized age range begins later, with no applicable Commissioner recommendation changing that range.

pairs.true: The four-year-old does not meet the state policy's five-year minimum for this pathway.
pairs.false: The state policy's five-year minimum can be waived by the pharmacist solely because a parent consents.
