pairs.false: The pharmacy may designate open business hours during which counseling is categorically unavailable.
pairs.reason_ko: 약국이 business에 열려 있는 시간의 상담 이용 가능성을 유지한다.

pairs.true: The consultation area must support visual and auditory confidentiality.
pairs.false: A labeled area meets the rule even if sensitive conversations are plainly audible to the queue.
pairs.reason_ko: 표지와 실제 visual·auditory privacy는 별도 조건이다.

pairs.true: The specific inpatient exception should not be extended automatically to hospital outpatient pickup.
pairs.false: Every prescription obtained anywhere in a hospital is exempt from the counseling-area rules.
pairs.reason_ko: Setting의 적용 제외를 outpatient·discharge까지 무조건 확대하지 않는다.

title: Counseling signage and management signage
case_a: A pharmacy displays a counseling-right sign that is 8 inches high and 10 inches wide, although its wording otherwise matches the rule.
case_b: The manager uses the minimum letter height for the MOR-name sign as though it were the specified letter requirement for the counseling-right sign.

pairs.true: The first sign is smaller than the stated minimum 11-inch height and 14-inch width.
pairs.false: The first sign meets the stated minimum dimensions because its wording is correct.
pairs.reason_ko: 문구와 최소 크기는 각각 충족해야 한다.

pairs.true: The counseling-right sign's half-inch lettering requirement is distinct from the MOR-name sign's one-inch requirement.
pairs.false: The two signs are governed by one identical lettering requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: 서로 다른 표지의 글자 크기를 혼동하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The counseling-right sign belongs conspicuously adjacent to the prescription-dispensing area as required.
pairs.false: Keeping the counseling-right sign in an employee-only folder fulfills the posting requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: Readily available 기록과 환자에게 보이는 posted sign은 다르다.

pairs.true: A posted sign does not replace the actual counseling offer and availability.
pairs.false: Posting the correct sign removes the need to offer counseling to prescription recipients.
pairs.reason_ko: 표지·offer·actual counseling을 각각 구별한다.

title: Prospective DUR and automated alerts
case_a: The computer displays no interaction alert, and the pharmacist proposes dispensing without considering a documented allergy.
case_b: For another prescription, an alert appears but has not yet been evaluated for its relevance to the actual patient.

pairs.true: Absence of a computer alert does not replace the pharmacist's prospective review of the allergy.
pairs.false: No computer alert conclusively establishes that the documented allergy needs no review.
pairs.reason_ko: 전산 alert 유무와 pharmacist의 실제 DUR 책임을 구분한다.

pairs.true: The second alert requires patient-specific evaluation rather than automatic acceptance or rejection.
pairs.false: Every computer alert is a legal prohibition on dispensing regardless of its relevance.
pairs.reason_ko: Alert의 clinical significance를 평가하고 적절한 조치·기록으로 연결한다.

pairs.true: Appropriate measures taken in response to a DUR concern must be documented.
pairs.false: Resolving a concern orally eliminates the need to document the response.
pairs.reason_ko: DUR 문제 해결 내용의 문서화가 필요하다.

pairs.true: Prospective review occurs before the applicable new prescription is dispensed or delivered.
pairs.false: A review performed only after delivery satisfies the prospective timing requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: Prospective라는 시점을 사후 점검으로 바꾸지 않는다.

title: Separate clinical and product checks
case_a: A pharmacy scans the correct barcode and verifies tablet count, but does not resolve the patient's therapeutic duplication.
case_b: Another pharmacist reviews MassPAT and assumes this also completes allergy review and verification of the patient's directions.

pairs.true: Correct product and count do not resolve the separate therapeutic-duplication concern.
pairs.false: Barcode and count verification complete DUR even when a duplication remains unresolved.
pairs.reason_ko: 제품의 정확성과 환자의 약물치료 적정성은 별개 검토이다.

pairs.true: A MassPAT query does not replace the patient's full relevant DUR and directions review.
pairs.false: A MassPAT query necessarily completes allergy and directions review.
pairs.reason_ko: PMP history와 dose·allergy·directions 검토의 목적을 구분한다.

pairs.true: Prescription authenticity and corresponding responsibility are distinct from final physical-product verification.
pairs.false: An accurately counted product establishes that the prescription is authentic.
pairs.reason_ko: 정확한 약을 골랐다는 사실이 처방 진정성을 증명하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The confidential profile should support timely retrieval of relevant patient information.
pairs.false: A profile that cannot be retrieved when dispensing meets the immediate-retrieval purpose.
pairs.reason_ko: 필요한 순간 patient profile을 사용할 수 있어야 한다.

title: Missing history versus negative findings
case_a: The allergy field is blank, and staff convert it to 'no known allergies' without asking the patient or checking available information.
case_b: The pharmacy stores a REMS authorization in the patient chart and assumes no separate counseling or dispensing records are needed.

pairs.true: An empty allergy field is not the same as a confirmed negative allergy history.
pairs.false: A blank allergy field is sufficient evidence that the patient has no allergies.
pairs.reason_ko: 정보 부재와 확인된 negative history는 다르다.

pairs.true: One stored REMS authorization does not replace other applicable records with different purposes.
pairs.false: A REMS entry in the chart replaces every counseling and dispensing record.
pairs.reason_ko: 같은 전산 차트에 있어도 REMS·Rx·counseling·PMP 기록 요건은 다르다.

pairs.true: The pharmacy must make the described reasonable effort to obtain relevant profile information.
pairs.false: Patient-profile obligations are satisfied by deliberately leaving relevant fields unexamined.
pairs.reason_ko: Name·contact·DOB·allergy·medication·comments 등을 합리적으로 확보한다.

pairs.true: Relevant pharmacist comments should preserve important therapy concerns for subsequent care.
pairs.false: Clinical concerns should be removed from the profile once the current transaction closes.
pairs.reason_ko: Therapy 관련 정보를 이후 care에 활용할 수 있게 유지한다.

title: Different patient information documents
case_a: A pharmacy replaces a required FDA Medication Guide with its software's generic consumer leaflet.
case_b: A staff member says that every product with a Medication Guide must also require enrollment in an active REMS program.

pairs.true: A generic consumer leaflet is not automatically a substitute for the required FDA-approved Medication Guide.
pairs.false: Any software leaflet necessarily fulfills a product's required Medication Guide.
pairs.reason_ko: CMI와 FDA-approved Medication Guide는 동일 문서가 아니다.

pairs.true: A Medication Guide requirement does not by itself prove a current REMS enrollment requirement.
pairs.false: The existence of a Medication Guide proves that REMS enrollment is required.
pairs.reason_ko: Guide 존재와 active REMS의 구체적 요건을 별도로 확인한다.

pairs.true: Required information may also be needed at refills under the applicable Medication Guide rule.
pairs.false: Medication Guides are categorically limited to the first dispensing and excluded from refills.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 dispensing·refill의 Guide 제공 요건을 함께 확인한다.

pairs.true: A VIS is vaccine information supplied before vaccination, not a general prescription pickup leaflet.
pairs.false: A VIS is the same document as every prescription medicine's generic consumer leaflet.
pairs.reason_ko: VIS·PPI·CMI·Medication Guide의 용도와 시점을 구별한다.

title: PPI and institutional administration
case_a: An oral contraceptive is dispensed in the community without the applicable patient package insert because the patient received one with an earlier package.
case_b: An LTCF continues the applicable therapy and assumes the community package workflow is the only patient-information timing rule to consider.

pairs.true: The applicable PPI accompanies each dispensed oral-contraceptive package.
pairs.false: An earlier package insert eliminates the requirement for subsequent dispensed packages.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 oral contraceptive의 각 dispensed package에 PPI를 함께 제공한다.

pairs.true: The institutional rule includes provision before first administration and every 30 days while therapy continues.
pairs.false: The institutional pathway has no first-administration or continuing 30-day information requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: Acute-care/LTCF의 지정 first administration·30일 경로를 구분한다.

pairs.true: The PPI information clock is separate from prescription refill validity.
pairs.false: The PPI's 30-day interval establishes the prescription's refill validity.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자정보 제공 시계와 처방 유효기간은 다르다.

pairs.true: Estrogen-progestogen oral contraceptives follow the specified oral-contraceptive provision rather than being indiscriminately reassigned.
pairs.false: Every estrogen-containing product is governed by an identical PPI provision regardless of product type.

title: Medicaid framework and Massachusetts counseling
case_a: A Massachusetts pharmacy declines to offer counseling to a cash-paying patient because the federal Medicaid DUR provisions concern Medicaid beneficiaries.
case_b: A mail-service prescription includes written information, and staff treat the leaflet as proof that all applicable counseling access requirements have been satisfied.

pairs.true: Massachusetts's independent counseling obligations are not confined to Medicaid payment.
pairs.false: Cash payment removes Massachusetts counseling obligations because Medicaid funds are absent.
pairs.reason_ko: 연방 Medicaid 체계와 주의 독립적인 counseling·DUR 의무를 구별한다.

pairs.true: Written information alone does not establish compliance with every applicable mail-service counseling requirement.
pairs.false: Enclosing a leaflet conclusively satisfies all mail-service counseling requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: 배송에서도 해당 환자 상담 이용 경로·의무를 별도로 충족한다.

pairs.true: Offer, actual counseling, and documented refusal describe different events.
pairs.false: The terms offer, counseling, and refusal identify the same event for legal records.
pairs.reason_ko: 제공 제안·실제 설명·환자 거절은 각각 사실에 맞게 기록한다.

pairs.true: Prospective review, patient information, and counseling duties must be connected without treating one as a substitute for the others.
pairs.false: Completing prospective review removes the need for all patient-information and counseling duties.
pairs.reason_ko: 한 단계의 완료가 다른 단계의 의무를 자동 면제하지 않는다.

title: PHI across media
case_a: An employee discards a readable paper prescription label in public trash and argues that HIPAA concerns only electronic records.
case_b: Another employee discusses an identifiable patient's diagnosis where unrelated customers can hear.

pairs.true: Identifiable health information on paper can fall within the Privacy Rule's protection.
pairs.false: Paper prescription labels are outside privacy protection because they are not electronic.
pairs.reason_ko: Privacy Rule는 paper·electronic·oral PHI를 다룰 수 있다.

pairs.true: An oral disclosure can implicate privacy even when no computer file is transmitted.
pairs.false: Speaking identifiable health information is outside privacy rules unless it is also emailed.
pairs.reason_ko: 구두 대화도 identifiable health information의 공개일 수 있다.

pairs.true: The Security Rule's electronic-PHI focus differs from the broader Privacy Rule.
pairs.false: The Security Rule's electronic focus narrows all Privacy Rule protection to electronic files.
pairs.reason_ko: Privacy와 ePHI Security의 적용 범위를 구별한다.

pairs.true: A pharmacy should assess the specific information, recipient, purpose, and applicable permission.
pairs.false: Any information located in a pharmacy is automatically public once a transaction ends.
pairs.reason_ko: 정보의 내용·식별성·이용 목적·허용 근거를 확인한다.

title: Business associate relationship
case_a: A billing vendor handles identifiable claims on behalf of a covered pharmacy without the pharmacy considering whether a business associate agreement is required.
case_b: The pharmacy sends relevant prescription information directly to the patient's treating clinician for treatment and labels that clinician a business associate solely because data were shared.

pairs.true: The billing arrangement requires evaluation of the applicable business-associate and agreement obligations.
pairs.false: A vendor is excluded from business-associate obligations whenever it calls its service billing support.
pairs.reason_ko: 명칭보다 pharmacy를 대신하여 PHI를 취급하는 실제 관계를 본다.

pairs.true: A treatment disclosure to another provider is not automatically the same as a business-associate service relationship.
pairs.false: Every treating provider receiving information becomes the pharmacy's business associate.
pairs.reason_ko: Provider 간 치료 정보 전달과 위탁업무 BA 관계를 구분한다.

pairs.true: A BAA does not authorize uses that the applicable privacy rules otherwise prohibit.
pairs.false: Signing a BAA permits any otherwise prohibited use of the information.
pairs.reason_ko: 계약이 법이 금지하는 이용까지 허용하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The actual functions and handling of PHI matter more than the vendor's marketing label.
pairs.false: Whether an entity is a business associate depends only on its chosen business title.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 PHI 처리 역할과 위탁 관계를 판단한다.

title: Treatment disclosure versus curiosity access
case_a: A pharmacist needs to clarify a prescription with the actual treating prescriber and is told that a separate patient authorization is always required first.
case_b: An employee uses the same system to examine a friend's medication history without a work-related reason.

pairs.true: A permitted treatment disclosure generally does not require separate patient authorization merely because PHI is involved.
pairs.false: Every treatment clarification involving PHI requires a separate signed authorization before discussion.
pairs.reason_ko: 허용된 TPO 범위의 treatment communication을 일반적으로 별도 authorization가 필요한 공개와 구분한다.

pairs.true: The friend's record cannot be accessed simply because the employee has technical access.
pairs.false: A pharmacy login makes curiosity access to a friend's record a treatment activity.
pairs.reason_ko: 로그인 권한과 적법한 patient-care purpose는 별개이다.

pairs.true: TPO is a defined permitted-use framework rather than a label that validates any activity.
pairs.false: Describing an activity as TPO makes it lawful regardless of its actual purpose.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 목적·역할·허용 범위를 검토한다.

pairs.true: The pharmacy must still protect confidentiality while carrying out an authorized treatment communication.
pairs.false: A treatment purpose eliminates confidentiality safeguards during communication.
pairs.reason_ko: 허용된 공개에도 적절한 비밀유지·전달 보호가 필요하다.

title: Minimum necessary and treatment exception
case_a: Two treating providers exchange information for the patient's treatment; an employee applies the minimum-necessary rule as though its treatment-disclosure exception did not exist.
case_b: A different employee invokes that exception to justify browsing unrelated internal records outside assigned duties.

pairs.true: The rule contains an exception for the described provider-to-provider treatment disclosure or request.
pairs.false: The rule has no exception for provider-to-provider treatment disclosures.
pairs.reason_ko: Minimum necessary의 명시적 treatment disclosure/request 예외를 구별한다.

pairs.true: The exception does not create unrestricted curiosity access for the pharmacy workforce.
pairs.false: The treatment-disclosure exception authorizes workforce access to unrelated patient files.
pairs.reason_ko: 외부 treatment 예외와 내부 workforce의 적정 접근은 다르다.

pairs.true: The purpose and recipient must be identified before deciding how the requirement applies.
pairs.false: The minimum-necessary analysis is identical for every recipient and purpose.
pairs.reason_ko: 본인 공개·authorization·required-by-law 등 예외의 문맥을 확인한다.

pairs.true: An applicable exception to minimum necessary is not an exception to every privacy obligation.
pairs.false: A minimum-necessary exception removes all other privacy requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: 하나의 예외를 HIPAA 전체 면제로 확대하지 않는다.

title: Marketing and sale of patient information
case_a: A pharmacy plans to give a product promoter an identifiable patient list and calls the transaction routine treatment support without reviewing authorization requirements.
case_b: The promoter offers payment for the list, and the pharmacy assumes the payment makes the disclosure a normal insurance-payment activity.

pairs.true: A marketing use must be evaluated under its actual authorization requirements rather than relabeled as treatment.
pairs.false: Calling the promotion treatment support establishes a permitted treatment purpose.
pairs.reason_ko: Marketing·sale of PHI와 실제 patient treatment를 구별한다.

pairs.true: Payment from a promoter does not by itself turn a sale of PHI into permitted health-care payment activity.
pairs.false: Any paid transaction involving PHI falls within ordinary health-care payment permission.
pairs.reason_ko: 일반적인 보험 payment와 PHI 매매 대가를 같은 개념으로 처리하지 않는다.

pairs.true: A patient's consent to receive care is not necessarily the authorization needed for an unrelated promotion.
pairs.false: Agreement to receive pharmacy care authorizes every unrelated promotional use of the patient's information.
pairs.reason_ko: 치료 동의·NPP acknowledgment·특정 disclosure authorization은 다르다.

pairs.true: The permitted purpose, data, recipients, and applicable consent requirements must be established before disclosure.
pairs.false: The pharmacy may disclose first and decide the required authorization after the promoter uses the list.
pairs.reason_ko: 사후에 명칭을 붙이는 방식이 필요한 사전 공개 근거를 대체하지 않는다.

title: Family pickup and limited relevant disclosure
case_a: With the patient's agreement, a family member collects a prescription and needs relevant instructions for helping with that medication.
case_b: The family member also requests unrelated sensitive records, claiming that family status gives unrestricted access.

pairs.true: Relevant information may be shared through the applicable patient-agreement or other permitted pathway.
pairs.false: Family pickup prevents any relevant explanation unless a separate broad written authorization is obtained.
pairs.reason_ko: 가족·대리인의 care 참여와 환자 동의·기회·허용 judgment를 검토한다.

pairs.true: Family relationship alone does not establish unrestricted access to unrelated records.
pairs.false: A family member collecting one prescription is entitled to all unrelated health records.
pairs.reason_ko: 가족 신분과 전체 기록 접근권은 동일하지 않다.

pairs.true: The scope of information should relate to the person's actual involvement in care or payment.
pairs.false: Involvement in one transaction authorizes disclosure unrelated to that involvement.
pairs.reason_ko: 관련된 범위의 정보를 적법하게 제공한다.

pairs.true: The patient's objection or preferences matter to the applicable disclosure pathway.
pairs.false: A family member's request overrides the patient's relevant objection solely because of kinship.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 환자의 동의·반대·대리권 조건을 확인한다.

title: Minor consent and record access
case_a: A minor receives a service under a specific Massachusetts independent-consent provision, and staff assume the parent's payment of insurance premiums gives access to the entire sensitive record.
case_b: A colleague interprets that specific consent provision as permission for the minor to consent independently to every unrelated treatment.

pairs.true: Payment of insurance premiums alone does not settle access to the protected service's records.
pairs.false: Paying the premiums automatically gives the parent unrestricted access to the protected service record.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 치료의 consent·confidentiality·personal representative 규칙을 함께 확인한다.

pairs.true: A specific minor-consent provision should not be generalized to all unrelated medical care.
pairs.false: Consent authority for one specified service establishes unrestricted consent authority for every treatment.
pairs.reason_ko: 각 서비스의 적용 조건과 범위를 유지한다.

pairs.true: Product eligibility and pharmacist scope remain separate from the minor's ability to consent.
pairs.false: Independent consent eliminates product-age and professional-scope restrictions.
pairs.reason_ko: 동의 가능성·제품 적격성·업무권한을 각각 판단한다.

pairs.true: A legal record-disclosure exception must be identified rather than assumed from the family relationship.
pairs.false: Every request from a parent is an automatic exception to the service's confidentiality rules.
pairs.reason_ko: Written consent·적법한 order·특수 안전 예외 등 실제 근거를 확인한다.

title: Notice of privacy practices
case_a: A patient signs acknowledgment of receiving the pharmacy's Notice of Privacy Practices, and staff treat it as permission for any future disclosure.
case_b: The pharmacy asks staff to keep that acknowledgment separate from any authorization needed for a specific nonroutine use.

pairs.true: Acknowledgment of the notice is not unrestricted authorization for future disclosures.
pairs.false: The notice acknowledgment authorizes every future use and disclosure of PHI.
pairs.reason_ko: NPP 수령 확인과 구체적인 disclosure authorization은 다르다.

pairs.true: Separating the acknowledgment from a required specific authorization preserves the distinct purposes.
pairs.false: A specific authorization can always be replaced by the notice acknowledgment.
pairs.reason_ko: 각 문서가 증명하는 행위를 혼동하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The direct-treatment provider follows the applicable good-faith acknowledgment procedure.
pairs.false: Notice provision has no acknowledgment-related procedure in the described direct-treatment setting.
pairs.reason_ko: NPP 제공과 해당 good-faith acknowledgment 절차를 확인한다.

pairs.true: Patient access, amendment, and confidential-communication rights require their own applicable analysis.
pairs.false: Signing the notice waives all access, amendment, and confidential-communication rights.
pairs.reason_ko: Notice 서명으로 환자의 별도 권리를 일괄 포기한 것으로 해석하지 않는다.

title: Patient access clock and extension
case_a: A covered pharmacy receives an access request and sends it to its records vendor 12 days later; the vendor proposes starting a fresh 30-day period on that later date.
case_b: The pharmacy needs an allowed extension but plans to give the written reason and completion date only after the initial 30-day period has elapsed.

pairs.true: The vendor handoff does not restart the ordinary clock running from the pharmacy's receipt.
pairs.false: Forwarding the request to the vendor restarts a new 30-day clock.
pairs.reason_ko: Covered entity receipt부터의 시계는 BA로 넘겼다고 초기화되지 않는다.

pairs.true: The allowed extension requires the specified written notice within the initial 30-day period.
pairs.false: The extension can be established by sending its notice only after the original period expires.
pairs.reason_ko: 초기 30일 안에 사유와 완료 예정일을 서면으로 알려야 한다.

pairs.true: The ordinary access period is measured in calendar days rather than business days.
pairs.false: The ordinary HIPAA access period is 30 business days.
pairs.reason_ko: 30 calendar days라는 단위를 유지한다.

pairs.true: The described extension is one additional period of no more than 30 calendar days.
pairs.false: The pharmacy may keep adding 30-day extensions whenever its vendor remains busy.
pairs.reason_ko: 허용된 한 번의 최대 추가 30일과 반복 연장은 다르다.

title: Different record-retention obligations
case_a: A pharmacy applies its general two-year prescription-record minimum to every HIPAA policy and authorization document.
case_b: Another employee says HIPAA requires every medical record of every kind to be destroyed exactly six years after creation.

pairs.true: The general prescription-record period does not replace HIPAA's applicable six-year documentation requirement.
pairs.false: The general two-year prescription period is sufficient for every HIPAA-required document.
pairs.reason_ko: HIPAA가 요구하는 policy·authorization 등 documentation의 6년과 일반 Rx 기록을 구분한다.

pairs.true: A minimum documentation-retention rule is not a universal destruction deadline for all medical records.
pairs.false: HIPAA's documentation rule creates an exact destruction date for every medical record.
pairs.reason_ko: 최소 보존·문서 종류·다른 적용 법규를 각각 확인한다.

pairs.true: Overlapping requirements must be met for records to which both apply.
pairs.false: A pharmacy can choose the shortest applicable minimum when several retention duties overlap.
pairs.reason_ko: 같은 자료에 함께 적용되는 의무를 임의로 짧게 선택하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Correcting a record should preserve the relevant audit trail rather than erase the prior facts.
pairs.false: An amendment request authorizes deletion of the original audit trail to conceal the correction.
pairs.reason_ko: 수정 과정의 사실관계와 추적성을 유지한다.

title: Breach presumption and risk review
case_a: A medication bag containing another patient's identifiable information is handed to the wrong person; staff conclude that an accidental disclosure cannot be a breach.
case_b: The pharmacy retrieves the bag and assumes retrieval alone proves that no information was seen or compromised.

pairs.true: An impermissible disclosure is evaluated under the breach framework even if the act was accidental.
pairs.false: Accidental disclosures are categorically outside the breach framework.
pairs.reason_ko: 실수 여부만으로 breach 여부를 결론내리지 않는다.

pairs.true: Retrieval is relevant mitigation but does not by itself establish every fact needed for the risk assessment.
pairs.false: Recovering the bag conclusively proves no information was viewed.
pairs.reason_ko: 수령자·실제 열람·정보 민감도·mitigation을 함께 평가한다.

pairs.true: An applicable exception or documented low probability of compromise must be supported.
pairs.false: An undocumented assurance that nobody was harmed replaces assessment of compromise.
pairs.reason_ko: 통지 불필요 판단에도 해당 근거와 문서화가 필요하다.

pairs.true: A privacy response is distinct from any medication-error CQI process triggered by the same event.
pairs.false: Opening a CQI record automatically completes all privacy breach analysis.
pairs.reason_ko: 한 사건의 약물 오류·privacy 의무를 별도로 처리한다.

title: Individual notice and small-breach HHS report
case_a: A confirmed reportable breach of unsecured PHI affects 20 individuals, and the pharmacy proposes waiting until the annual HHS report to notify those individuals.
case_b: A manager treats the 60-day outer limit as an automatic permission to wait the full period even though earlier notice is feasible; no authorized delay applies.

pairs.true: The small-breach annual HHS route does not postpone the individual-notification obligation.
pairs.false: A breach affecting fewer than 500 people permits individual notice to wait for the annual HHS report.
pairs.reason_ko: 개인 통지의 discovery 후 최대 60일과 소규모 HHS 연말 후 보고를 구분한다.

pairs.true: Notice must be provided without unreasonable delay, not routinely held until the outer limit.
pairs.false: The 60-day outer limit permits unreasonable delay until the last day in every case.
pairs.reason_ko: Without unreasonable delay와 최대 기한을 함께 적용한다.

pairs.true: The small-breach HHS deadline is within 60 days after the discovery calendar year ends.
pairs.false: The small-breach HHS clock starts 60 days after each affected patient next visits.
pairs.reason_ko: 연말과 환자의 다음 방문은 다른 시작점이다.

pairs.true: Individual and regulator notifications have different recipients and may have different clocks.
pairs.false: One regulator filing necessarily serves as notice to all affected individuals.
pairs.reason_ko: 수신자별 통지 의무를 각각 충족한다.

title: Exactly 500 and more than 500
case_a: A reportable unsecured-PHI breach affects exactly 500 individuals, all residing in one state; no other media-notice trigger is present.
case_b: A separate breach affects 501 residents of one state.

pairs.true: The first breach meets the 500-or-more threshold for the specified HHS reporting route.
pairs.false: The first breach falls into the fewer-than-500 annual HHS route.
pairs.reason_ko: HHS의 500 or more에는 정확히 500이 포함된다.

pairs.true: The second breach meets the more-than-500-residents threshold for the specified media notice.
pairs.false: The second breach fails the media threshold because 501 is not more than 500.
pairs.reason_ko: Media 기준은 해당 주·관할의 residents more than 500이다.

pairs.true: Exactly 500 residents do not meet the stated more-than-500 media threshold by that count alone.
pairs.false: The first breach meets the more-than-500 media threshold solely because exactly 500 residents are affected.
pairs.reason_ko: ≥500 HHS와 >500 media의 경계를 같은 숫자로 바꾸지 않는다.

pairs.true: Media notice, when required, is additional to individual notice rather than a substitute.
pairs.false: A required media notice replaces the individual notices.
pairs.reason_ko: Media·individual·HHS 의무는 구분해 수행한다.

title: Part 2 record origin and consent
case_a: A pharmacy assumes that possessing any buprenorphine prescription automatically makes every pharmacy record subject to the identical Part 2 program rules.
case_b: A federally assisted SUD program uses the current rule's permitted single-consent pathway for future treatment, payment, and health-care operations disclosures.

pairs.true: The record's source and the program or recipient's status must be examined rather than inferred solely from the drug name.
pairs.false: Any buprenorphine prescription makes every pharmacy record an identical Part 2 program record.
pairs.reason_ko: 약 이름만으로 program·record 출처·수신자의 지위를 결정하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The permitted single TPO consent must be applied under its conditions and scope.
pairs.false: The current Part 2 framework has no possible single-consent pathway for future TPO uses.
pairs.reason_ko: 현행 rule의 적격 single TPO consent 경로를 구별한다.

pairs.true: Legal-proceeding protections are not eliminated by alignment with HIPAA.
pairs.false: Alignment with HIPAA makes all SUD records unrestricted evidence for proceedings against the patient.
pairs.reason_ko: TPO 조정과 legal proceeding의 별도 보호는 다르다.

pairs.true: SUD counseling notes may have distinct consent protections from general treatment records.
pairs.false: SUD counseling notes and all general treatment records have no distinct consent treatment.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 counseling notes의 별도 보호를 유지한다.

title: Administrative, physical, and technical security
case_a: A pharmacy installs strong passwords but has no role-based access management, training, or physical device protection.
case_b: The manager treats a proposed cybersecurity rule as already binding without checking whether it has taken effect.

pairs.true: Passwords do not substitute for all administrative, physical, and technical safeguards.
pairs.false: Strong passwords alone satisfy the entire ePHI safeguard framework.
pairs.reason_ko: 관리·물리·기술적 보호를 함께 평가한다.

pairs.true: The proposal's status and effective requirements must be checked before presenting it as current law.
pairs.false: A proposed rule becomes binding merely because it is posted online.
pairs.reason_ko: Proposed와 final·effective를 구분한다.

pairs.true: Availability and integrity are security objectives alongside confidentiality.
pairs.false: Security concerns confidentiality only and excludes accuracy or availability.
pairs.reason_ko: Confidentiality·integrity·availability의 목적을 함께 이해한다.

pairs.true: A useful security control is not necessarily a universally mandated implementation in every circumstance.
pairs.false: Any useful security feature is automatically a specific legal mandate for every pharmacy.
pairs.reason_ko: 권장 설계와 실제 법정 의무를 구별한다.

title: Downtime, incident response, and records
case_a: During a system outage, a pharmacy proposes bypassing identity checks and duplicate-dispensing controls because electronic access is unavailable.
case_b: After discovering a suspected security incident, staff delete the relevant logs before investigating, calling this cleanup.

pairs.true: An outage does not create a general exemption from identity and duplicate-dispensing safeguards.
pairs.false: Loss of electronic access authorizes bypassing identity and duplicate-dispensing safeguards.
pairs.reason_ko: Downtime에도 처방 진정성·환자 확인·중복 조제 방지가 필요하다.

pairs.true: Incident response should preserve relevant evidence rather than erase the logs needed for investigation.
pairs.false: Deleting the incident logs is a substitute for investigation and required documentation.
pairs.reason_ko: 대응·차단·증거 보존·risk review·통지를 구분한다.

pairs.true: Restoration should include reconciliation of appropriate downtime records.
pairs.false: Restoring the computer eliminates the need to reconcile transactions performed during downtime.
pairs.reason_ko: 복구 후 기록 누락·중복을 확인한다.

pairs.true: A suspected incident must be assessed for the applicable breach and other reporting triggers.
pairs.false: Every suspected incident automatically has the identical external reporting outcome without assessment.
pairs.reason_ko: Incident와 reportable breach의 적용 조건을 별도로 평가한다.

title: Uncollected prescription return to stock
case_a: An uncollected prescription has never left the pharmacy's control, and staff propose pouring the tablets back into the manufacturer's stock bottle.
case_b: Instead, staff consider keeping an eligible return-to-stock supply in its patient container or another appropriate labeled container.

pairs.true: The uncollected tablets must not be returned to the manufacturer's stock bottle under the stated RTS rule.
pairs.false: Uncollected tablets may be poured into the manufacturer's bottle because the patient never received them.
pairs.reason_ko: 미교부 RTS 허용과 manufacturer bottle에 되붓기 금지는 함께 적용된다.

pairs.true: An eligible RTS container must retain the required identification and the expiration assigned at initial filling.
pairs.false: A new RTS container permits removal of product identification and assignment of a fresh expiration.
pairs.reason_ko: Product·strength·manufacturer/supplier 또는 NDC·원 filling expiry를 유지한다.

pairs.true: The pharmacy needs an RTS policy and procedure.
pairs.false: An occasional RTS transaction is exempt from the described written procedure requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: RTS에 관한 P&P 의무를 확인한다.

pairs.true: A prepared but uncollected prescription differs from medicine already dispensed to a patient.
pairs.false: Medicine returned by a patient is automatically eligible for exactly the same RTS pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 약국 통제 아래 미교부 약과 환자에게 교부 후 반환 약을 구별한다.

title: Error or suspected defect returned by a patient
case_a: A patient brings back medication that this pharmacy dispensed to the wrong person; the pharmacy refuses to accept it solely because it has crossed the counter.
case_b: After accepting the medication, staff propose adding it to ordinary inventory for another patient.

pairs.true: The described Massachusetts rule requires the dispensing pharmacy to accept medication it dispensed in error.
pairs.false: Crossing the counter eliminates the pharmacy's duty to accept its own dispensing-error medication.
pairs.reason_ko: 오류 조제 또는 defective·contaminated 의심 약의 해당 수령 의무를 확인한다.

pairs.true: The accepted medication must be quarantined and lawfully disposed of rather than returned to saleable inventory.
pairs.false: Acceptance of the error return authorizes its resale to another patient.
pairs.reason_ko: 수령·격리·적법 폐기와 일반 재고 복귀는 다르다.

pairs.true: A suspected defect or contamination can trigger the described acceptance pathway without a completed proof of harm.
pairs.false: The pharmacy must wait for proven patient injury before accepting a suspected defective product.
pairs.reason_ko: 의심 defect·contamination과 확정 injury는 다른 사실이다.

pairs.true: Accepting the return does not complete any separately applicable error response or reporting.
pairs.false: Receiving the medication finishes all otherwise applicable patient-error and reporting duties.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자 보호·CQI·외부 보고 등 trigger를 별도로 검토한다.

title: Ordinary returns and voluntary collection
case_a: A patient wants to return properly dispensed, nondefective medication because it is no longer needed.
case_b: The pharmacy plans to install a general controlled-drug take-back receptacle based only on its existing DEA pharmacy registration.

pairs.true: The described state rule does not generally require accepting every properly dispensed nondefective patient return.
pairs.false: The dispensing pharmacy must accept every nondefective patient return under the same error-return rule.
pairs.reason_ko: 정상 교부 후 단순 불필요 반환과 오류·defect 수령 의무를 구별한다.

pairs.true: General controlled-drug collection requires the applicable collector authorization and method conditions.
pairs.false: An ordinary DEA pharmacy registration by itself authorizes every take-back receptacle.
pairs.reason_ko: Collector modification·장소·방법 조건을 별도로 충족한다.

pairs.true: A voluntary disposal-collection service does not turn returned drugs into saleable stock.
pairs.false: Operating a take-back service permits collected patient drugs to be reused as stock.
pairs.reason_ko: Disposal collection과 재판매 재고 취득은 다른 행위이다.

pairs.true: The specific obligation to accept an error return differs from a universal obligation to operate a public collection program.
pairs.false: The error-return duty requires every pharmacy to operate a public collection program.
pairs.reason_ko: 개별 반환 의무와 자발적인 collection service 운영을 혼동하지 않는다.

title: Same-patient multidrug package modification
case_a: This pharmacy previously dispensed a multidrug package, and the patient's therapy changes before all doses are used.
case_b: A pharmacist removes a discontinued medicine and proposes using those removed tablets for another patient because they remain identifiable.

pairs.true: The described pathway permits appropriate modification and re-dispensing of that pharmacy's package to the same patient.
pairs.false: Any therapy change requires discarding every remaining drug in that pharmacy's package with no allowed same-patient pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 조건을 갖춘 same-patient repackaging 경로와 무조건 전체 폐기를 구별한다.

pairs.true: Removed medication may not be transferred into general stock or dispensed to a different patient.
pairs.false: Identifiable removed tablets may be assigned to another patient as ordinary stock.
pairs.reason_ko: 제거한 약을 다른 환자·general inventory에 사용하는 것은 허용 경로가 아니다.

pairs.true: The pharmacy must record the repackaging, removal, re-dispensing, and responsible pharmacist.
pairs.false: The original dispensing record alone accounts for every later package modification.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 변경 수량·제거·재교부·담당 약사를 추적한다.

pairs.true: The revised labels and directions must match the actual revised package.
pairs.false: The original label can remain unchanged after its listed drug is removed or replaced.
pairs.reason_ko: Package 내용·label·directions·records의 일치를 유지한다.

title: Repackaging does not restart stability
case_a: A returned same-patient package contains a medicine whose applicable expiration arrives in 12 days; staff plan to assign a new 60-day period after repackaging.
case_b: The revised package has individually removable cells with no medication name or strength on the cells.

pairs.true: Repackaging cannot extend the medicine past its applicable shorter expiration or stability limit.
pairs.false: Moving the medicine into a fresh package restarts a new 60-day stability period.
pairs.reason_ko: 새 포장일이 원 expiry·shorter stability를 초기화하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The removable cells must carry the required identification rather than relying only on the outer box.
pairs.false: A correct outer-box label makes identification on removable cells unnecessary.
pairs.reason_ko: 분리되는 cell에서도 약명·strength 등을 식별해야 한다.

pairs.true: The packaging maximum is a ceiling, not a guarantee that every contained medicine is stable that long.
pairs.false: A 60-day packaging maximum proves 60 days of stability for every drug.
pairs.reason_ko: 허용 최대치와 개별 제품 안정성은 다르다.

pairs.true: A therapy change requires checking both the medication content and the updated patient instructions.
pairs.false: Updating instructions alone is sufficient even if discontinued tablets remain in the pack.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 pack 변경과 정보 변경을 연결한다.

title: Recall traceability and returned shipments
case_a: An RTS container may contain a recalled lot, but the pharmacy cannot confirm that it is outside the recall.
case_b: A delivery is returned after an uncertain temperature history, and staff assume the sealed outer package proves the product remained suitable.

pairs.true: The potentially affected RTS medicine cannot be re-dispensed until the pharmacy confirms it is not within the recalled lot.
pairs.false: Uncertain lot identity permits dispensing if the container was originally filled before the recall notice.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 lot가 아니라는 확인 전에는 potentially affected RTS를 교부하지 않는다.

pairs.true: An intact outer package does not by itself establish acceptable temperature exposure and product integrity.
pairs.false: Sealed outer packaging conclusively proves acceptable temperature history.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 보관·온도·무결성 근거를 검토한다.

pairs.true: A failed delivery, an uncollected pharmacy prescription, and a patient return are distinct custody situations.
pairs.false: Every returned package has the same legal custody and reuse status.
pairs.reason_ko: 반환 전 custody와 환자 교부 여부를 먼저 분류한다.

pairs.true: Carrier involvement does not by itself eliminate all pharmacy responsibilities for a lost or misdirected shipment.
pairs.false: Any carrier loss makes all investigation and applicable reporting solely the carrier's responsibility.
pairs.reason_ko: 인계·계약·실제 구간에 따른 책임과 필요한 환자 보호를 확인한다.

title: Sealed collection liners
case_a: An authorized collector removes and seals an inner liner, then proposes opening it to count tablets and calculate an exact drug inventory.
case_b: An employee notices an expensive package inside and proposes recovering it for the pharmacy's stock.

pairs.true: The sealed collection liner must not be opened to sort or count its contents.
pairs.false: An authorized collector may reopen the liner to perform an ordinary tablet inventory.
pairs.reason_ko: Sealed liner collection은 일반 pharmacy inventory count와 다른 절차이다.

pairs.true: Collected patient medication is not a supply source for the pharmacy's saleable inventory.
pairs.false: Identifiable medicine recovered from a collection liner may be returned to saleable stock.
pairs.reason_ko: Disposal 목적으로 취득한 mixed returns는 재사용 stock이 아니다.

pairs.true: Required unique identification and transfer or destruction records concern the liner's controlled handling.
pairs.false: Sealing a liner eliminates its identification and movement-record requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: 봉인 뒤에도 liner 추적·보안·적법한 처리 기록을 유지한다.

pairs.true: Mail-back collection requires the designated authorized recipient and qualifying package process.
pairs.false: Mailing controlled drugs in any envelope to any pharmacy is a compliant mail-back program.
pairs.reason_ko: 적격 prepaid·identified package와 authorized recipient 조건을 확인한다.

title: Two LTCF collection clocks
case_a: Under an authorized LTCF collection arrangement, a resident's medication is discontinued, triggering the specified timely disposal-transfer process.
case_b: On a later date, a sealed inner liner is removed from the receptacle and stored under the specified secure conditions.

pairs.true: The resident-medication clock relates to the discontinuation or other specified resident event.
pairs.false: The resident-medication clock begins only when an unrelated liner is later removed.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자 사건 뒤 즉시 또는 늦어도 3 business days라는 경로를 구별한다.

pairs.true: The removed-liner storage clock begins at removal rather than the earlier resident event.
pairs.false: The removed-liner clock starts at the resident's original prescription date.
pairs.reason_ko: Liner removal 후 최대 3 business days의 별도 secure storage 시계이다.

pairs.true: The two three-business-day rules have different subjects and triggers.
pairs.false: The shared number means the two rules are one combined deadline.
pairs.reason_ko: 숫자가 같아도 주체·행위·trigger가 다르면 별도 의무이다.

pairs.true: Liner installation and removal must use the specifically authorized personnel or witness combination.
pairs.false: Any two people present satisfy the permitted witness combination regardless of their roles.
pairs.reason_ko: Collector·LTCF supervisory 인력의 실제 적격 조합을 확인한다.

title: Professional scope and registration are separate
case_a: A prescription contains a mathematically valid DEA number, but the pharmacist has not confirmed the prescriber's current registration or authority for the treatment.
case_b: An employee concludes that the title 'doctor' establishes unrestricted prescribing authority for any patient, drug, or professional purpose.

pairs.true: A valid-looking DEA number does not establish current registration, identity, or scope.
pairs.false: A correct DEA check digit conclusively establishes the prescriber's current legal authority.
pairs.reason_ko: 번호 형식과 실제 등록 유효성·신원·허용 schedule·scope는 별개이다.

pairs.true: The professional's actual license and authorized scope must match the proposed treatment.
pairs.false: The title 'doctor' supplies unrestricted prescribing scope for every drug and patient.
pairs.reason_ko: 직종·관할 면허·환자·질환·약물에 대한 실제 권한을 확인한다.

pairs.true: DEA and Massachusetts controlled-substance registration requirements must be considered separately.
pairs.false: A DEA registration replaces every applicable Massachusetts controlled-substance registration.
pairs.reason_ko: DEA와 MCSR은 다른 체계이다.

pairs.true: A lawful institutional-number pathway must satisfy its own authorization and internal-code conditions.
pairs.false: Any hospital employee may prescribe using the hospital DEA number merely by wearing its badge.
pairs.reason_ko: 기관 번호·internal code 경로는 적격 practitioner와 허용 조건을 갖춰야 한다.

title: Corresponding responsibility and red-flag resolution
case_a: A controlled-substance prescription contains every required field, but information available to the pharmacist materially contradicts the claimed treatment purpose.
case_b: A second prescription presents one unusual feature that can have a legitimate explanation, and staff propose labeling the patient fraudulent without review.

pairs.true: Completed fields do not remove the pharmacist's corresponding responsibility to evaluate legitimacy.
pairs.false: All required fields being present conclusively establishes a legitimate prescription.
pairs.reason_ko: 형식 완결성과 legitimate medical purpose는 다른 판단이다.

pairs.true: A single unusual feature should be evaluated rather than treated as conclusive proof of fraud.
pairs.false: One unusual feature conclusively proves that every such patient is committing fraud.
pairs.reason_ko: 신호 하나로 단정하지 않고 실제 사실관계를 검토한다.

pairs.true: The pharmacist should use appropriate information and document the resolution of a material concern.
pairs.false: An unexplained concern may be erased from the record once payment is approved.
pairs.reason_ko: 보험 승인과 concern 해결·기록은 다르다.

pairs.true: The prescriber's primary responsibility and the dispensing pharmacist's responsibility coexist.
pairs.false: The prescriber's signature transfers all legal responsibility away from the pharmacist.
pairs.reason_ko: Prescriber 책임과 pharmacist corresponding responsibility가 함께 남는다.

title: Patient prescription versus office stock
case_a: A practitioner writes a prescription using a patient's name but intends the medication to replenish general office stock for unrelated patients.
case_b: The pharmacy considers an actual registrant-to-registrant supply transaction and asks whether patient-prescription paperwork alone is sufficient.

pairs.true: The general office-stock purpose is not made a legitimate patient prescription by adding a patient's name.
pairs.false: Adding any patient name converts a general office-stock order into a lawful patient prescription.
pairs.reason_ko: Ultimate-user prescription과 office-stock distribution의 목적을 구별한다.

pairs.true: The stock transaction requires the applicable distribution, registration, ordering, and record pathway.
pairs.false: Patient-prescription paperwork alone supplies every authorization for registrant stock distribution.
pairs.reason_ko: Stock 공급에는 별도 거래·등록·기록 조건이 적용된다.

pairs.true: A specific patient-product delivery exception must be evaluated on its own scope.
pairs.false: An exception for one patient-specific injectable authorizes general office stock for every drug.
pairs.reason_ko: 특정 환자용 특수 경로를 일반 stock 허가로 확대하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Dispensing, prescription-information transfer, and stock distribution are different transactions.
pairs.false: Moving a stock bottle to another pharmacy is the same transaction as transferring refill information.
pairs.reason_ko: 처방정보와 실물 재고의 이동을 구별한다.

title: Required prescription fields and original dates
case_a: A controlled prescription is dated with the day the patient plans to fill it rather than the day the prescriber actually issues and signs it.
case_b: A pharmacy treats a prescriber's signature as a default no-substitution instruction, although no separate such instruction exists.

pairs.true: The actual issue date and any separate earliest-fill instruction must be distinguished.
pairs.false: The planned pickup date may replace the actual issue date as an ordinary formatting preference.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 발행일과 future earliest-fill 지시는 다른 항목이다.

pairs.true: The signature alone is not the separate no-substitution instruction.
pairs.false: A prescriber signature automatically constitutes a no-substitution direction.
pairs.reason_ko: No-substitution은 독립된 요소이며 signature·default로 대신하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The prescription must identify the actual medication, strength, form, quantity, and directions as required.
pairs.false: Listing only a therapeutic class necessarily supplies the required medication information.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 처방의 drug·strength·form·quantity·directions를 확인한다.

pairs.true: Specified EPT or naloxone identifier exceptions differ from unexplained omission of ordinary required information.
pairs.false: Any missing patient information is valid simply because some public-health prescriptions have exceptions.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 적용되는 법정 예외인지 확인한다.

title: Original transmission form and EPCS
case_a: A pharmacy scans a signed paper controlled prescription and calls the resulting image an original electronic controlled-substance prescription.
case_b: A prescriber sends a photograph of a prescription by ordinary text message and staff assume that any electronic delivery satisfies EPCS requirements.

pairs.true: Scanning paper changes its storage form, not its original prescription-transmission category.
pairs.false: Scanning a paper prescription retroactively makes it an originally issued EPCS.
pairs.reason_ko: 저장 형식과 원 발행·전송 방식은 다르다.

pairs.true: An ordinary text-message photograph is not automatically compliant EPCS.
pairs.false: Every prescription image received through an electronic device is compliant EPCS.
pairs.reason_ko: 적격 application·identity·signing·전송·보존 조건을 확인한다.

pairs.true: An agent's transmission role does not permit using the prescriber's credentials to sign as the prescriber.
pairs.false: An authorized agent may sign EPCS with the prescriber's personal credentials as ordinary transmission assistance.
pairs.reason_ko: 정보 전달 권한과 prescriber 인증 서명을 구분한다.

pairs.true: Permitted corrections must preserve the original record and an appropriate authorization trail.
pairs.false: A pharmacist may overwrite the original signed electronic order to make a later change appear original.
pairs.reason_ko: 수정 내용·authorizing communication·pharmacist action의 추적성을 유지한다.

title: Electronic-prescribing exceptions
case_a: During a qualifying temporary power failure, an otherwise valid paper prescription is issued under an applicable electronic-prescribing exception.
case_b: A prescriber with an electronic-prescribing waiver proposes an ordinary oral Schedule II refill without satisfying an emergency pathway.

pairs.true: An applicable electronic-prescribing exception may permit another lawful format while other conditions remain.
pairs.false: A paper prescription is necessarily invalid even when an applicable electronic-prescribing exception exists.
pairs.reason_ko: Electronic 원칙과 적격 paper/oral exception을 함께 읽는다.

pairs.true: The waiver does not create an ordinary oral Schedule II refill authority.
pairs.false: An electronic-prescribing waiver authorizes an ordinary oral Schedule II refill.
pairs.reason_ko: Format 예외가 CII emergency·no-refill 조건을 삭제하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The pharmacist's specific exception-verification relief does not waive authenticity or prescriber-authority review.
pairs.false: Not having to verify the EP exception eliminates every prescription-legitimacy check.
pairs.reason_ko: Waiver 확인과 처방 진정성·권한 확인은 다르다.

pairs.true: An expired historical LTCF exception must not be assumed to cover every later prescription.
pairs.false: An LTCF exception with a past endpoint remains universally available without a verified extension.
pairs.reason_ko: 과거 적용기한·추가 연장·다른 실제 예외를 구별한다.

title: Changes that need a new prescription
case_a: A patient asks the pharmacy to change a controlled prescription to a different family member and to replace a missing prescriber signature itself.
case_b: A Schedule II patient wants the pharmacy to move an existing earliest-fill date earlier without a new prescription.

pairs.true: Changing the patient identity or supplying the prescriber's signature is outside the stated pharmacy correction pathway.
pairs.false: The pharmacy may change the patient and supply the signature if the family agrees.
pairs.reason_ko: Patient identity·prescriber signature 등 변경 불가 핵심 항목을 구분한다.

pairs.true: The stated Schedule II earliest-fill change requires a new lawful prescription.
pairs.false: The pharmacy may move the earliest-fill date earlier as a routine clerical correction.
pairs.reason_ko: CII earliest-fill date 변경을 임의 보완으로 처리하지 않는다.

pairs.true: A permitted generic substitution is different from replacing the prescribed drug with a different therapy.
pairs.false: Every change of active therapy is a lawful generic substitution.
pairs.reason_ko: 적법한 interchange와 약물 자체 변경은 다르다.

pairs.true: An allowed addition of a missing issue date does not authorize rewriting an existing date.
pairs.false: Permission to add a missing issue date permits changing an already written issue date.
pairs.reason_ko: 추가와 기존 값 변경을 구별한다.

title: Consultation, limited additions, and recording changes
case_a: A pharmacist proposes changing a Schedule II strength after speaking only with an office employee, relying on a policy clause that permits an agent to confirm an address.
case_b: A Schedule VI patient requests a days-supply adjustment involving gabapentin, and staff treat it as the policy's ordinary non-PMP Schedule VI adjustment pathway.

pairs.true: The address-related agent provision does not establish agent authority for the Schedule II strength change.
pairs.false: An agent permitted to confirm an address may authorize every Schedule II strength change under the same clause.
pairs.reason_ko: CII 일반 clinical change의 prescriber consultation과 특정 주소 경로를 구분한다.

pairs.true: Gabapentin cannot be treated as an ordinary non-PMP drug for a pathway expressly excluding PMP drugs.
pairs.false: Gabapentin qualifies for the non-PMP-only adjustment pathway because Massachusetts calls it Schedule VI.
pairs.reason_ko: VI와 PMP-reportable Additional Drug 상태를 함께 적용한다.

pairs.true: An authorized correction requires a record of the change, date, responsible pharmacist, and applicable authorization.
pairs.false: The unexplained notation 'MD OK' necessarily records every required detail of a change.
pairs.reason_ko: 어떤 항목을 언제 누가 허용·수행했는지 추적한다.

pairs.true: Adding a permitted missing registration number still requires correct identification of the actual prescriber.
pairs.false: Permission to add a missing number allows using any plausible registration number.
pairs.reason_ko: 추가 가능성이 신원·실제 번호 확인의 면제는 아니다.

title: Schedule II refill and partial-fill distinction
case_a: An oxycodone prescription is marked with two refills, and the pharmacy proposes treating the written refill count as sufficient authority.
case_b: A colleague mistakes a lawful partial supply from the original authorized quantity for an additional refill.

pairs.true: A prescriber's written refill count does not create Schedule II refill authority.
pairs.false: The prescriber's written count makes two Schedule II refills permissible.
pairs.reason_ko: CII no-refill 원칙은 처방자가 refill을 적었다고 바뀌지 않는다.

pairs.true: A lawful partial supply uses the original authorization rather than creating a refill.
pairs.false: Every partial supply is an additional refill prohibited solely because it is Schedule II.
pairs.reason_ko: Partial fill과 refill의 법적 구조를 구분한다.

pairs.true: A new lawful prescription is distinct from a refill of the old Schedule II order.
pairs.false: A new Schedule II prescription is legally the same transaction as refilling the old prescription.
pairs.reason_ko: 새 authorization과 기존 Rx refill을 혼동하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Electronic storage does not remove the pharmacist's final validation responsibility.
pairs.false: An electronic Schedule II prescription needs no pharmacist final validation.
pairs.reason_ko: EPCS에서도 해당 final validation 책임이 남는다.

title: Validity versus days supply
case_a: A Massachusetts Schedule II prescription otherwise eligible for a 90-day supply is presented for the first time 40 days after issuance; no alternative order pathway applies.
case_b: Staff argue that the allowable 90-day quantity also creates 90 days in which to begin filling the prescription.

pairs.true: The first-fill proposal exceeds the described Massachusetts 30-day Schedule II validity rule.
pairs.false: The prescription remains valid on day 40 merely because its quantity could cover 90 days.
pairs.reason_ko: 30일 prescription validity와 허용되는 days supply를 구별한다.

pairs.true: A quantity allowance does not lengthen the original prescription-validity clock.
pairs.false: A 90-day quantity allowance extends the prescription's validity to 90 days.
pairs.reason_ko: 공급량 한도가 처방 사용 기한을 바꾸지 않는다.

pairs.true: Issue date remains the relevant starting fact for the stated validity rule.
pairs.false: The first attempted pickup date restarts the stated validity period.
pairs.reason_ko: 시계의 시작점은 original issue date이다.

pairs.true: An otherwise permissible quantity still requires a currently valid prescription.
pairs.false: A permitted quantity cures an expired prescription.
pairs.reason_ko: 한 요건 충족이 다른 요건의 결함을 해결하지 않는다.

title: Non-opioid Schedule II and III supply allowance
case_a: A valid methylphenidate prescription authorizes an otherwise appropriate 90-day supply, and staff insist the allowance is limited only to an old diagnosis-specific summary.
case_b: A valid testosterone prescription is categorized as requiring a 30-day ceiling solely because it is Schedule III.

pairs.true: The current described non-opioid category is not restricted to the obsolete diagnosis-only summary.
pairs.false: A non-opioid 90-day allowance requires relying exclusively on an obsolete ADHD-or-narcolepsy summary.
pairs.reason_ko: 현행 category와 과거 특정 diagnosis 중심 요약을 구별한다.

pairs.true: Schedule III status alone does not exclude testosterone from the described non-opioid category.
pairs.false: Every Schedule III prescription is limited to 30 days solely because of its schedule.
pairs.reason_ko: Schedule·opioid 여부·실제 category를 함께 본다.

pairs.true: The allowance does not permit supplying more than the prescriber authorized.
pairs.false: The statutory maximum permits increasing any prescribed quantity to a 90-day amount.
pairs.reason_ko: 법정 최대치와 prescriber-authorized quantity는 별개이다.

pairs.true: The separate validity and any other applicable limits remain in force.
pairs.false: Qualifying for the supply category removes all other prescription-validity limits.
pairs.reason_ko: Supply 경로의 허용이 나머지 유효성·제한을 없애지 않는다.

title: OUD quantity allowance is not dispensing authority
case_a: A pharmacy points to Massachusetts's 90-day OUD-treatment quantity category to justify routine retail dispensing of methadone for OUD.
case_b: Staff compare that proposal with a properly authorized buprenorphine treatment prescription but ignore the drugs' different federal pathways.

pairs.true: The state quantity category does not itself authorize routine retail methadone prescribing and dispensing for OUD.
pairs.false: The state 90-day OUD category establishes routine retail methadone OUD authority.
pairs.reason_ko: 주 days-supply 조항과 연방 OUD 취급 authority는 별개이다.

pairs.true: Buprenorphine and methadone must be assessed under their distinct applicable federal pathways.
pairs.false: Sharing an OUD indication makes buprenorphine and methadone subject to an identical retail pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 동일 indication으로 다른 약물의 규칙을 합치지 않는다.

pairs.true: An implantable-pump quantity category does not prove every compounded product is suitable for the entire duration.
pairs.false: A pump-related quantity allowance guarantees every preparation's full-duration stability.
pairs.reason_ko: Quantity와 해당 preparation BUD·품질은 다른 판단이다.

pairs.true: A general opioid pain prescription does not enter the OUD category merely because it is an opioid.
pairs.false: Any opioid pain prescription automatically qualifies for the OUD-treatment supply category.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 치료 목적과 statutory category를 확인한다.

title: Multiple Schedule II prescriptions
case_a: A prescriber issues several separate Schedule II prescriptions on one date and proposes postdating the later prescriptions' issue dates.
case_b: One prescription has an earliest-fill date 60 days after the actual issuance, and staff rely only on the federal multiple-prescription allowance to use it in Massachusetts.

pairs.true: The prescriptions use their actual issue dates, with separate appropriate earliest-fill instructions.
pairs.false: Later prescriptions may be postdated instead of carrying their actual issue dates.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 발행일과 earliest-fill instruction은 별도 항목이다.

pairs.true: The federal allowance does not eliminate Massachusetts's separately applicable validity limitation.
pairs.false: Federal multiple-prescription permission overrides the Massachusetts validity limit in this scenario.
pairs.reason_ko: 연방 허용과 주 validity 조건을 함께 적용한다.

pairs.true: Separate prescriptions under this pathway are not refills of one Schedule II prescription.
pairs.false: Multiple separate prescriptions are legally refills of one Schedule II prescription.
pairs.reason_ko: 여러 original prescription과 refill을 구분한다.

pairs.true: The federal pathway includes legitimate purpose, diversion-risk assessment, and state-law conditions.
pairs.false: A total of 90 days alone establishes compliance with every condition of the federal pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 90일 총량 외 실제 해당 허용 조건을 충족해야 한다.

title: Emergency oral Schedule II criteria
case_a: A patient wants a Schedule II medicine quickly, but appropriate alternative treatment is available and a lawful written prescription can reasonably be supplied before dispensing.
case_b: Another case involves an electronic-system outage, and staff assume the outage alone satisfies every federal emergency-oral criterion.

pairs.true: Convenience does not meet the combined federal emergency criteria described in the notes.
pairs.false: A patient's desire for rapid pickup is by itself a qualifying oral Schedule II emergency.
pairs.reason_ko: 즉시 필요·적절한 대체 없음·사전 written 제공의 합리적 불가능이라는 조건을 함께 확인한다.

pairs.true: An electronic outage does not by itself establish every oral-emergency condition.
pairs.false: Any electronic outage is automatically a qualifying oral Schedule II emergency.
pairs.reason_ko: Paper exception과 oral CII emergency를 구분한다.

pairs.true: The emergency quantity is limited to what is adequate for the emergency period.
pairs.false: Every qualifying oral Schedule II emergency authorizes a fixed seven-day quantity.
pairs.reason_ko: Emergency-period adequate amount이지 모든 사례의 고정 7일분이 아니다.

pairs.true: The emergency pathway does not create refill authority for the Schedule II prescription.
pairs.false: An oral emergency converts Schedule II into a refillable prescription.
pairs.reason_ko: 응급 format 허용과 no-refill 원칙은 다른 조건이다.

title: Emergency caller and pharmacy recipient
case_a: For a proposed federal emergency oral Schedule II prescription, the prescriber's receptionist calls a certified technician instead of the prescribing practitioner speaking to the pharmacist.
case_b: A central-fill pharmacy proposes accepting the emergency oral prescription directly under the ordinary retail emergency pathway.

pairs.true: The specified federal emergency pathway requires the prescribing individual practitioner to authorize the pharmacist.
pairs.false: The receptionist-to-technician call satisfies that specific emergency authorization pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 일반 agent 전달·CPhT III–VI 수신과 emergency CII 직접 practitioner-to-pharmacist를 구별한다.

pairs.true: The federal emergency-oral provision does not allow the central-fill pharmacy to receive it through that pathway.
pairs.false: A central-fill pharmacy may accept the emergency oral Schedule II order through the same retail pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: §1306.11(d)의 central-fill 제한을 유지한다.

pairs.true: The pharmacist must promptly reduce the required oral information to a record.
pairs.false: The pharmacist may dispense first and postpone all oral-order recording until the follow-up arrives.
pairs.reason_ko: 최초 oral authorization의 필수 정보를 즉시 기록한다.

pairs.true: An unfamiliar prescriber requires reasonable authenticity verification.
pairs.false: An unknown caller's assertion of being a prescriber removes the need for authenticity verification.
pairs.reason_ko: 모르는 prescriber의 진정성을 합리적 방법으로 확인한다.

title: Federal emergency follow-up clock
case_a: An emergency oral Schedule II order is authorized on Monday, but the first quantity is dispensed Tuesday; the pharmacy starts the federal follow-up clock on Tuesday.
case_b: After the federal follow-up period expires without the required prescription, staff merely write 'not received' in the file.

pairs.true: The federal follow-up clock starts with oral authorization rather than the later dispensing date.
pairs.false: The federal follow-up clock begins only when the first quantity is dispensed.
pairs.reason_ko: 이 문항은 federal follow-up의 clock를 묻는다. MA 별도 더 이른 의무의 통합 결론을 내리지 않는다.

pairs.true: Failure to receive the required follow-up triggers the stated DEA notification duty.
pairs.false: A file note alone replaces the DEA notification required for a missing follow-up.
pairs.reason_ko: 후속 미수령 기록과 DEA 통지는 다른 행동이다.

pairs.true: The federal seven-day period must not be lengthened to seven business days.
pairs.false: The federal seven-day period may be treated as seven business days whenever weekends intervene.
pairs.reason_ko: Federal 7 days와 MA 문서의 business-day 표현을 섞지 않는다.

pairs.true: The follow-up covers the emergency quantity and links to the original oral record.
pairs.false: The follow-up prescription authorizes an extra duplicate supply in addition to the emergency quantity.
pairs.reason_ko: 후속 서류는 동일 emergency supply의 기록이며 새 추가 수량이 아니다.

title: Fax-as-original qualifying settings
case_a: A valid Schedule II prescription is faxed for a resident of a qualifying long-term-care facility.
case_b: A separate hospice fax concerns a Schedule II nonnarcotic drug, and staff invoke the hospice-narcotic exception without considering whether another lawful pathway applies.

pairs.true: The described federal LTCF fax-as-original route is not limited to narcotic Schedule II drugs.
pairs.false: The described LTCF fax-as-original route applies only to narcotic Schedule II drugs.
pairs.reason_ko: LTCF의 CII 전반 경로와 hospice narcotic 경로를 구분한다.

pairs.true: The hospice-narcotic exception does not itself cover the nonnarcotic prescription in the second case.
pairs.false: The hospice-narcotic exception itself covers every Schedule II drug regardless of narcotic status.
pairs.reason_ko: 특정 exception의 약물 조건을 유지한다. 다른 경로 가능성은 별도이다.

pairs.true: The hospice pathway requires the qualifying hospice status and required indication on the prescription.
pairs.false: Any informal description of comfort care necessarily establishes the qualifying hospice fax pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 지정 hospice와 hospice patient notation 등 조건을 확인한다.

pairs.true: A transmission exception leaves other applicable validity, legitimacy, and record requirements intact.
pairs.false: Fax-as-original status removes all other prescription requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: 형식 예외가 나머지 의무를 없애지 않는다.

title: Compounded infusion fax exception
case_a: A faxed Schedule II narcotic prescription is for a compounded parenteral infusion meeting the specified route and direct-administration conditions.
case_b: Staff extend that exception to any Schedule II injectable product, without checking whether it is a narcotic or a qualifying compounded infusion.

pairs.true: The first case must be evaluated under the specific compounded-infusion fax exception.
pairs.false: A qualifying compounded-infusion prescription can never use the specified fax-as-original route.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 narcotic·compounded infusion·지정 투여 조건의 예외를 확인한다.

pairs.true: The exception's narcotic and compounded-infusion conditions cannot be omitted in the second case.
pairs.false: Any Schedule II injectable automatically qualifies without the narcotic or compounding conditions.
pairs.reason_ko: 주사제라는 한 특징만으로 exception 전체를 충족하지 않는다.

pairs.true: A qualifying route includes the specified IV, IM, SC, or intraspinal infusion context.
pairs.false: The fax exception applies to any oral tablet merely because the patient also receives an infusion.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 처방의 제형·route·목적을 일치시킨다.

pairs.true: The exception is about transmission rather than creating refills or extending supply limits.
pairs.false: Meeting the infusion fax exception permits otherwise prohibited Schedule II refills.
pairs.reason_ko: Fax original과 refill·supply는 다른 법적 판단이다.

title: Shortage remainder clock
case_a: A pharmacy provides a shortage-based Schedule II partial fill on Monday at 2 p.m.; all remaining conditions are valid, and the remainder is available Thursday at noon.
case_b: For a second shortage-based partial fill, the remainder becomes available 80 hours after the first partial dispensing.

pairs.true: Thursday at noon is within 72 hours of the first case's Monday 2 p.m. partial fill.
pairs.false: Thursday at noon is outside 72 hours of the first case's Monday 2 p.m. partial fill.
pairs.reason_ko: 가상 시간 계산은 70시간이다. Shortage 경로는 first partial filling부터 계산한다.

pairs.true: The second case requires the stated prescriber notice and a new prescription for further supply beyond 72 hours.
pairs.false: The second remainder may be supplied at 80 hours merely because the original prescription has not otherwise expired.
pairs.reason_ko: Shortage 72시간 초과 후 추가 공급을 일반 validity 잔여기간으로 허용하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The shortage clock does not start at the original prescription's earlier issue date.
pairs.false: The shortage clock necessarily starts at the issue date instead of the first partial fill.
pairs.reason_ko: 다른 requested-partial 경로의 clock와 구별한다.

pairs.true: A later shipment does not restart the shortage remainder clock.
pairs.false: Receiving new inventory starts a fresh 72-hour remainder period.
pairs.reason_ko: 약국 입고 시점이 기존 partial authorization의 시계를 초기화하지 않는다.

title: Actual reason for partial filling
case_a: A Schedule II supply was partially dispensed solely because of pharmacy stock shortage, with no actual patient or prescriber request for the alternative request-based pathway.
case_b: After 72 hours passes, staff relabel the original transaction as patient-requested solely to claim a longer remainder window.

pairs.true: The original facts support the shortage pathway rather than an invented patient request.
pairs.false: A shortage transaction automatically proves a patient request for the alternative pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 authorization·요청·기록으로 경로를 구분한다.

pairs.true: A retrospective label change does not establish an actual qualifying request that did not occur.
pairs.false: Relabeling the transaction after the deadline creates the missing patient request.
pairs.reason_ko: 기한을 늘리기 위한 사후 사실 변경은 적법한 요청이 아니다.

pairs.true: A genuinely authorized request must be documented and evaluated under its own conditions.
pairs.false: The alternative pathway requires no evidence of who requested the partial fill.
pairs.reason_ko: 요청 주체·내용·시점과 각 partial 기록을 연결한다.

pairs.true: All partial supplies remain constrained by the authorized total quantity.
pairs.false: Changing the partial-fill category permits increasing the total quantity beyond the original authorization.
pairs.reason_ko: 경로가 무엇이든 authorized total을 초과할 수 없다.

title: Requested partial and authorized requester
case_a: An adult patient requests less than the prescribed Schedule II quantity on day 20 after issuance, and the pharmacy begins a qualifying request-based partial fill.
case_b: A casual pickup agent asks for a larger partial amount than the prescriber specified and claims that pickup authority is sufficient.

pairs.true: The general request-based remainder clock is tied to issuance, not a new 30 days from day 20.
pairs.false: The first requested partial on day 20 creates a new 30-day remainder window.
pairs.reason_ko: 일반 requested partial remainder는 written issue부터 30일 조건이다.

pairs.true: Pickup status alone does not establish the specified request authority or permission to exceed the prescriber's partial amount.
pairs.false: Any pickup agent may increase a prescriber-specified partial amount.
pairs.reason_ko: Minor parent/guardian·성인 MPOA caregiver 등 적격 requester와 prescriber limit를 확인한다.

pairs.true: The initial partial and each remainder must be recorded with the relevant quantities and dates.
pairs.false: Only the final remainder needs to be recorded because all supplies use one prescription.
pairs.reason_ko: 각 actual dispensing을 원 Rx와 연결해 추적한다.

pairs.true: The prescriber's partial-fill language does not prove that a patient actually made a request.
pairs.false: A printed partial-fill notice establishes a patient request even when no request occurred.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자에게 알리는 notation과 실제 request는 다르다.

title: Emergency requested partial and same pharmacy
case_a: An emergency oral Schedule II prescription is partially filled at the patient's request, and staff apply the ordinary nonemergency 30-day requested-partial window.
case_b: A Massachusetts patient asks a different pharmacy in the same chain to provide a remainder after an initial requested partial fill at the first pharmacy.

pairs.true: The federal emergency-oral requested-partial remainder limit is 72 hours from issuance rather than the ordinary 30-day period.
pairs.false: A patient request extends an emergency oral Schedule II remainder to the ordinary 30-day window.
pairs.reason_ko: Emergency oral request pathway는 issue부터 72시간으로 구별한다.

pairs.true: The described Massachusetts requested-remainder pathway requires the same dispensing pharmacy.
pairs.false: The same chain name makes every location the same pharmacy for the requested remainder.
pairs.reason_ko: Same pharmacy와 shared company/system을 동일시하지 않는다.

pairs.true: A partly dispensed Schedule II order is not an initially unfilled EPCS for the one-time initial-transfer pathway.
pairs.false: Any remaining quantity counts as an initially unfilled EPCS eligible for initial transfer.
pairs.reason_ko: 이미 quantity가 공급된 처방과 original unfilled electronic 처방은 다르다.

pairs.true: The two 72-hour pathways must be distinguished by their different starting events.
pairs.false: Shortage and emergency requested partial use one identical starting event merely because both say 72 hours.
pairs.reason_ko: Shortage first partial과 emergency request issue의 trigger를 구분한다.

title: Out-of-state initial window and remainder
case_a: An otherwise eligible out-of-state Schedule II prescription is first presented on day 8 after issuance, and staff attempt to use the general 30-day rule instead of the applicable initial five-day rule.
case_b: A different eligible out-of-state prescription had a lawful requested initial partial fill within the five-day window, and a remainder is sought at the same pharmacy within 30 days of issuance.

pairs.true: The first prescription cannot be revived by replacing the applicable initial five-day condition with the general 30-day rule.
pairs.false: The general 30-day rule eliminates the out-of-state initial five-day condition in the first case.
pairs.reason_ko: 최초 사용 window와 일반 validity를 구별한다.

pairs.true: The second remainder is evaluated using the separate issuance-based remainder clock and other conditions.
pairs.false: Every out-of-state requested remainder must be completed within the initial five-day window.
pairs.reason_ko: 최초 five-day 조건과 lawful started partial의 remainder 조건은 다르다.

pairs.true: The remainder period is not a fresh 30 days from the initial partial fill.
pairs.false: A lawful initial partial starts a fresh 30-day remainder period.
pairs.reason_ko: Original issue date의 시계를 유지한다.

pairs.true: The special initial five-day rule should not be copied onto every ordinary Massachusetts-issued requested partial.
pairs.false: Every Massachusetts-issued Schedule II requested partial must begin within five days.
pairs.reason_ko: Out-of-state 조문의 적용 범위를 일반 MA 처방에 확대하지 않는다.

title: Narcotic and nonnarcotic interstate paths
case_a: A valid nonnarcotic Schedule II prescription comes from a qualified practitioner in a nonbordering state and is presented within the applicable initial window for Massachusetts pickup.
case_b: A narcotic Schedule II prescription from a state outside the specified Maine-or-bordering-state group is presented for ordinary Massachusetts counter pickup, without a separate applicable exception.

pairs.true: The nonnarcotic pathway is not limited to Maine and Massachusetts-bordering states merely because it is Schedule II.
pairs.false: The first nonnarcotic prescription is categorically excluded solely because its state is not bordering Massachusetts.

pairs.true: The specified opioid or narcotic patient-information duties have their own product and setting conditions.

pairs.reason_ko: 해당 opioid·narcotic 범주와 예외 setting을 확인한다.

pairs.true: A generic pharmacy leaflet is not automatically the Department-designated opioid information.
pairs.false: Any leaflet automatically satisfies the designated opioid-information requirement.

title: Protected-care label and internal record

pairs.true: The exception does not justify applying a Schedule VI pathway to federally scheduled testosterone or deleting the original prescriber record.
