pairs.reason_ko: Testosterone의 CIII 상태와 patient label·원 기록을 구별한다.

pairs.true: A patient-label exception does not remove prescriber-identity and authority verification.
pairs.false: Using a practice name means prescriber-identity verification is no longer necessary.
pairs.reason_ko: 표시 예외와 신원·권한 확인 의무는 별개이다.

pairs.true: Treatment purpose alone does not determine the drug's legal schedule.
pairs.false: Use in gender-affirming care makes every medicine Schedule VI.
pairs.reason_ko: 적응증과 법적 분류를 혼동하지 않는다.

title: Product-level therapeutic equivalence
case_a: A pharmacist substitutes an extended-release product for an immediate-release product solely because the active ingredient name matches.
case_b: Another substitution decision relies on an A-rating somewhere in a product list without matching the relevant reference product and equivalence code.

pairs.true: Matching ingredient names alone does not establish interchangeability across release formulations.
pairs.false: The same active ingredient automatically makes immediate- and extended-release products interchangeable.
pairs.reason_ko: Ingredient·strength·form·route·release와 해당 TE 관계를 함께 확인한다.

pairs.true: The relevant product-code pairing and Massachusetts list framework must be evaluated.
pairs.false: Any A-rated entry proves every product with that ingredient is mutually interchangeable.
pairs.reason_ko: 정확한 reference product·code pairing과 MA additions/exceptions를 확인한다.

pairs.true: Pharmaceutical equivalence and therapeutic equivalence are related but distinct determinations.
pairs.false: The terms pharmaceutical equivalent and therapeutic equivalent have no distinct requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: 적절한 bioequivalence·승인 등 TE 조건을 구별한다.

pairs.true: Insurance payment preference does not establish legal therapeutic equivalence.
pairs.false: The insurer's preferred product is legally interchangeable solely because the claim pays.
pairs.reason_ko: 보험 adjudication과 법적 product selection은 다르다.

title: Less-expensive interchangeable product
case_a: An otherwise applicable Massachusetts brand prescription has no lawful no-substitution direction, and a less-expensive reasonably available interchangeable product is identified.
case_b: After dispensing the substitute, staff leave the label identifying only the originally prescribed product rather than what was actually supplied.

pairs.true: The applicable Massachusetts selection rule must be applied rather than ignored for inventory convenience.
pairs.false: Inventory preference alone removes the applicable less-expensive interchangeable-product rule.
pairs.reason_ko: 정확한 interchangeable product와 statutory selection 조건을 적용한다.

pairs.true: The label must identify the actual product dispensed under the applicable interchange labeling requirements.
pairs.false: The original brand name alone is sufficient even when it conceals the product actually dispensed.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 generic/manufacturer 또는 dispensed brand의 적정 표시가 필요하다.

pairs.true: No-substitution must be a valid separate instruction rather than a default assumption from the signature.
pairs.false: The prescriber's signature automatically cancels the interchange selection rule.
pairs.reason_ko: Signature와 별도 no-substitution 지시를 구분한다.

pairs.true: The dispensing record must retain the actual product identification and transaction details.
pairs.false: The pharmacy can record the prescribed product instead of the actual product for convenience.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 NDC·product·quantity·date·pharmacist 기록을 유지한다.

title: Generic-name order and authorized generic
case_a: A prescription uses a generic drug name without specifying a manufacturer, and staff apply every brand-interchange assumption without reviewing the separate generic-name rule.
case_b: A product is described as an authorized generic marketed under a brand NDA, and staff reject that possibility solely because no separate ANDA entry is found.

pairs.true: The generic-name selection pathway must be read on its own terms and with the prescriber's intent.
pairs.false: A generic-name prescription with no manufacturer must be treated identically to every brand-specific interchange.
pairs.reason_ko: Generic-name Rx의 legally marketed selection과 brand interchange를 구별한다.

pairs.true: An authorized generic may be marketed under the NDA rather than a separate ANDA.
pairs.false: Every authorized generic necessarily has a separate ANDA listing.
pairs.reason_ko: Authorized generic의 규제 경로와 ANDA generic은 다르다.

pairs.true: Actual product correspondence must be verified rather than assumed from the manufacturer name.
pairs.false: A common manufacturer name proves any two products are a brand and its authorized generic.
pairs.reason_ko: 같은 회사라는 사실만으로 제품 대응 관계를 추정하지 않는다.

pairs.true: A listing alone does not prove the product is currently being marketed or available.
pairs.false: Appearance on a listing guarantees current distribution and stock availability.
pairs.reason_ko: 목록 등재와 현재 유통은 다른 사실이다.

title: Emergency interchange documentation
case_a: A genuine medical emergency meets the described exception conditions, and the prescribed no-substitution brand is unavailable while an eligible less-expensive interchangeable product is available.
case_b: The pharmacy uses the exception but omits the emergency date, hour, nature, and purchaser's written acceptance.

pairs.true: The specified emergency pathway must be distinguished from routine disregard of a no-substitution instruction.
pairs.false: No qualifying emergency interchange pathway exists under the described Massachusetts rule.
pairs.reason_ko: 지정 조건의 emergency interchange와 일반 위반을 구별한다.

pairs.true: The emergency record and purchaser's written acceptance are conditions of the described pathway.
pairs.false: An emergency removes the described documentation and written-acceptance requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: Date·hour·nature·purchaser acceptance를 함께 확인한다.

pairs.true: Routine inventory convenience does not by itself establish a medical emergency.
pairs.false: Every out-of-stock situation is automatically a medical emergency.
pairs.reason_ko: 재고 불편과 실제 medical emergency를 분리한다.

pairs.true: A therapeutic change outside legal interchangeability requires its own authorization.
pairs.false: The emergency interchange pathway allows substituting any drug in the same therapeutic class.
pairs.reason_ko: Interchangeable product와 다른 therapy 변경을 구별한다.

title: Biosimilar and interchangeable biologic
case_a: A pharmacy treats approval as a biosimilar as sufficient by itself to establish pharmacist-level substitution authority.
case_b: For an otherwise eligible biological substitution, staff import another state's fixed five-business-day notification rule as the Massachusetts statutory deadline.

pairs.true: Biosimilar approval and the required interchangeability determination are distinct.
pairs.false: Every approved biosimilar is automatically substitutable at the pharmacist level.
pairs.reason_ko: FDA Purple Book의 제품별 interchangeability와 MA 조건을 함께 본다.

pairs.true: The Massachusetts reasonable-time wording should not be replaced by an unsupported other-state fixed number.
pairs.false: Another state's five-business-day rule establishes the Massachusetts deadline.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 주의 실제 조문 표현을 유지한다.

pairs.true: The actual dispensed product must be identified and the required patient written notification provided.
pairs.false: An eligible substitution eliminates actual-product labeling and patient written notification.
pairs.reason_ko: 허용 여부와 후속 label·notification 의무는 별개이다.

pairs.true: A product-specific record minimum does not erase other applicable longer record obligations.
pairs.false: The biological-substitution record rule permits ignoring every other applicable retention rule.
pairs.reason_ko: 겹치는 record requirement를 함께 충족한다.

title: Lesser-price checkout rule
case_a: At checkout, an applicable prescription's retail price is lower than the amount the customer would otherwise pay through the described insurance cost-sharing transaction.
case_b: Staff assume that a paid claim automatically establishes the correct amount to collect without considering the Massachusetts lesser-price requirement.

pairs.true: The applicable lesser-price requirement must be evaluated before collecting the higher amount.
pairs.false: An insurance claim's displayed amount always controls even when the applicable lesser-price requirement says otherwise.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 §21C의 적용 거래와 lesser-price 조건을 확인한다.

pairs.true: Claim approval and legal compliance with the patient-charge rule are different determinations.
pairs.false: A paid claim conclusively proves compliance with the patient-charge rule.
pairs.reason_ko: 보험 결제 승인과 statutory patient charge를 구분한다.

pairs.true: The comparison must use the actual prices relevant to the statutory transaction.
pairs.false: The comparison can substitute an unrelated product's advertised price for the actual transaction.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 처방·거래·비교금액에 법을 적용한다.

pairs.true: The rule should not be generalized into a universal promise that every insurance arrangement or product has identical pricing.
pairs.false: The rule guarantees identical prices for all products and all insurance arrangements.
pairs.reason_ko: 원문의 적용 범위와 특정 상황을 넘어 보편적 가격 보장을 만들지 않는다.

title: Child resistance, tamper evidence, and OTC status
case_a: A pharmacy selects a tamper-evident blister package and assumes its visible opening evidence proves child-resistant performance.
case_b: Staff classify every OTC product as exempt from special packaging without evaluating the listed substance, amount, or formulation.

pairs.true: Tamper evidence and child resistance are distinct packaging properties.
pairs.false: Tamper evidence alone establishes child-resistant performance.
pairs.reason_ko: 개봉 흔적과 어린이 개봉 저항성은 서로 다른 성능이다.

pairs.true: OTC status alone does not establish exemption from special-packaging requirements.
pairs.false: Every OTC product is exempt from special packaging solely because no prescription is needed.
pairs.reason_ko: 규제되는 OTC household substances의 조성·수량 조건을 확인한다.

pairs.true: Child-resistant does not mean childproof.

pairs.reason_ko: 시험된 개봉 저항성을 절대 개봉 불가로 표현하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The actual product and use determine whether a listed requirement or exception applies.
pairs.false: Packaging rules are determined only by the shelf where the product is displayed.
pairs.reason_ko: 제품·제형·함량·사용 목적에 맞는 규정을 확인한다.

title: Patient request and prescriber request
case_a: A patient makes a documented blanket request for non-child-resistant packaging for their own prescriptions.
case_b: A prescriber requests non-child-resistant packaging for one prescription, and staff apply it to every future prescription from every prescriber.

pairs.true: The patient's own blanket request must be distinguished from a request limited to one prescription.
pairs.false: A patient can never make a blanket request concerning their own prescriptions.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자의 실제 요청 범위를 확인한다.

pairs.true: The prescriber's prescription-specific request does not create an unlimited future waiver.
pairs.false: A prescriber request for one prescription automatically covers all future unrelated prescriptions.
pairs.reason_ko: Prescriber의 해당 처방 요청과 환자 blanket request를 구분한다.

pairs.true: Age alone does not establish that the patient requested non-child-resistant packaging.

pairs.reason_ko: 고령이라는 사실은 요청의 증거가 아니다.

pairs.true: The record should identify who requested what scope of packaging exception.
pairs.false: The pharmacy may infer an unlimited waiver from an undocumented single transaction.
pairs.reason_ko: 주체·범위·실제 요청을 확인 가능하게 기록한다.

title: Prednisone package-total exception
case_a: A package contains 21 prednisone 5-mg tablets and no other substance subject to the relevant prescription-drug special-packaging provision.

pairs.reason_ko: Unit-dose와 unit당 50mEq 이하 조건을 함께 본다.

pairs.true: The isosorbide dinitrate exception identifies sublingual or chewable forms at the stated strength limit.

pairs.reason_ko: Sublingual/chewable·10mg 이하라는 조건을 유지한다.

pairs.true: Manufacturer mnemonic-package exceptions do not automatically survive arbitrary pharmacy repackaging.

title: Planner suitability and container performance

pairs.true: The described pharmacy dose-planner pathway does not permit using medication previously dispensed by a different pharmacy.

title: Multidrug packaging limits and content

pairs.true: The pack cannot ignore the shorter stability limit or treat unauthorized liquid mixing as mere packaging.

pairs.reason_ko: 포장 최대치·제품 안정성·compounding authorization을 따로 확인한다.

pairs.true: The maximum 60-day packaging supply is not a new prescription-supply authorization.
pairs.false: A 60-day packaging maximum overrides every shorter prescription supply limit.
pairs.reason_ko: Packaging과 prescribed quantity·schedule-specific limit는 다르다.

pairs.true: Compatibility, container capacity, identification, and tamper-evidence conditions remain applicable.
pairs.false: Correct medication names alone satisfy every compatibility and container condition.
pairs.reason_ko: 포장 내 약물·재료 적합성·용량·식별 조건을 함께 본다.

title: Pseudoephedrine base quantities

pairs.reason_ko: 각 entry의 최소 보존 의무를 유지한다.

pairs.true: Seller self-certification and employee training are distinct from professional pharmacy licensure.

pairs.false: Providing disposal information creates a statutory maximum package quantity not otherwise stated.
pairs.reason_ko: 권고·허용과 확인되지 않은 새 법정 숫자를 구분한다.

title: Distribution percentage denominator

title: Order, loss, and destruction documents

title: DEA initial notice and completed Form 106

pairs.reason_ko: Theft와 quantity-based significant loss 판단을 구분한다.

title: Parallel Massachusetts loss reporting

title: Destruction and reverse distribution
case_a: A pharmacy removes controlled stock from its computer and peels off its labels, then records the medication as physically destroyed.

pairs.true: Compliance with section 503A can provide specified exemptions without FDA approval of the individual compounded product.

pairs.reason_ko: 503A의 조건부 면제와 개별 제품의 FDA 판매승인은 다르다.

pairs.true: The proposed unlimited office-stock plan is not justified by the described patient-specific and limited anticipatory-compounding pathways.
pairs.false: The absence of identified patients is immaterial to an unlimited office-stock plan under section 503A.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자별 처방과 제한적인 anticipatory 경로를 무제한 office stock 제조 허용으로 확대하지 않는다.

pairs.true: An exemption from specified cGMP provisions does not authorize insanitary preparation conditions.
pairs.false: A qualifying cGMP exemption removes the need to avoid insanitary conditions.
pairs.reason_ko: 면제되는 특정 조항과 남는 위생·품질 의무를 구별한다.

pairs.true: Following an approved manufacturer's reconstitution instructions can have a different classification from making a new formulation.
pairs.false: Any preparation performed inside a pharmacy has the same legal classification as a new compounded formulation.
pairs.reason_ko: 제조사 지시대로의 적격 재구성과 새로운 formulation 조제를 같은 행위로 묶지 않는다.

title: Bulk ingredients and the certificate of analysis
case_a: A supplier provides a certificate of analysis for a bulk ingredient, but the pharmacy has not established that the ingredient is eligible for its proposed section 503A use.
case_b: A different container is labeled research use only, yet an employee proposes using it for a patient's injectable preparation because the powder appears identical to a pharmaceutical ingredient.

pairs.true: A certificate of analysis does not by itself establish the ingredient's legal eligibility for the proposed compounding use.
pairs.false: A certificate of analysis is sufficient to establish legal eligibility regardless of the bulk substance's applicable listing status.
pairs.reason_ko: COA와 해당 원료를 법적으로 사용할 수 있는 경로는 별도 점검이다.

pairs.true: The research-use-only material is not justified for the proposed human injectable merely by its appearance.
pairs.false: Visual similarity to a pharmaceutical powder establishes suitability for human injectable compounding.
pairs.reason_ko: Research-use-only 등 용도 제한과 실제 제제·투여경로 적합성을 확인한다.

pairs.true: The applicable bulk-substance pathway, manufacturer registration, and valid analytical documentation must be assessed together.
pairs.false: Manufacturer registration replaces the need to assess the bulk substance's applicable eligibility pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 원료 목록·monograph 등의 적격 경로, 제조자와 COA 요건을 함께 확인한다.

pairs.true: Ingredient lot and expiration information should remain traceable to the actual preparation.
pairs.false: Keeping a supplier's general catalog makes batch-specific ingredient traceability unnecessary.
pairs.reason_ko: 공급업체 일반 정보와 이번 조제에 사용한 실제 lot·expiry 추적은 다르다.

title: Patient-specific difference and a shortage
case_a: A prescriber documents that a patient cannot use a dye in a commercial product and specifies a clinically meaningful individualized alternative.
case_b: An unrelated pharmacy wants to copy a marketed product solely because its own shelf is empty and its proposed copy would cost less; it has not established a current FDA shortage or another applicable exception.

pairs.true: The documented patient-specific difference is relevant to evaluating the permitted compounding pathway.
pairs.false: A documented clinically meaningful difference has no relevance to evaluating a compounded alternative.
pairs.reason_ko: 환자의 의학적 필요에 따른 유의한 차이를 prescriber 문서와 연결한다.

pairs.true: The second pharmacy has not established a permitted copying pathway merely through local stock shortage and price.
pairs.false: Local stock shortage and a lower price establish the described copying exception without additional facts.
pairs.reason_ko: 개별 약국의 재고 부족은 FDA shortage와 같지 않고 가격 차이만으로 유의한 의학적 차이가 되지 않는다.

pairs.true: A shortage-related exception or enforcement policy must be evaluated for the actual product, pathway, and relevant time.
pairs.false: A product's historical shortage establishes a continuing exemption for future copies.
pairs.reason_ko: Shortage의 대상과 시점·조제 경로를 확인하며 과거 상태를 영구 허가로 쓰지 않는다.

pairs.true: The legal assessment remains separate from whether the pharmacy can technically prepare the formulation.
pairs.false: Technical ability to prepare the formula establishes that copying restrictions are satisfied.
pairs.reason_ko: 제조 가능성과 법적 조제 경로 충족은 별개의 판단이다.

title: Complex nonsterile and hazardous manipulation
case_a: A drug-store pharmacy without the applicable complex nonsterile authority plans a preparation classified as complex under the Massachusetts policy.
case_b: The pharmacy proposes crushing hazardous tablets into a suspension using an assessment of risk previously written only for counting intact tablets.

pairs.true: The pharmacy must establish the additional authority required for its actual complex nonsterile activity.
pairs.false: A general drug-store license alone establishes authority for the described complex nonsterile activity.
pairs.reason_ko: Massachusetts의 complex 분류와 필요한 추가 면허를 실제 조제 행위에 적용한다.

pairs.true: The intact-tablet assessment does not establish adequate controls for the proposed crushing and compounding activity.
pairs.false: The intact-tablet assessment covers crushing automatically because the active ingredient is unchanged.
pairs.reason_ko: 같은 성분이라도 manipulation·분진·노출 경로가 달라지면 AOR와 containment를 다시 판단한다.

pairs.true: A change in USP terminology does not itself repeal Massachusetts facility-licensing categories.
pairs.false: Updated USP category terminology automatically eliminates Massachusetts complex-compounding licensure.
pairs.reason_ko: USP의 품질 분류와 주의 법적 면허 분류는 다른 체계다.

pairs.true: The formulation, personnel preparation, facilities, and hazardous-drug controls require a combined assessment.
pairs.false: Obtaining the complex license eliminates the separate need to assess hazardous-drug controls.
pairs.reason_ko: 면허 취득 자체가 적정 시설·훈련·노출 방지 조건을 대신하지 않는다.

title: Flavoring and manufacturer-directed preparation
case_a: A patient's agent requests flavoring of an eligible Schedule VI medication under the described Massachusetts policy pathway.
case_b: A technician proposes using a different diluent and concentration from a kit's manufacturer-approved directions, while continuing to classify the process as unchanged manufacturer-directed reconstitution.

pairs.true: The eligible flavoring pathway still requires evaluation and documentation of stability, compatibility, and therapeutic intent.
pairs.false: Patient-requested flavoring removes the need to consider stability or document the change.
pairs.reason_ko: 허용된 Schedule VI flavoring도 dose·stability·compatibility와 변경 기록을 확인한다.

pairs.true: The changed diluent and concentration prevent assuming that the preparation is the same approved-instructions exception.
pairs.false: The preparation remains within the unchanged-instructions exception whenever the original kit is used.
pairs.reason_ko: Kit 사용 여부보다 실제 제조사 지시를 그대로 지켰는지가 중요하다.

pairs.true: Permission for the specified Schedule VI flavoring pathway should not be extended to every Schedule II–V formulation change.
pairs.false: The Schedule VI flavoring permission also authorizes any formulation change to Schedule II–V medicines.
pairs.reason_ko: 약물 범주와 허용 행위의 조건을 다른 schedule로 확대하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Tablet splitting requires attention to hazardous status, release characteristics, and actual manipulation.
pairs.false: Calling an activity tablet splitting settles its classification without reviewing the product.
pairs.reason_ko: 동작 이름만으로 nonhazardous·modified release·조제 분류를 결정하지 않는다.

title: Formula versus the actual preparation record
case_a: A pharmacy keeps an approved recipe with ingredients, amounts, instructions, packaging, and the basis for its assigned beyond-use date.
case_b: After preparing a batch, the pharmacy has no record of the actual ingredient lots, preparation time, personnel, yield, or checks because staff believe the stored recipe is sufficient.

pairs.true: The approved recipe serves a master-formulation function rather than documenting every actual batch.
pairs.false: The stored recipe proves which ingredient lots and personnel were used for each actual batch.
pairs.reason_ko: MFR는 반복 가능한 제조법이고 CR는 이번 실제 작업의 증거다.

pairs.true: The missing actual-batch documentation is not replaced by the master formulation record.
pairs.false: A master formula removes the need for a record of actual quantities, personnel, and quality checks.
pairs.reason_ko: 실제 preparation date/time·원료 lot·수량·담당자·검수·yield를 추적해야 한다.

pairs.true: The records should connect the preparation's identification to ingredients, assigned BUD, and relevant quality results.
pairs.false: The batch's identification can be disconnected from ingredient and quality records once the label is printed.
pairs.reason_ko: Label 출력 이후에도 조제·원료·품질의 traceability가 필요하다.

pairs.true: Any simplified record pathway applies only when its specified conditions and required information are met.
pairs.false: A short preparation time makes any omitted compounding record eligible for simplified treatment.
pairs.reason_ko: Flavoring·kit 등의 제한된 간소화 경로를 모든 짧은 작업에 확대하지 않는다.

title: Nonsterile default BUD and shorter limits
case_a: A nonpreserved aqueous compounded preparation has water activity at or above 0.6, and no applicable preparation-specific monograph or supporting stability data establishes a different limit.
case_b: A second preparation is a nonaqueous oral liquid with water activity below 0.6 under the same no-specific-data assumption; a component or product condition may impose a shorter limit.

pairs.true: The stated default for the first preparation is a maximum 14 days under refrigeration, subject to shorter applicable limits.
pairs.false: The first preparation receives a 35-day default because every aqueous formulation is treated as preserved.
pairs.reason_ko: Nonpreserved aqueous와 preserved aqueous의 기본 maximum을 구분한다. 첫 경로는 냉장 14일이다.

pairs.true: The stated nonaqueous oral-liquid default is 90 days, not the 180-day category for other nonaqueous dosage forms.
pairs.false: The second preparation receives 180 days merely because it is nonaqueous.
pairs.reason_ko: Nonaqueous oral liquid의 90일과 다른 nonaqueous 제형의 180일을 구분한다.

pairs.true: For an otherwise eligible preserved aqueous preparation, the described default maximum is 35 days at controlled room temperature or refrigerated conditions.
pairs.false: The preserved aqueous default is 35 days only when frozen.
pairs.reason_ko: Preserved aqueous의 보관 조건을 임의로 frozen-only로 바꾸지 않는다.

pairs.true: A shorter relevant stability or component limitation may require a BUD below the default maximum.
pairs.false: A default maximum permits ignoring a shorter demonstrated stability limitation.
pairs.reason_ko: Default는 보장기간이 아니라 상한이며 실제 제제의 더 짧은 제한이 우선할 수 있다.

title: Sterile categories and the surrounding environment
case_a: A pharmacy has an ISO 5 primary engineering control in an unclassified segregated compounding area and proposes assigning Category 2 conditions based only on the hood classification.
case_b: A second pharmacy describes Category 3 as a drug-toxicity classification and assumes it has no relation to facilities, testing, or allowed beyond-use dates.

pairs.true: An ISO 5 hood in the described SCA does not by itself establish the cleanroom conditions for Category 2 preparation.
pairs.false: An ISO 5 hood alone establishes Category 2 conditions regardless of the surrounding area.
pairs.reason_ko: PEC의 ISO 5와 SEC·SCA·cleanroom suite 조건을 별도로 평가한다.

pairs.true: Category 3 is a compounding framework involving additional conditions, not a toxicity grade for the ingredient.
pairs.false: Category 3 identifies the ingredient's third-level toxicity rather than compounding conditions.
pairs.reason_ko: Category 1·2·3을 옛 risk 명칭이나 약물 독성등급의 단순 치환으로 보지 않는다.

pairs.true: Facility category, personnel qualification, monitoring, testing, and BUD restrictions must be considered together.
pairs.false: Choosing a longer BUD is sufficient to establish the required facility category.
pairs.reason_ko: 긴 BUD를 먼저 고른 뒤 시설 조건이 충족됐다고 역으로 추정할 수 없다.

pairs.true: Sterile hazardous-drug work requires both product protection and appropriate containment for exposure control.
pairs.false: A product-protective positive-pressure workbench necessarily provides hazardous-drug containment.
pairs.reason_ko: 무균성 보호와 외부 HD 노출 방지는 동시에 충족해야 할 별도 목적이다.

title: Immediate-use timing and distinct sterile products
case_a: Preparation of an otherwise eligible immediate-use CSP starts at 8:00 AM and finishes at 8:25 AM. Administration is planned to begin at 12:15 PM.
case_b: A separate otherwise eligible preparation combines four different sterile products, but a staff member argues that small quantities make it fit the described three-product immediate-use limit.

pairs.true: The proposed 12:15 PM start exceeds four hours from the 8:00 AM preparation start.
pairs.false: The proposed 12:15 PM start meets the four-hour limit because preparation finished at 8:25 AM.
pairs.reason_ko: 네 시간의 시작점은 preparation 시작이다. 완료 시점이나 투여 종료 시점으로 바꾸지 않는다.

pairs.true: Four different sterile products exceed the stated limit regardless of their small individual quantities.
pairs.false: Four different sterile products satisfy the stated limit when each amount is small.
pairs.reason_ko: 서로 다른 sterile products의 수와 사용하는 부피·vial 수를 혼동하지 않는다.

pairs.true: The four-hour condition concerns when administration begins, not a requirement that the entire infusion finish within that period.
pairs.false: The entire infusion must finish within four hours for the described start-of-administration condition to be met.
pairs.reason_ko: Begin administration과 finish infusion은 서로 다른 시간 조건이다.

pairs.true: Immediate-use permission does not create a general exception allowing leftover single-dose contents to be shared among patients.
pairs.false: Immediate-use status authorizes retaining and sharing leftover single-dose contents among patients.
pairs.reason_ko: Source container와 환자별 사용 조건을 별도로 지켜야 한다.

title: Release testing is not interchangeable
case_a: A Massachusetts preparation is subject to a sterility-testing requirement, but the pharmacy wants to dispense it while the result is pending and recall it later if the result fails.
case_b: Another preparation passed a sterility test, and the pharmacist is asked to conclude that this also proves acceptable potency and absence of endotoxin.

pairs.true: The described Massachusetts policy requires a negative sterility result before dispensing a CSP for which that testing is required.
pairs.false: A plan to recall later satisfies the described policy while a required sterility result is pending.
pairs.reason_ko: 필수 sterility testing 대상 CSP의 negative-before-dispense 조건을 지킨다.

pairs.true: The sterility result does not by itself establish acceptable potency or endotoxin status.
pairs.false: Passing a sterility test establishes acceptable potency and endotoxin status for the same batch.
pairs.reason_ko: Sterility·potency·endotoxin·container integrity는 서로 다른 품질 속성이다.

pairs.true: A filter specification alone does not prove that a process removes endotoxin or supports a longer BUD.
pairs.false: Using a 0.2-micrometer filter establishes endotoxin removal and a longer BUD without additional evidence.
pairs.reason_ko: Filter compatibility·integrity·validated process와 pyrogen 평가를 분리한다.

pairs.true: Release review also considers appearance, particulates, container integrity, labeling, and applicable records.
pairs.false: A negative sterility result replaces the remaining pre-release visual and documentation checks.
pairs.reason_ko: 한 시험의 통과로 나머지 release checks를 생략하지 않는다.

title: Occupational hazard versus diversion schedule
case_a: A medication is not federally scheduled, but its handling can expose workers to a hazardous drug. Staff propose excluding it from the pharmacy's hazardous-drug assessment solely because it has no DEA schedule.
case_b: A compounding activity uses a hazardous active pharmaceutical ingredient; the manager proposes using a routine assessment of risk to waive the required containment.

pairs.true: Lack of a DEA schedule does not establish that a medicine is nonhazardous for occupational handling.
pairs.false: A medicine without a DEA schedule is outside hazardous-drug handling requirements.
pairs.reason_ko: HD의 직업적 노출 위험과 controlled-substance의 남용·유출 schedule은 다른 분류다.

pairs.true: The proposed assessment does not establish an exception to full containment for the described hazardous-API compounding activity.
pairs.false: A routine assessment of risk can waive containment for any hazardous active pharmaceutical ingredient.
pairs.reason_ko: AOR가 허용되는 제형·활동과 full containment가 필요한 활동의 경계를 지킨다.

pairs.true: Dosage form, packaging, manipulation, and exposure pathways are relevant to the risk assessment.
pairs.false: An ingredient's generic name is sufficient to assess risk without its dosage form or manipulation.
pairs.reason_ko: Counting·crushing·compounding·spill에서 노출 형태가 달라진다.

pairs.true: Hazardous-drug requirements can apply alongside controlled-substance requirements for the same medication.
pairs.false: A medication can be subject to either hazardous-drug controls or DEA controls, but not both.
pairs.reason_ko: 한 약이 두 체계 모두의 대상일 수 있으므로 중첩 의무를 확인한다.

title: Containment and personnel preparation
case_a: A pharmacy selects gloves based only on their nitrile material and has not established the applicable chemotherapy-glove performance or suitability for sterile hazardous preparation.
case_b: A new employee will independently handle hazardous drugs before role-specific training because the next annual competency assessment is scheduled soon.

pairs.true: Glove material alone does not establish the required chemotherapy-tested performance and task suitability.
pairs.false: Nitrile material alone establishes suitability for every sterile hazardous-drug task.
pairs.reason_ko: 소재 명칭과 chemo-tested 성능·sterile outer glove 등 작업별 요건은 다르다.

pairs.true: A future annual competency date does not replace training needed before independent hazardous-drug duties.
pairs.false: Upcoming annual evaluation permits independent hazardous-drug work before initial training.
pairs.reason_ko: 초기 training과 정기 competency를 별도로 충족한다.

pairs.true: Containment must be selected for the sterile or nonsterile activity and its exposure pathway.
pairs.false: A general nonhazardous sterile workbench establishes suitable containment for hazardous manipulation.
pairs.reason_ko: 제품을 보호하는 장비와 작업자·환경을 보호하는 containment의 목적을 구분한다.

pairs.true: An HD designated person and the Massachusetts nonsterile-compounding designated pharmacist are not interchangeable role definitions.
pairs.false: The HD designated-person title has the identical qualification rule as every nonsterile designated-pharmacist role.
pairs.reason_ko: 관련 규정·policy별로 지정인의 자격과 MOR의 책임을 따로 확인한다.

title: Residue removal and waste pathways
case_a: After a hazardous-drug manipulation, an employee uses an alcohol wipe and documents that deactivation, decontamination, cleaning, and disinfection are all established by that one action.
case_b: A returned material is both hazardous and federally controlled, but staff select a disposal vendor solely because it accepts ordinary pharmaceutical returns.

pairs.true: The single wipe does not establish that all four distinct hazardous-residue and microbial-control objectives were met.
pairs.false: An alcohol wipe necessarily establishes deactivation, decontamination, cleaning, and disinfection.
pairs.reason_ko: 약물 위해 감소·잔류 제거·일반 오염 제거·미생물 감소는 서로 다른 목적이다.

pairs.true: The disposal pathway must be assessed for both hazardous-waste and controlled-substance requirements that apply.
pairs.false: Acceptance of ordinary pharmaceutical returns proves authority to receive the described hazardous controlled waste.
pairs.reason_ko: Reverse distribution이라는 이름만으로 모든 폐기물의 수령 권한이 생기지 않는다.

pairs.true: Agent selection, contact time, sequence, compatibility, and personnel protection belong in the applicable procedure.
pairs.false: A residue-removal procedure can omit contact time and compatibility whenever the surface looks clean.
pairs.reason_ko: 외관 청결과 정해진 chemical·microbial control 수행은 다르다.

pairs.true: Damaged hazardous-drug packages require an appropriate containment and spill response rather than routine counter unpacking.
pairs.false: A visibly damaged hazardous-drug package should be opened at the normal receiving counter to identify the leak.
pairs.reason_ko: 손상 포장의 개봉 장소·PPE·격리·spill SOP와 적격 취급 조건을 확인한다.

title: 503A and 503B do not confer identical exemptions
case_a: An outsourcing facility relies on section 503B to supply eligible office-use stock and argues that it has the same cGMP exemption as qualifying section 503A preparations.
case_b: The facility tells purchasers that appearing in FDA's outsourcing-facility registration system means every compounded medicine it makes has individual FDA approval.

pairs.true: The described section 503B pathway remains subject to cGMP requirements.
pairs.false: Section 503B supplies receive the same described cGMP exemption as qualifying section 503A preparations.
pairs.reason_ko: 503A와 503B의 면제 범위·품질 규제를 동일시하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Outsourcing-facility registration does not constitute individual FDA approval of every compounded product.
pairs.false: FDA outsourcing-facility registration establishes individual product approval for all of its preparations.
pairs.reason_ko: 시설 등록과 제품 승인은 별개이며 개별 제품도 해당 조건을 충족해야 한다.

pairs.true: Federal permission to supply eligible office-use stock does not remove the need for a valid prescription when dispensing prescription drugs to an individual patient.
pairs.false: Office-use supply permission removes prescription requirements for later dispensing directly to patients.
pairs.reason_ko: 시설 stock 공급과 실제 환자에게 prescription drug를 dispense하는 단계를 구분한다.

pairs.true: Applicable Massachusetts facility authority remains a separate requirement from federal registration.
pairs.false: Federal outsourcing registration by itself establishes the required Massachusetts facility authority.
pairs.reason_ko: 연방 등록과 주의 license·MCSR·inspection 조건을 함께 확인한다.

title: Outsourcing ingredients and resale
case_a: A section 503B facility proposes using a bulk substance merely because it has a certificate of analysis, without establishing a qualifying clinical-need or shortage pathway.
case_b: A third party proposes buying compounded drugs from the outsourcing facility for ordinary wholesale resale, rather than dispensing under patient prescriptions or administering in a healthcare setting.

pairs.true: The certificate does not replace the bulk-substance eligibility conditions for section 503B.
pairs.false: A certificate of analysis alone establishes eligibility for any section 503B bulk substance.
pairs.reason_ko: 503B의 bulk eligibility 경로와 COA·제조자·compendial 조건을 별도로 충족한다.

pairs.true: The ordinary wholesale-resale plan is not justified by the described patient-dispensing or healthcare-administration pathways.
pairs.false: The patient-dispensing exception permits any purchaser to engage in ordinary wholesale resale.
pairs.reason_ko: 503B 재판매 제한과 적법한 patient dispensing·healthcare administration을 구분한다.

pairs.true: Essentially-copy and unsafe-or-ineffective withdrawal restrictions remain relevant to eligibility.
pairs.false: Section 503B status removes restrictions concerning copies and drugs withdrawn for safety reasons.
pairs.reason_ko: 등록이 개별 제품에 적용되는 추가 금지·제한을 없애지 않는다.

pairs.true: Where shortage status is the qualifying basis, the relevant statutory timing conditions must be evaluated.
pairs.false: A shortage at any historical time is sufficient for all later compounding, distribution, and dispensing.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 경로가 요구하는 compounding·distribution·dispensing 시점을 확인한다.

title: Outsourcing registration and product reporting
case_a: An outsourcing facility submits its annual registration in the October 1 through December 31 window and assumes that no separate drug-product report is required.
case_b: The facility supplies a preparation without a patient-specific prescription, but its label omits the applicable Office Use Only and Not for Resale statements.

pairs.true: Annual registration and the separate initial and June/December product-reporting obligations are distinct.
pairs.false: Submitting annual registration replaces the separate initial and semiannual product reports.
pairs.reason_ko: 시설 annual registration와 직전 기간의 drug reporting은 다른 제출물이다.

pairs.true: The label must be evaluated for the applicable Office Use Only and Not for Resale requirements.
pairs.false: A facility registration number substitutes for the described office-use and resale statements.
pairs.reason_ko: 503B의 해당 label·container 요건을 제품 공급 경로에 맞게 확인한다.

pairs.true: Product reports concern drugs compounded in the applicable preceding reporting period.
pairs.false: Product reports are limited to products that already have individual FDA marketing approval.
pairs.reason_ko: 503B product reporting을 approved-product 목록 제출로 축소하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Lot identification, preparation timing, and required storage information remain part of applicable labeling assessment.
pairs.false: A compounded-drug statement makes lot and storage information unnecessary.
pairs.reason_ko: Compounded 표시가 나머지 추적·사용정보를 대신하지 않는다.

title: Massachusetts outsourcing provisional status
case_a: A Massachusetts resident outsourcing facility has provisional status under a pathway allowing preparation while the required FDA inspection and full approval remain outstanding.
case_b: A nonresident outsourcing supplier presents its federal registration listing as the only evidence that it may supply Massachusetts.

pairs.true: The provisional preparation pathway does not itself authorize distribution or dispensing before the required inspection and full approval.
pairs.false: Permission to compound under the described provisional status also permits immediate distribution and dispensing.
pairs.reason_ko: Provisional에서 허용된 preparation과 full authority가 필요한 출고를 구분한다.

pairs.true: The nonresident supplier must establish applicable Massachusetts approval and relevant home-state and inspection conditions.
pairs.false: The federal listing alone establishes the described nonresident Massachusetts supply authority.
pairs.reason_ko: FDA 공개 등록명부의 존재와 MA에서 공급할 자격은 같지 않다.

pairs.true: State renewal timing and federal annual registration may require separate calendars.
pairs.false: Completing federal annual registration necessarily renews the Massachusetts authorization.
pairs.reason_ko: 연방·주의 서로 다른 갱신 체계를 한 번의 제출로 처리하지 않는다.

pairs.true: A relocation must follow the applicable advance application and new-location approval requirements.
pairs.false: An existing authorization transfers to a new address without applicable relocation review.
pairs.reason_ko: 사업장 주소 변경과 검사·승인·신청 시점을 별도로 관리한다.

title: Research access, marketing approval, and substitution
case_a: A sponsor has an investigational new drug pathway for clinical research and describes it to a retail pharmacy as approval to market the product for routine patient prescriptions.
case_b: A different product has an approved ANDA, and staff assume this permits substituting it for products with other routes and release formulations without a product-specific interchange assessment.

pairs.true: An IND-related research pathway is not the same as marketing approval for routine retail sale.
pairs.false: An IND establishes marketing approval for routine prescription sales outside the research pathway.
pairs.reason_ko: 연구용 사용·운송 경로와 일반 판매승인을 분리한다.

pairs.true: The ANDA approval does not establish interchangeability across unrelated routes or release formulations.
pairs.false: ANDA approval establishes pharmacist substitution across all routes and release formulations of the ingredient.
pairs.reason_ko: 제품 승인과 정확한 제형·route·strength·TE·주법상 대체조제 판단은 다르다.

pairs.true: A BLA is the licensing application pathway for biological products, rather than a pharmacy's professional license.
pairs.false: A BLA is the individual dispensing pharmacist's professional license.
pairs.reason_ko: BLA·NDA·ANDA·IND가 답하는 규제 질문을 구별한다.

pairs.true: Submission of an NDA and approval of that application are different regulatory states.
pairs.false: Submitting an NDA establishes that the proposed drug is approved for marketing.
pairs.reason_ko: 신청 접수·심사·승인 상태를 같은 것으로 처리하지 않는다.

title: An identifier is not an approval
case_a: A wholesaler presents an NDC number and a searchable label listing as proof that a particular product has FDA marketing approval.
case_b: A pharmacist sees an emergency-use authorization and treats it as unrestricted full approval without checking the authorization's current conditions or covered population.

pairs.true: The identifier and listing do not by themselves establish FDA approval of the specific product.
pairs.false: An NDC and searchable label together establish FDA approval without checking the applicable approval record.
pairs.reason_ko: NDC·listing·DailyMed 검색과 실제 approval 증거를 구별한다.

pairs.true: An EUA must be evaluated for its scope and current conditions rather than treated as unrestricted full approval.
pairs.false: An EUA removes the need to check the authorized population and conditions of use.
pairs.reason_ko: EUA는 정식 승인과 별도 경로이며 대상·조건·유효 상태가 중요하다.

pairs.true: An OTC medicine may follow an application pathway or an applicable monograph pathway.
pairs.false: Every OTC medicine is marketed through the monograph pathway and none through an approved application.
pairs.reason_ko: OTC라는 판매 구분만으로 승인 경로를 하나로 단정하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Off-label use of an approved product does not create new pharmacist prescribing authority.
pairs.false: An approved product's off-label use creates general independent prescribing authority for pharmacists.
pairs.reason_ko: 약물 사용 판단과 직종의 법적 scope·처방권한은 다른 층이다.

title: A limited DSCSA exemption is not a blanket waiver
case_a: A dispenser qualifies for a documented exemption covering specified enhanced DSCSA requirements during a defined period.
case_b: The dispenser therefore proposes purchasing from unqualified suppliers and dispensing suspect products without investigation, although those obligations are not among the exempted requirements.

pairs.true: The dispenser must identify precisely which requirements and time period the exemption covers.
pairs.false: Qualification for one DSCSA exemption removes every DSCSA obligation for that business.
pairs.reason_ko: 대상 entity·면제되는 구체적 요건·기간을 따로 확인한다.

pairs.true: The described exemption does not justify ignoring remaining trading-partner and suspect-product duties.
pairs.false: The specified enhanced-requirement exemption also waives the unrelated supplier and suspect-product duties.
pairs.reason_ko: Enhanced 요건의 한정 면제와 기본 공급망 의무를 구별한다.

pairs.true: An exemption's eligibility criteria must be established rather than inferred from the business calling itself small.
pairs.false: Describing the pharmacy as small establishes eligibility without applying the actual criteria.
pairs.reason_ko: Small이라는 일상적 명칭이 해당 기준일·직원수·대상 정의의 증거는 아니다.

pairs.true: A proposed or requested exemption is not equivalent to an effective exemption already granted.
pairs.false: Submitting an exemption request has the same effect as receiving a currently effective exemption.
pairs.reason_ko: 신청·제안·시행된 결정의 상태를 분리한다. 이 문항은 변동 가능한 연장 날짜 자체를 묻지 않는다.

title: Trading partners and traceability
case_a: A pharmacy receives a package with a product identifier but has not confirmed that the supplier qualifies as an authorized trading partner for the transaction.
case_b: A covered transaction's tracing records are scheduled for destruction after two years solely because staff remember a general pharmacy-record minimum.

pairs.true: The package identifier does not replace verification of the trading partner's applicable qualification.
pairs.false: A product identifier establishes the supplier's authorized-trading-partner status.
pairs.reason_ko: 제품 식별자와 공급자 자격은 별도 정보다.

pairs.true: The described DSCSA transaction records have their own six-year retention requirement.
pairs.false: The general two-year pharmacy-record minimum replaces the described DSCSA six-year requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: DSCSA 기록 보존과 일반 처방·구매 기록의 minimum을 혼동하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Lot, serial, expiration, and product-identification information serve traceability functions rather than patient-prescription authorization.
pairs.false: Traceability information provides the legal authority for a patient's prescription without a prescriber order.
pairs.reason_ko: 공급망 식별과 환자별 처방의 적법성은 다른 점검이다.

pairs.true: A transaction-specific exception requires evaluation of its actual conditions.
pairs.false: A transaction between two pharmacies is exempt without assessing its purpose or applicable conditions.
pairs.reason_ko: 약국끼리 거래한다는 사실만으로 모든 거래 예외를 확정하지 않는다.

title: Suspect and illegitimate products
case_a: A pharmacist identifies credible signs that a received product may be illegitimate but has not completed the required investigation.
case_b: After investigation, the product is determined to be illegitimate. Staff propose waiting until a routine monthly report to notify the appropriate parties.

pairs.true: The suspect-product situation calls for segregation and investigation rather than routine dispensing while uncertainty remains.
pairs.false: A suspect product may remain available for routine dispensing until it is definitively classified as illegitimate.
pairs.reason_ko: Suspect 단계에서도 quarantine·조사·거래자료 확인을 수행한다.

pairs.true: The stated illegitimate-product determination triggers the applicable 24-hour notification framework rather than routine monthly delay.
pairs.false: A monthly report satisfies the stated 24-hour notification requirement after illegitimate-product determination.
pairs.reason_ko: Determination과 최초 의심의 clock를 구분하고 FDA·immediate trading partner 통지를 확인한다.

pairs.true: FDA Form 3911 concerns the described DSCSA notification process, not DEA theft reporting.
pairs.false: FDA Form 3911 is the DEA form used instead of Form 106 for controlled-drug theft.
pairs.reason_ko: 기관·보고대상·양식의 역할을 구별한다.

pairs.true: Releasing quarantined product requires an appropriate documented resolution, not merely a decision that storage space is needed.
pairs.false: A quarantine can be ended solely to free storage space while the investigation remains unresolved.
pairs.reason_ko: 격리 해제에는 적정 조사·결론·기록이 필요하며 편의상 사용 가능 재고로 돌리지 않는다.

title: Recall, market withdrawal, and stock recovery
case_a: A manufacturer removes a marketed product for a violation that would support FDA legal action and describes the action as a routine commercial withdrawal.
case_b: Another manufacturer retrieves a lot still entirely under its direct control; none of that lot has been released for sale or use.

pairs.true: The first action fits the described recall concept rather than becoming a market withdrawal merely through the firm's chosen label.
pairs.false: Calling the first action a commercial withdrawal determines its category regardless of the violation.
pairs.reason_ko: 명칭보다 marketed 여부와 법적 조치 대상 위반 등 실제 조건을 확인한다.

pairs.true: The second situation fits the described stock-recovery concept because no part of the lot has been released for sale or use.
pairs.false: The second situation is necessarily a patient-level recall even though none of the lot was released.
pairs.reason_ko: Stock recovery는 아직 판매·사용을 위해 release되지 않은 lot와 직접 통제 조건을 포함한다.

pairs.true: A correction can occur without physically moving a product to a new location.
pairs.false: A recall-related correction requires physical transport of every affected product.
pairs.reason_ko: Relabeling·repair·inspection 등 현장 correction도 개념상 가능하다.

pairs.true: A non-recall classification does not itself eliminate patient-safety or other reporting duties arising from the facts.
pairs.false: Classifying an action as non-recall eliminates any other patient-safety or reporting obligation.
pairs.reason_ko: FDA 분류와 별도 Board 보고·환자 보호 의무를 각각 판단한다.

title: Risk class and an unclassified recall
case_a: A company begins a recall and notifies the pharmacy before FDA assigns a risk classification. Staff plan to continue dispensing the affected lot until a class appears.
case_b: A separate recalled product is classified as Class III, and a technician assumes the pharmacy can disregard the recall because serious harm is unlikely.

pairs.true: Lack of a completed FDA classification does not justify continuing to dispense the affected lot contrary to the recall instructions.
pairs.false: A pharmacy should continue dispensing an affected lot until FDA assigns Class I, II, or III.
pairs.reason_ko: Recall initiation과 FDA classification이 같은 날일 필요는 없다. Not yet classified도 조치가 필요할 수 있다.

pairs.true: Class III's lower expected health risk does not authorize disregarding the recall.
pairs.false: Class III makes compliance with the recall instructions optional.
pairs.reason_ko: 위험 가능성이 낮다는 분류와 회수 지시 이행은 다른 판단이다.

pairs.true: Class I concerns a reasonable probability of serious adverse health consequences or death.
pairs.false: Class I means a low probability of any health consequence and is the least serious category.
pairs.reason_ko: Recall Class I을 Class III 또는 controlled-substance Schedule I과 혼동하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Lot identification and distribution history remain necessary regardless of the risk class.
pairs.false: The recall class alone identifies which patients received the affected lot.
pairs.reason_ko: Risk class는 위험 구분이며 실제 lot·환자·배송 경로는 별도 추적한다.

title: Nuclear pharmacy's additional requirements
case_a: A pharmacist holds a general Massachusetts pharmacist license but has not established the required qualified-nuclear-pharmacist approval or facility radiation authority.
case_b: An eligible nuclear-dispensing situation uses the described limited pathway when the patient's name is initially unavailable; the pharmacy plans never to obtain it afterward.

pairs.true: The general pharmacist license does not replace the additional nuclear qualification and applicable facility authority.
pairs.false: The general pharmacist license alone establishes the described nuclear qualification and facility radiation authority.
pairs.reason_ko: 개인 약사 면허·qualified nuclear pharmacist 승인·방사선 시설 authority를 구별한다.

pairs.true: The limited patient-name pathway requires obtaining that information within the described 72 hours after dispensing.
pairs.false: The limited patient-name pathway permanently waives obtaining the patient's name.
pairs.reason_ko: 이 72시간은 해당 핵약학 예외의 후속 정보 기한으로 일반 처방 누락 허가가 아니다.

pairs.true: The described nuclear acquisition and disposition records have a three-year retention requirement.
pairs.false: The nuclear acquisition and disposition records are governed only by a one-year retention requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: 특수 nuclear 기록의 3년과 일반 약국 기록의 별도 최소기간을 구분한다.

pairs.true: Radioactivity information must be interpreted with its calibration date and time.
pairs.false: Radioactivity information remains unchanged regardless of its calibration date or time.
pairs.reason_ko: 방사성 activity와 calibration time의 연결을 유지한다. 이 문항은 전체 USP 825 실무를 포괄하지 않는다.

title: Quality event categories
case_a: A pharmacist catches an incorrect strength before it reaches the patient. The system records it as a near miss.
case_b: A properly dispensed commercial medicine causes an adverse reaction, while a different preparation has a quality defect but has not yet harmed a patient.

pairs.true: The first situation is not the same as the policy's patient-received QRE definition, although it remains relevant to safety improvement.
pairs.false: A near miss intercepted before reaching the patient is identical to the policy's patient-received QRE definition.
pairs.reason_ko: QRE의 해당 정의와 near miss를 구분하되 near miss의 분석 가치를 지우지 않는다.

pairs.true: An adverse event and a product defect are different categories that can have different reporting triggers.
pairs.false: An adverse event and a product defect are the same category with the same trigger in every case.
pairs.reason_ko: Clinical harm·quality defect·dispensing error는 서로 다르며 겹칠 수도 있다.

pairs.true: Absence of current patient injury does not establish that a defective preparation is acceptable for dispensing.
pairs.false: A preparation cannot be considered defective unless patient injury has already occurred.
pairs.reason_ko: 결함 판단과 실제 harm 발생을 분리한다.

pairs.true: An accurate dispensing process does not prove that an adverse reaction is impossible.
pairs.false: Correct product selection and labeling rule out any subsequent adverse reaction.
pairs.reason_ko: 정확한 조제와 약물의 위해반응 가능성은 다른 문제다.

title: A meaningful CQI program
case_a: A pharmacy maintains only a list of employees associated with errors, with no documented analysis of contributing factors or prevention process.
case_b: After adopting a workflow change, the pharmacy never checks whether staff follow it or whether the targeted problem recurs.

pairs.true: Identifying an employee alone does not provide the described written CQI program's detection, assessment, and prevention functions.
pairs.false: An employee-name error list fulfills the described CQI program without contributing-factor analysis.
pairs.reason_ko: 개인 이름 기록만이 아니라 workflow·staffing·기술·교육·SOP의 원인과 예방을 다룬다.

pairs.true: The change should be followed by evaluation of implementation and effectiveness.
pairs.false: Adopting a workflow change establishes effectiveness without further evaluation.
pairs.reason_ko: CAPA 수립과 실제 이행·재발 방지 효과 확인을 구별한다.

pairs.true: Personnel CQI education is required at least annually under the described framework.
pairs.false: CQI education is needed only when the pharmacy first opens.
pairs.reason_ko: Written program과 정기 인력 교육을 함께 유지한다.

pairs.true: The program should assign responsibility and use findings to reduce patient harm and recurrence.
pairs.false: The program should focus only on assigning blame because system factors are outside CQI.
pairs.reason_ko: 학습용 system-factor 예시는 별도 법정 staffing 수치를 만드는 것이 아니라 원인분석 방식이다.

title: Immediate action and the CQI record clock
case_a: A pharmacist learns of a QRE at 10:00 AM Monday but proposes waiting until Friday's completed investigation to begin the initial record.
case_b: The pharmacy has notified the patient and given corrective instructions, yet staff assume that this makes a written CQI record unnecessary.

pairs.true: Initial documentation is due within the described 24 hours after discovery or notification, not after the investigation ends.
pairs.false: The initial documentation clock begins only when the investigation is complete.
pairs.reason_ko: 발견하거나 설명을 들은 시점과 최종 조사완료 시점을 혼동하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Patient communication does not replace the required CQI documentation.
pairs.false: Patient notification substitutes for keeping the QRE record.
pairs.reason_ko: 즉시 환자 보호·통지와 기록·분석은 각각 수행해야 한다.

pairs.true: The described QRE records are retained for at least two years from the QRE report date.
pairs.false: The described QRE record may be discarded as soon as the patient accepts the correction.
pairs.reason_ko: QRE report date 기준 보존과 환자의 수용 여부를 구분한다.

pairs.true: New investigation findings can supplement an initial record made with currently known facts.
pairs.false: An initial record must be delayed until every contributing factor is conclusively known.
pairs.reason_ko: 현재 확인 사실을 제때 기록하고 후속 조사 결과를 추가한다.

title: Serious injury without inpatient admission
case_a: Improper dispensing leads to an emergency-department visit with additional treatment and monitoring, but the patient is not admitted as an inpatient.
case_b: A manager classifies the event as nonserious solely because it did not cause death or inpatient admission.

pairs.true: The additional emergency-department treatment and monitoring may satisfy the described serious-injury definition.
pairs.false: Absence of inpatient admission excludes the event from the described serious-injury definition.
pairs.reason_ko: MA policy의 serious injury에는 hospital·ED의 추가 treatment·testing·monitoring 경로가 포함된다.

pairs.true: The manager must apply the actual definition rather than use death or admission as the exclusive test.
pairs.false: Death or inpatient admission are the exclusive criteria in the described Massachusetts definition.
pairs.reason_ko: 정의에 열거된 여러 결과를 실제 사실에 적용한다.

pairs.true: A state SADE definition and the federal 503B serious-and-unexpected standard are separate frameworks.
pairs.false: The Massachusetts SADE definition is interchangeable with the federal 503B serious-and-unexpected standard.
pairs.reason_ko: 주 정의의 preventable 요소와 연방 unexpected 요소를 하나의 기준으로 합치지 않는다.

pairs.true: Subsequent clinical information may change which reporting triggers the pharmacy must assess.
pairs.false: The first clinical description fixes the reporting assessment even if more serious outcomes later appear.
pairs.reason_ko: 사건 경과와 추가 정보에 따라 적용 의무를 다시 확인한다.

title: Improper dispensing with serious harm
case_a: A resident pharmacy's MOR discovers both improper dispensing and the resulting serious injury on the same day. No uncertainty about which fact was discovered first exists in this case.
case_b: After filing the applicable Board report, staff propose retaining the associated records for only the general two-year prescription-record period.

pairs.true: The event requires the applicable prompt Board reporting with the described seven-business-day outside limit.
pairs.false: The described reporting limit is seven calendar days rather than seven business days.
pairs.reason_ko: 동일 날짜에 두 사실을 안 사례로 시작점 차이를 제거했다. Prompt action과 최대 7 business days를 구별한다.

pairs.true: The described improper-dispensing report records require at least five years from Board-report filing.
pairs.false: The general two-year prescription-record period replaces the five-year report-record requirement.
pairs.reason_ko: §20.02의 해당 report records와 일반 prescription records의 기간이 다르다.

pairs.true: The Board report does not replace patient notification and applicable CQI duties.
pairs.false: Submitting the Board report eliminates the separate patient-notification and CQI obligations.
pairs.reason_ko: 기관 보고·환자 보호·내부 품질관리는 병렬 의무다.

pairs.true: A nonresident pharmacy's dispensing into Massachusetts must be assessed under its applicable reporting provision.
pairs.false: Nonresident status makes improper dispensing into Massachusetts exempt from Board reporting.
pairs.reason_ko: Resident 조항의 특정 제외가 nonresident의 별도 보고 조항을 없애지 않는다.

title: A pharmacy-produced drug and an SADE
case_a: An employee learns that a drug produced by the pharmacy is associated with an event satisfying the applicable Massachusetts SADE trigger. The MOR first reads the employee's message three days later.
case_b: The preparation is also suspected to be defective and to have caused the SADE, bringing the described immediate defective-preparation policy into the assessment.

pairs.true: The employee-awareness trigger is not postponed until the MOR opens the message.
pairs.false: The reporting clock necessarily starts only when the MOR reads the employee's message.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 규정은 어떤 pharmacy employee든 알게 된 시점을 사용한다.

pairs.true: The immediate defective-preparation policy cannot be ignored merely because a general seven-business-day provision exists.
pairs.false: The general seven-business-day provision permits disregarding the applicable immediate defective-preparation policy.
pairs.reason_ko: 일반 보고기한과 더 빠른 specific policy trigger를 함께 확인한다.

pairs.true: The described state pathway connects reporting to the Board, FDA MedWatch, and the Betsy Lehman Center.
pairs.false: The described state pathway requires reporting only to the pharmacy's purchasing wholesaler.
pairs.reason_ko: 해당 pharmacy-produced SADE 경로의 수신기관을 구분한다.

pairs.true: This specific trigger should not be copied to every ordinary adverse effect of every accurately dispensed commercial medicine.
pairs.false: Every ordinary side effect of any commercial medicine meets this pharmacy-produced SADE trigger.
pairs.reason_ko: 제품의 제조·조제 주체와 사건 정의·결과가 충족되는지 먼저 판단한다.

title: Federal outsourcing adverse-event reporting
case_a: A section 503B outsourcing facility receives initial information about a serious and unexpected adverse drug experience involving its compounded prescription drug.
case_b: Material follow-up information arrives later, but the facility plans to hold it until the next annual registration renewal.

pairs.true: The described initial FDA report is due as soon as possible and no later than 15 calendar days after initial receipt.
pairs.false: The initial report can be deferred until the annual registration-renewal window.
pairs.reason_ko: Federal 503B의 initial receipt와 15 calendar days를 annual registration와 분리한다.

pairs.true: Applicable follow-up reporting has its own 15-calendar-day framework rather than the annual-registration schedule.
pairs.false: Follow-up information is reported only during annual registration.
pairs.reason_ko: 추가 정보 수령 또는 FDA 요구에 따른 follow-up 의무를 별도로 수행한다.

pairs.true: The described adverse-experience records have a ten-year federal retention requirement.
pairs.false: The described adverse-experience records have no retention requirement after report submission.
pairs.reason_ko: 연방 AE 기록 10년과 다른 약국 기록기간을 구분한다.

pairs.true: An applicable faster Massachusetts obligation remains separate from the federal outside limit.
pairs.false: The federal 15-day limit removes any applicable faster Massachusetts reporting duty.
pairs.reason_ko: 동시에 적용되는 주 immediate·7 business days 등을 연방 한도로 대체하지 않는다.

title: Defective preparations: recall, log, and report
case_a: A pharmacy has reason to believe a preparation it dispensed is defective. No patient injury has yet been reported.
case_b: The pharmacy treats the recall log and the separate report for a dispensed sterile or complex nonsterile defect as one document with an identical trigger date in every event.

pairs.true: The described defect obligation calls for immediate recall and quarantine without waiting for proven patient injury.
pairs.false: Recall and quarantine are required only after patient injury has been established.
pairs.reason_ko: 알거나 합리적으로 알 이유가 있는 결함과 harm의 확정을 구분한다.

pairs.true: The recall-based log-availability clock and the defect-identification reporting clock must be tracked separately.
pairs.false: The recall log and defect report necessarily have the same trigger date because both mention seven days.

title: ISO 5 environmental action thresholds
case_a: An ISO 5 viable air result is 2 CFU per cubic meter per media device. Staff compare it with the described action level of greater than 1 CFU.
case_b: A separate ISO 5 surface result is exactly 3 CFU per media device, and staff compare it with the described surface threshold of greater than 3 CFU.

pairs.true: The first result exceeds the stated ISO 5 viable-air action threshold.
pairs.false: The first result does not exceed the threshold because the applicable ISO 5 viable-air number is 3 CFU.
pairs.reason_ko: ISO 5 air >1과 surface >3은 다른 기준이다.

pairs.true: Exactly 3 CFU does not exceed a threshold written as greater than 3, although other relevant findings still require assessment.
pairs.false: Exactly 3 CFU exceeds the stated greater-than-3 threshold because greater than means greater than or equal to.
pairs.reason_ko: >와 ≥를 바꾸지 않는다. Threshold 미초과를 모든 품질 문제 없음의 보증으로 확대하지 않는다.

pairs.true: Air and surface results require their respective sampling units and thresholds.

pairs.reason_ko: Air는 m³와 media device, surface는 media device 기준을 확인한다.

pairs.false: An action-level result can be dismissed solely because the preparation looks clear.
pairs.reason_ko: 제품 외관은 환경모니터링 action level의 대응을 대체하지 않는다.

title: Sampling denominators and pass-through classification
case_a: A laboratory reports viable-air counts per cubic meter, but staff treat that unit as one liter when comparing it with the policy's air limits.
case_b: A pass-through connects two different ISO-classified spaces, and personnel apply the less clean space's threshold without considering the stated policy rule.

pairs.true: One cubic meter corresponds to 1,000 liters, so the reported denominator must not be treated as one liter.
pairs.false: One cubic meter and one liter are interchangeable denominators for the reported air result.
pairs.reason_ko: 수치뿐 아니라 실제 공기량·분모를 보존한다.

pairs.true: The described pass-through rule uses the cleaner connected space's ISO classification.
pairs.false: The pass-through necessarily uses the less clean connected space's classification.
pairs.reason_ko: 연결된 공간 중 더 깨끗한 ISO 분류를 사용하는 policy 조건을 확인한다.

pairs.true: Results from distinct sites or media devices should not be combined into an invented cumulative comparison.

pairs.true: The appropriate threshold depends on ISO class and whether the measurement is nonviable, viable air, or surface.

pairs.reason_ko: ISO5·7·8 및 측정 방식별 숫자·단위가 다르다.

title: Environmental reporting and repeat findings

case_b: The same ISO area has another action-level finding within 60 days, separated from the first by an acceptable result.

pairs.reason_ko: 해당 보고 담당자의 범위와 책임을 확인한다.

title: Nonviable failure versus conditional viable remediation
case_a: A pharmacy exceeds a nonviable-particle action level and proposes using a conditional viable-remediation pathway to avoid stopping and recertifying, with no different Board direction.
case_b: A pharmacy considering permitted conditional work during viable remediation assumes an additional remediation BUD ceiling can extend the shorter baseline limit for its actual CSP category.

pairs.true: An additional remediation ceiling does not extend a shorter otherwise-applicable category or stability limit.

pairs.true: Conditional viable-remediation work requires the specified risk assessment, implemented remediation, repeat sampling, and product-risk controls.

pairs.reason_ko: Affected·unaffected 구분과 조사 결과에 근거한 제한적 판단을 유지한다.
